title: Sonu Sood rents out commercial unit in Mumbai’s Versova for Rs 3.52 crores
body: Here's the latest box office buzz making the rounds:

The locality is known for its coastal setting, residential developments and proximity to Mumbai’s entertainment industry. It will increase to Rs 5.40 lakhs in the second year, Rs 5.83 lakh in the third year, Rs 6.29 lakhs in the fourth year and Rs 6.80 lakhs in the fifth year.

Notably, Versova is connected to several parts of Mumbai through Link Road, SV Road and the Western Express Highway. The Versova Metro station and Andheri railway station provide access to different residential and commercial areas across the city.

As per the latest buzz, The locality also offers connectivity to business hubs such as Andheri East, Goregaon and Bandra Kurla Complex. Its social infrastructure includes Versova Beach, cafes, restaurants, retail outlets, educational institutions and healthcare facilities. The proposed Versova-Bandra Sea Link is expected to improve connectivity across Mumbai’s western suburbs once completed.
In further updates, The area’s combination of urban amenities, coastal surroundings and proximity to entertainment hubs has contributed to its appeal among residents and professionals.

title: Amitabh Bachchan takes a break from social media for a few days following medical advice
body: Here's the latest update from the Bollywood world:
Amitabh Bachchan continues to host Kaun Banega Crorepati 18 and is set to reprise his role as Ashwatthama in the sequel to Kalki 2898 AD.

Adding to this, Taking to X, the Kalki 2898 AD star wrote in Hindi, “Apologies. I seek forgiveness. I have been advised to take a few days off to rest and recover, so I am unable to write anything at the moment.” His announcement came amid recent speculation surrounding his health and retirement, both of which had attracted attention in recent weeks.

Meanwhile, Bachchan had sparked retirement rumours last month after sharing a cryptic entry on Tumblr. However, he subsequently clarified that the post did not indicate that he was stepping away from his acting career and that he had simply been going to sleep for the night.
Notably, Amitabh Bachchan's Soon-to-release Projects And Television Commitments

As per the latest buzz, Despite the latest update, Bachchan continues to have projects lined up across films and television. The star is set to return as Ashwatthama in Nag Ashwin's soon-to-release sequel to Kalki 2898 AD , alongside Prabhas and Kamal Haasan. He is also continuing his association with television as the host of the current season of Kaun Banega Crorepati .

In further updates, Earlier this month, Bachchan appeared less energetic than usual during an episode of Kaun Banega Crorepati 18 . He skipped his customary opening monologue while standing at the centre of the stage and explained that he had suffered a fall on the set the previous day. Pointing towards his left knee, the star addressed the incident and reassured the audience about the situation. He initially remained seated while delivering his opening remarks before getting back on his feet to host the contestants.

On top of that, The star's health had also drawn attention in May, when reports claimed that he had been admitted to Mumbai's Nanavati Hospital. According to those reports, however, the visit was for his routine monthly health check-up, and he returned home the same day.

While Bachchan has now verified that he has been advised to take a few days off, he has not shared further details about his condition. His latest announcement suggests that he will be reducing his social media activity temporarily while following the recommendation to rest and recover.

Adding to this, The reported return to the movie’s set came shortly after the firing incident. While further details about the investigation remain awaited, the arrests of the three accused marked a development in the case.

Following the firing incident involving Tiger, Vidyut shared a video addressing the broader issue of people witnessing harassment or assault without intervening. He captioned the video, “We know there’s a lot happening in our country. Sometimes we can raise our voice, sometimes we can’t, but WE do in our own way, But when we see someone being harassed or assaulted on the street (woman ), why do we stand by and watch? Why can’t one of us step forward, not just as witnesses, but as human beings? We need fewer spectators and more heroes.”

title: Daler Mehndi controversy: FWICE writes to PM Narendra Modi, Uttarakhand CM Pushkar Singh Dhami after minister’s alcohol allegation
body: Here's the latest update from the Bollywood world:

The development follows an incident at the Siddhpeeth Maa Kunjapuri Tourism and Development Fair in New Tehri on Sunday, when Uttarakhand Cabinet minister Subodh Uniyal interrupted Mehndi’s performance and alleged that the singer was under the influence of alcohol.

Adding to this, In its letters, FWICE shared it was aware of Mehndi’s health-related issues and recovery from surgery. The federation also shared that, to its knowledge, the singer does not consume alcohol.

Meanwhile, Addressing the row, FWICE shared concerns about a performer’s condition should be handled discreetly rather than through public reprimands. “While we recognise the importance of ensuring the smooth conduct of public events, such concerns should be addressed with sensitivity and discretion rather than through public reprimand (sic),” the federation wrote.

Notably, It further stressed the need to avoid reaching conclusions about an artist’s condition without sufficient consideration of the circumstances. “In these circumstances, it is particularly important to exercise restraint before drawing conclusions about an artist's condition. Any concerns regarding a performer's well-being should be addressed with compassion and professionalism,” the letter shared.

As per the latest buzz, FWICE (Federation of Western India Cine Employees) writes to PM Modi and Uttarakhand CM Pushkar Singh Dhami over alleged public humiliation of singer Daler Mehndi by Uttarakhand Minister Subodh Uniyal. https://t.co/PhvtRHmquh
In further updates, — Press Trust of India (@PTI_News) October 21, 2026

On top of that, FWICE also highlighted Mehndi’s contribution to Indian music, noting that his work has collected him recognition across generations. It shared the incident had caused concern within the entertainment industry.

title: Aastha Tiku’s directorial debut Dreamboat to premiere at Dharamshala International Film Festival; first look out
body: Here's the latest fashion moment turning heads:

Written and directed by Tiku, Dreamboat follows an underground musician whose unconventional relationship with her favourite pillow is interrupted by her mother. She then embarks on a strange journey through Mumbai, where her friendships, desires and sense of reality begin to shift.
Adding to this, The abandoned pillow also takes on a life of its own, adding a surreal element to the story as the protagonist searches for love and connection in an increasingly unfamiliar city.

As per the latest buzz, Explaining the central relationship in the movie, Tiku added, “Through the fantasy genre with a female protagonist the intent was to capture the relationship of an artist and her muse - a pillow. The movie allowed me to follow my instincts and make something honest, punk and experiential.”
In further updates, The movie is produced by Tiku and National Award-winning filmmaker Amit Masurkar, whose credits include Newton, Sherni and Sulemani Keeda.
On top of that, Masurkar shared the movie’s unusual premise and visual approach attracted him to the project.

“What drew me to Dreamboat was its unconventional premise and the treatment boards Aastha had prepared for the movie. I love how she used pop culture, music, colour, language, fashion to create this campy and surreal fever dream,” he shared.

title: Mere participation in protest not enough to show intention to disobey, obstruct police: HC
body: Here's the latest protest news from across India:
New Delhi, The Delhi High Court has shared that mere participation in a demonstration does not by itself establish a "common intention" to disobey police directions or obstruct police personnel.

Adding to this, Mere participation in protest not enough to show intention to disobey, obstruct police: HC Justice Sanjeev Narula made the observation while quashing an FIR against an SSC aspirant who was booked by Delhi Police in 2025 for allegedly failing to disperse from Ramlila Maidan despite repeated announcements to vacate the protest venue.
Meanwhile, The petitioner had participated in the protest at Ramlila Maidan in August last year over alleged irregularities in the conduct of the SSC entrance examination.

Notably, The prosecution claimed that certain organisers refused to conclude the demonstration after the expiry of the permitted time and instigated the gathering to remain at the venue until their demands were fulfilled.

As per the latest buzz, The police registered the FIR alleging that certain protestors disobeyed the prohibitory orders under Section 163 of the Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita as they continued to occupy the ground and some of them pushed and scuffled with police personnel.

In further updates, Giving relief to the petitioner, the court shared that neither the FIR nor the subsequent status report attributed any criminal conduct specifically to him, and his mere presence among the protesters, in the absence of a common intention to commit a crime with others, was not sufficient to establish the offence under section 223 of the Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita .

On top of that, The provision penalises disobedience of an order lawfully promulgated by a public servant, where the person concerned has knowledge of such order and the disobedience causes, or tends to cause, obstruction, annoyance etc to persons lawfully employed.

"The petitioner cannot be subjected to criminal proceedings merely on account of his presence amongst the protesters, in the absence of material indicating his knowing participation in the alleged disobedience or any common intention to commit the offence. The continuation of the proceedings against him, in these circumstances, would serve no worthwhile purpose," shared the court in the order passed on October 13.

title: Sonakshi Sinha, Zaheer Iqbal's Tu Hai Meri Kiran to release tomorrow as planned, producers say ₹8.85 crore dispute has been resolved
body: Here's the latest box office buzz making the rounds:

Actors Sonakshi Sinha and Zaheer Iqbal’s Tu Hai Meri Kiran will arrive in theatres on October 23, with the producers confirming that the dispute surrounding the movie has been resolved internally. The announcement comes after the Bombay High Court intervened earlier this week, putting the movie’s planned theatrical rollout in doubt. Producers Vishal Rana and Sarvesh Goel have now shared the movie will rollout as scheduled.

Adding to this, Sonakshi Sinha and Zaheer Iqbal’s Tu Hai Meri Kiran will arrive in theatres on October 23, with the producers confirming that the dispute surrounding the movie has been resolved internally. What the makers are saying Vishal Rana addressed the situation in a statement, saying, “There were certain matters that needed to be addressed, and I am glad that we have been able to resolve them internally. Everything is now sorted, and we are moving ahead with the rollout of Tu Hai Meri Kiran as planned on 23rd October. Our focus has always been on bringing the movie to audiences, and we look forward to its theatrical rollout tomorrow.”

Meanwhile, Sarvesh Goel also clarified that the matter had been settled and that the team was preparing for the rollout. He shared, “There have been reports surrounding the movie, but I would like to clarify that the matter has been resolved internally. We are moving forward as planned, and Tu Hai Meri Kiran will rollout in cinemas on 23rd October. Our priority is to ensure that the movie reaches audiences as intended, and we look forward to its rollout.”

Notably, According to Bar and Bench, the movie’s rollout came under a cloud after the Bombay High Court passed an interim order on October 19, restraining its theatrical rollout. Justice Amit Borkar issued the order under Section 9 of the Arbitration and Conciliation Act after co-producer AND Movie Products LLP approached the court over a financial dispute with Echelon Productions.

As per the latest buzz, AND Movie claimed it had invested ₹ 8.85 crore rupees under a co-production agreement signed with Echelon in March 2024. It alleged that the money had not been returned even after the agreed deadline had passed and that a cheque issued towards the payment had been dishonoured.

In further updates, Echelon, in response, argued that AND Movie had effectively agreed to the rollout by participating in promotional posts on Instagram. The court, however, made it clear that taking part in a movie’s publicity does not automatically mean giving up contractual rights or agreeing to its commercial rollout.

On top of that, The court directed Echelon Productions to deposit ₹ 8.85 crore rupees, along with 15% interest, within three working days as security before proceeding with the rollout. It also asked the production house to disclose agreements with third parties relating to the movie’s commercial exploitation and restore the agreed producer credits within 48 hours. The producers have since maintained that the matter has been resolved internally and that the movie will rollout on the original date.

Directed and written by Karan Rawal, Tu Hai Meri Kiran brings together romance, mystery and suspense. The movie explores complicated relationships, one-sided love and unexpected turns. Ankit Gupta, Sherlin Seth, Zarina Wahab and Purnendu Bhattacharya also feature in the movie. It is presented by Echelon Productions and AND Productions, with Vishal Rana, Sarvesh Goel, Ashwani Kumar, Manoj Darak and Nrupal Patel serving as producers.

title: Ranbir Kapoor and Yash’s film Ramayana crosses ₹5.33 crore in advance booking 14 days before release, sells 1.28 lakh tickets
body: Here's the latest box office buzz making the rounds:

Nitesh Tiwari’s Ramayana is seeing encouraging interest at the advance booking window, with audiences already booking tickets for the Ranbir Kapoor and Yash -starrer ahead of its November rollout. The movie opened advance bookings on Tuesday, October 20, coinciding with Dussehra. With nearly two weeks to go before it hits theatres, the early numbers have given the mythological epic a promising start.

Adding to this, Nitesh Tiwari’s Ramayana has got off to a promising start at the advance booking window, with audiences showing interest in the Ranbir Kapoor, Sai Pallavi and Yash-starrer nearly two weeks before its theatrical rollout. Ramayana advance booking report According to trade tracker Sacnilk, Ramayana had collected ₹ 5.33 crore rupees gross across India by 3 pm on Wednesday, October 21, excluding block seats. The movie had sold 1.28 lakh tickets across 3,710 shows.

Meanwhile, Bookings have continued to rise since the initial 6 am cut-off, adding another ₹ 21.71 lakh to the total. The movie’s overall occupancy is around 15%, with the Hindi version accounting for the bulk of the early business. The Kannada and Telugu versions have also begun drawing audiences, adding to the movie’s pan-India reach.

Notably, Delhi-NCR is currently the biggest market for Ramayana, contributing ₹ 1.82 crore rupees, or around 34% of its total gross. Mumbai follows with ₹ 1.07 crore rupees, accounting for nearly 20% of the collection. Pune has recorded ₹ 35.31 lakh in advance sales, while Hyderabad has contributed ₹ 32.22 lakh and Bengaluru ₹ 31.45 lakh. The state-wise figures show Maharashtra at the top with ₹ 1.72 crore rupees, followed by Delhi at ₹ 1.40 crore rupees and Gujarat at ₹ 46.54 lakh.

As per the latest buzz, The dubbed versions are also attracting early interest. The Kannada version has collected ₹ 19.03 lakh from 69 shows, with Yash playing Ravana likely to be a major attraction for audiences in Karnataka. The Telugu version has collected ₹ 17.41 lakh from 34 shows.

In further updates, Directed by Nitesh Tiwari, Ramayana: Rise of a Legend brings the story of the ancient Indian epic to the big screen on a grand scale. Ranbir Kapoor plays Lord Rama, Sai Pallavi stars as Sita, and Yash portrays Ravana. The cast also features Sunny Deol as Hanuman and Ravie Dubey as Lakshmana.

On top of that, Academy Award-winning visual effects company DNEG is handling the VFX, while the music is composed by Hans Zimmer and A.R. Rahman. Produced by Namit Malhotra, the movie is planned as a two-part saga. The first instalment is scheduled to arrive in theatres on November 5, 2026, while the second part is expected to rollout in 2027.

title: Keerthy Suresh, Radhika Apte, Rana Daggubati, Huma Qureshi and Vetrimaaran: IFP announces its celeb lineup for Season 16
body: Here's the latest update from the Bollywood world:

Actors, filmmakers, writers and artists from across the country will come together for the 16th edition of IFP, scheduled for October 24 and 25 at Mehboob Studios in Mumbai. This year's line-up includes Keerthy Suresh , Radhika Apte, Rana Daggubati , Mrunal Thakur, Sobhita Dhulipala , Huma Qureshi, Nithya Menen and Pratik Gandhi, alongside National Award-winning filmmaker Vetrimaaran and several other names from the creative industries. Spread across two days, the festival will feature conversations, masterclasses and workshops covering cinema, streaming, writing, music, advertising and digital storytelling.

Adding to this, IFP Season 16: Keerthy Suresh, Mrunal Thakur, Sobhita Dhulipala, Rana Daggubati and Vetrimaaran among star attractions. Vetrimaaran, Rana Daggubati and Huma Qureshi to discuss their journeys Filmmaker Vetrimaaran will talk about his approach to cinema and the process of making films in a session titled Making of a Modern Auteur. Rana Daggubati will look beyond his work as an star and discuss his efforts to support new talent in More Than a Star: On Nurturing the New Wave.

Meanwhile, Huma Qureshi will revisit the roles and career decisions that have shaped her as a performer in Many Lives of Huma Qureshi. Mrunal Thakur will also look back at her journey from television to Hindi and Telugu cinema in Making Her Mark, while Sobhita Dhulipala is among the actors set to feature at the festival.

Notably, Keerthy Suresh and Radhika Apte will share the stage for On Playing Power Ft. AKKA. The conversation will focus on their characters in the soon-to-release Netflix series Akka and what it takes to portray women who hold power. title: 'Not involved with CJP's protest call': Neha Bora to Delhi HC on Oct 16 detention
body: Here's the latest protest news from across India:

All India Students’ Association (AISA) president Neha Bora on Thursday told the Delhi High Court that she was not involved in a separate protest call issued by the Cockroach Janta Party (CJP) at Central Park on October 16.

Adding to this, CJP founder Abhijeet Dipke revealed a flag march on Friday evening after the party’s co-convenors, Saurav Das and Ashutosh Ranka, were arrested. (REUTERS) The court was hearing Bora’s plea challenging a Delhi Police notice directing her to furnish a personal bond of ₹ 10,000.

Meanwhile, Representing the student leader in court, senior advocate Gopal Sankaranarayanan termed her brief detention and the Delhi Police notice "completely illegal" and informed the court that she was not involved in a separate protest call by the CJP at Connaught Place.
Notably, “She is not involved with the CP Central Park call, and she was dealing with her own call at Mandi House,” the advocate told the high court on Thursday.
As per the latest buzz, A New Delhi district police officer, designated as the Special Executive Magistrate (SEM), had directed Bora to appear before it on Monday and execute the bond.
In further updates, The order was issued on October 17, the day she was rolled out after being detained on Friday.

On top of that, The notice cited three grounds for requiring Bora to execute the bond: alleged sloganeering at Mandi House on October 16; repeated protests in the vicinity of Jantar Mantar despite prohibitory orders under Section 163 of the Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita (BNSS); and the allegation that she instigated people to participate in a protest at Connaught Place on October 16, HT reported earlier.
In her petition filed through advocate Abhik Chimni, Bora shared the notice was prima facie ambiguous, factually incorrect and violative of Articles 19 and 21 of the Constitution.

body: Here's the latest update from the Bollywood world:

New Delhi, Artists deserve dignity and respect, singer Mika Singh shared on Thursday, reiterating that Uttarakhand cabinet minister Subodh Uniyal must apologise to his brother Daler Mehndi for publicly reprimanding him at an event.

Adding to this, Acknowledge your mistake and apologise: Mika to U'Khand minister on Daler Mehndi row On Sunday evening, Mehndi was performing at the Siddhpeeth Maa Kunjapuri Tourism and Development Fair in Uttarakhand's New Tehri town when Uniyal stormed up to the stage and asked him loudly if he was drunk.
Meanwhile, The 59-year-old singer, known for hits such as "Tunak Tunak Tun", "Bolo Ta Ra" and "Ho Jayegi Balle Balle", was heard saying "sorry" in video clips that have since gone widely shared.

Notably, Mika, who has been vocal in his support for his brother since the incident, has demanded an apology from Uniyal and urged Uttarakhand Chief Minister Pushkar Singh Dhami to look into the matter.

title: Ramayana: Part One to get JioHotstar pay-per-view release following theatrical window
body: Here's the latest on what's streaming and coming up:

Directed by Nitesh Tiwari, Ramayana: Part One is scheduled to rollout worldwide in theatres on November 5, including in IMAX 3D. The movie will be rolled out in Hindi, Tamil, Telugu, Kannada, Malayalam and English.

Adding to this, Following its theatrical run, audiences in India will be able to purchase the movie separately on JioHotstar through its dedicated on-demand offering. The platform shared the movie will be available across supported devices and in the highest quality supported by the service.
Meanwhile, Nita M. Ambani, Chairperson, JioStar, shared the partnership would help take the cinematic adaptation of the epic to audiences beyond theatres.

Notably, “Ramayana is one of India’s greatest civilisational treasures - a story that has shaped our conscience, inspired our imagination, and guided the way we live for centuries. As India enters a new era of storytelling, we have an extraordinary opportunity to carry our cultural legacy forward,” she shared.

As per the latest buzz, She added, “At JioHotstar, our vision is to use technology to bring the finest stories within reach of every Indian. It is our privilege to present this grand cinematic vision of Ramayana to families across the country, and introduce a new generation to its eternal values of duty, love, courage, and goodness.”

In further updates, Namit Malhotra, producer, filmmaker and founder and CEO of DNEG, shared the movie was designed to be experienced on a large screen, particularly in IMAX 3D. However, he noted that cinema infrastructure does not provide access to every audience member.

On top of that, “I believe Ramayana should be experienced on the biggest screen possible, in IMAX 3D. But our country’s cinema infrastructure cannot reach everyone who holds this epic close. Ramayana belongs to every Indian, and our ambition must reflect that,” Malhotra shared.

Explaining the decision to partner with JioHotstar, he added, “JioHotstar has time and again shown how technology can bring a nation together through its sports and entertainment offering. That made them a natural partner to take Ramayana into people’s hands and living rooms, after its theatrical run.”

title: EXCLUSIVE: After Obsession, CBFC imposes cuts on another adult Hollywood horror film, Clayface; 24 seconds of nudity, face-smashing scenes censored
body: Here's the latest update from the Bollywood world:

The Central Board of Movie Certification (CBFC) passed Clayface with an 'A' certificate. However, the makers were asked to make certain changes. At two places, visuals of nudity were removed and 'replaced suitably with appropriate shots'. In one scene, a 5-second nude shot was censored, while in another, the CBFC snipped 19 seconds. One of these scenes features Joana Ribeiro, who plays Mia Torrez. To conceal her nudity, the makers have zoomed in on another character.
Adding to this, Similarly, the CBFC asked the makers to 'suitably modify' visuals of a face being smashed in two places. One shot lasts 1 second, while the other is 6 seconds long.

Meanwhile, Moreover, the word 'motherf****r' was 'voluntarily removed' from the subtitles. Lastly, static anti-alcohol and anti-drug messages were added to the bottom-right corner of the screen wherever applicable.

Notably, After these changes were made, the CBFC passed Clayface on October 19. The length of the movie, as mentioned on the censor certificate, is 108.31 minutes. In other words, Clayface is 1 hour, 48 minutes and 31 seconds long.

As per the latest buzz, The censor changes bring back memories of similar modifications made to the 2026 sleeper Hollywood smash hit Obsession. Like Clayface , Obsession was also granted an 'A' certificate, and yet the makers were asked to censor scenes depicting extreme violence and graphic sexual activity, amounting to 38 seconds. This led to an uproar, with many questioning why filmmakers were being forced to remove shots from a movie meant exclusively for adults. It remains to be seen whether the cuts given to Clayface also face a similar backlash.

title: Manoj Joshi on portraying Sardar Vallabhbhai Patel: ‘We wanted to create a play that would become the talk of the country’ | HT Interview
body: Here's the latest update from the Bollywood world:

Veteran Indian star Manoj Joshi , a Padma Shri recipient known for his versatile performances in films, television and theatre, has returned to the stage to portray Sardar Vallabhbhai Patel in Widely shared Rachh’s Sardar: The Architect of United India. In an exclusive interview with HT Lifestyle, the star opened up about the challenges of bringing Patel’s story to the stage, his enduring love for theatre and his journey as an star.

Adding to this, Padma Shri recipient Manoj Joshi returned to theatres with Widely shared Rachh’s iconic play on Sardar Vallabbhai Patel. Presented by Neemtree Entertainment, the production brings this defining chapter of Indian history to life through theatre. The play explores the challenges, negotiations and decisions that defined Patel’s mission to unite the country.

Meanwhile, “This was my dream initially, 10 years back,” shared Manoj Joshi, recalling how the idea of portraying Sardar Vallabhbhai Patel took shape. His friend Geeta Manik spent seven years researching Patel and wrote around three drafts of the play. Their shared vision was to bring Patel’s story and his contribution to the unification of India to the stage in a compelling way.
Notably, View this post on Instagram A post shared by DD News (@ddnews_official)
As per the latest buzz, “We chose not to do just a play. The play should be the talk of the country,” Joshi shared, emphasising the team’s ambition to create a memorable theatrical production.

In further updates, Recalling memorable moments from the play, Manoj Joshi shared, “Every single scene is very important for me.” He highlighted how Patel navigated complex political situations and used strategic thinking to bring princely states, including Hyderabad, Bhopal and Junagadh, into the Indian Union.

On top of that, Speaking about one of his favourite moments, Joshi recalled the final scenes in which Patel instructs his son not to use his name for personal gain, describing it as one of the most memorable parts of the play.

Speaking about the play’s reception across cities such as Mumbai , Bhopal, Pune and Gujarat, Joshi shared one response remained common among audiences: a renewed appreciation for India’s independence and its history. He recalled spectators expressing surprise at learning historical details they had not known before, underlining the play’s role in making Patel’s contribution more accessible to audiences.

title: ‘Protests achieve nothing’: Amit Shah takes dig at Rahul Gandhi, says Congress won't win polls even in ‘30 years’
body: Here's the latest protest news from across India:

Union Home Minister Amit Shah addresses the inauguration and foundation stone laying ceremony of Yamuna revival projects, in New Delhi. (PTI) Speaking at an event in outer Delhi to launch and inaugurate 33 Delhi Jal Board (DJB) projects worth ₹ 8,941 crore rupees, Shah hit out at the Congress and the Aam Aadmi Party (AAP) over their allegations of “vote chori” and discrepancies in the Special Intensive Revision (SIR) of electoral rolls, accusing them of using “political jugglery and mobocracy” to challenge the people’s mandate.

Adding to this, “You cannot use political jugglery and mobocracy to defy the mandate of the people. If you want to win elections, go among the people to understand their problems. These protests and demonstrations will not achieve anything. Implement schemes for people’s welfare wherever you have been elected, otherwise you will be wiped out from the remaining places,” Shah shared.
Meanwhile, Shah accused the opposition of repeatedly questioning electoral outcomes whenever the BJP wins, alleging that the “vote chori” narrative was an excuse to cover up electoral defeats.

Notably, “A new game has begun in Delhi. As BJP governments are being elected, they are making excuses of vote chori. They say the BJP is not coming to power by popular vote but by vote theft. In reality, you want to save the votes of infiltrators by making these allegations of Vote chori,” he shared.

As per the latest buzz, He cited the Congress ’s electoral defeats across states over several decades, arguing that the party had been rejected by voters even before the BJP came to power nationally in 2014. He also pointed to the opposition’s victories in Kerala, Himachal Pradesh and Telangana, arguing that the same electronic voting machines (EVMs) and Election Commission were in place when those parties won.

In further updates, Predicting that the BJP would remain in power for 30 years, Shah shared the opposition’s negative politics would prevent it from returning to government. He urged Congress and AAP to concentrate on improving governance in states where they still hold power.

On top of that, "When I say BJP will be in power for 30 years, they again reiterate allegations of vote theft...I want to tell you that Amit Shah was born here, stays here, and will die here...I don't need to visit foreign countries every six months. I am saying you won't form government for 30 years, based on your negative politics," he shared.

Turning to Delhi’s environmental challenges, Shah blamed successive Congress and AAP governments for allowing sewage and industrial waste to enter the Yamuna. He shared the Centre, Delhi, Haryana and Uttar Pradesh were now working together on a time-bound plan to clean the river.

title: ‘They’re just pictures of Indian flag': Raihan Vadra questions removal of protest photos from Delhi exhibition
body: Here's the latest protest news from across India:

Visual artist Raihan Vadra , son of Congress leader Priyanka Gandhi Vadra, on Thursday questioned the Bikaner House administration's move to remove 70 photographs documenting recent protests in Delhi from his solo exhibition just hours before its scheduled opening.

Adding to this, Artist and Photographer Raihan Vadra, son of Congress leader Priyanka Gandhi Vadra, with one of his photographs at Bikaner House, in New Delhi, Wednesday, Oct. 21, 2026. (PTI) Vadra alleged that Bikaner House officials asked him to remove two photographs of the Indian flag from his exhibition after he had already set aside pictures containing overtly political slogans. He shared officials argued that the context of the Delhi protests made the photographs political and subsequently asked him to remove more images after inspecting the exhibition for a second time.

Meanwhile, "I shared, ‘But they are just pictures of the Indian flag. I do not think there is anything in your policy that says photographs of the Indian flag have to be removed’. At that point, I firmly told them to put their demand in writing if they wanted me to remove the photographs of the Indian flag. They did not send me anything in writing," news agency PTI quoted Raihan Vadra as saying.
Notably, He alleged that officials later removed one flag photograph themselves while he was at home preparing for the exhibition's opening, adding that he had recorded the incident on video.
As per the latest buzz, Criticising the decision, Raihan Vadra shared an art institution should not prohibit political content, arguing that political expression is integral to artistic practice.

In further updates, “I had to tell them that an art institution should not have such a policy. I mean, most art is political, right? You cannot function as an artistic institution and then say that political content is not allowed,” he shared.
On top of that, Vadra also questioned the timing of the decision, claiming he had shared the exhibition layout with the administration on October 15 and received a response.
“You’re telling me just four hours before my show that you couldn’t see the layout. Now, 70 photographs have to be removed. What am I supposed to do?” he shared.

title: Sit-ins, mass cease-work mark 3rd day of protest amid Manipur ethnic violence spike
body: Here's the latest protest news from across India:

Hundreds of protestors on Thursday staged sit-ins amid a day-long mass cease-work call following two days of street protests in Imphal valley districts against the killing of three Meitei farmers three days earlier amid a spike in ethnic violence in Manipur.

Adding to this, Protesters in Imphal East on Wednesday. (ANI) A 45-year-old Kuki man collecting bamboo shoots was killed, and at least six Kuki houses were set ablaze after the three Meiteis were killed in an ambush on Monday. The ambush was the first incident of violence between Meiteis and Kukis after July 13, when armed Kuki groups attacked Meiteis in Bishnupur’s Torbung Bangla. In the last few months, at least 50 people have died in the state, mostly in Naga-Kuki clashes.

Meanwhile, A committee formed in connection with the killing of three Meiteis urged people to observe a day’s mass cease-work and stage sit-ins in their respective localities, offices, educational institutions, and marketplaces. Marketplaces, including Khwairamband Ima, opened around 9.30am before businesses were made to shutter.

Notably, Shutdowns paralysed much of Manipur on Tuesday and Wednesday when at least six protestors were injured as police dispersed a mob when protestors tried to storm a stadium to meet chief minister Yumnam Khemchand.

As per the latest buzz, Protestors blocked the Imphal-Dimapur national highway at Khurai Lamlong junction. An altercation between security forces and protestors in Khurai Lamlong forced police to fire tear gas, mock bombs, and stun grenades to disperse the crowd and clear the highway. The protesters retaliated with slingshots and threw stones instead of clearing the highway.

In further updates, The protesters have refused to take the bodies of the three slain Meiteis until all involved in the killing are held. Meitei protesters on Monday left two bodies in front of the main gate of the Chief Minister’s residence to protest the failure to protect civilians after suspected armed Kuki militants carried out the ambush.
On top of that, Security forces fired tear gas shells to disperse the mob that breached security outside the residence and parked a truck carrying two bodies.
The families of the victims claimed that the attackers belonged to the Kuki community.

title: Manoj Bajpayee reacts to Tiger Shroff firing incident, says “That's really scary”
body: Here's the latest update from the Bollywood world:
The veteran star expresses relief that Tiger escaped unharmed and hopes the ongoing investigation sets an example to deter similar attacks in Mumbai.

Adding to this, Reacting to the incident, Bajpayee shared, “I don't see a gang war, but shots are being fired from who knows where, and that's really scary. Secondly, it's sad what happened to Tiger, but the best and happiest part is that he's safe, and his driver is also recovering slowly. Anyway, we aren't law and order experts or anything. From what I've heard in the news, the investigation is ongoing. The alleged suspects have been brought to Mumbai, and they've been arrested. I just hope the investigation wraps up as soon as possible and that an example is set so that next time, anyone will think twice before doing something like this.”

Meanwhile, The incident took place on the evening of Sunday, October 18, when unidentified assailants allegedly opened fire at Tiger Shroff’s car in Juhu before fleeing on a motorcycle. The star escaped without gunshot injuries, while his driver, Firdous, and a bystander sustained injuries and were taken to Nanavati Hospital for treatment. The driver is as per reports recovering.

Notably, The Mumbai Crime Branch’s Anti-Extortion Cell is leading the investigation. As per the latest buzz, the suspected shooters fled Mumbai through Gujarat and Rajasthan and were intercepted in Kota before being brought back to the city. On October 21, a court remanded three accused to police custody until October 31 as investigators continued questioning them.

As per the latest buzz, The probe has also widened beyond the alleged shooters. The Delhi Police Special Cell has as per reports arrested individuals suspected of being part of an interstate weapons supply network linked to the case. Investigators are examining possible connections to an overseas-based syndicate allegedly affiliated with the Lawrence Bishnoi gang. An online claim of responsibility has also been reported, although the alleged links and motive remain subject to investigation.

In further updates, Meanwhile, reports that the accused may have conducted reconnaissance near other prominent residences have prompted precautionary security measures, including heightened security around Salman Khan’s Galaxy Apartments in Bandra.

On top of that, Tiger Shroff’s team has urged the public and media to avoid speculation while the investigation continues. The authorities are expected to establish the circumstances surrounding the attack and determine whether a wider conspiracy was involved.

title: BJP launches 15-day campaign to counter opposition’s SIR protests in Bihar
body: Here's the latest protest news from across India:

The Bharatiya Janata Party (BJP) on Thursday launched a 15-day campaign, ‘Loktantra Bachao, Bheedtantra Hatao’ (Save Democracy, Remove Mobocracy). The campaign which began on Thursday will continue till November 5. The campaign will feature rallies, press conferences, youth and student dialogues and outreach to civil society groups to defend its position on electoral processes and counter the opposition’s allegations over the Special Intensive Revision (SIR) of electoral rolls and its demand for the resignation of Chief Election Commissioner Gyanesh Kumar, senior party leaders shared on Wednesday.

Adding to this, The campaign will focus on electoral roll accuracy, protection of voting rights, accountability of political parties. (Representative file photo) On Wednesday, BJP state president Sanjay Saraogi and state organisation general secretary Bhikhubhai Dalsania reviewed the campaign strategy with state office-bearers.
Meanwhile, The campaign will focus on electoral roll accuracy, protection of voting rights, accountability of political parties and public confidence in democratic institutions.

Notably, The BJP has accused opposition parties, particularly the Congress and the Communist Party of India (Marxist) CPI(M), of spreading misleading claims about electoral rolls and undermining trust in the electoral process.

As per the latest buzz, The campaign’s outreach will extend to social media, influencer engagement under the theme ‘Ghuspethiya Hatao, Loktantra Bachao’ (Remove infiltrators , save democracy), and the distribution of publications, booklets and other publicity material.

In further updates, Saraogi shared the BJP will reach people across Bihar to strengthen democracy, ensure the integrity of electoral rolls and protect constitutional values. The campaign is intended to present the party’s position on these issues and challenge the opposition’s claims, he shared.

On top of that, The party aims to counter what it calls misleading claims by the opposition and the Cockroach Janta Party (CJP) over the revision exercise, which has triggered protests over the deletion of large numbers of voters’ names from electoral rolls.

“We have been asking the opposition to give us even one name that has been wrongfully deleted from the electoral roll during the SIR. They have not been able to provide one and are unnecessarily trying to mislead people over the SIR,” BJP media in-charge Danish Eqbal shared.

title: Jamia Millia Islamia cancels its 106th Foundation Day celebrations amid protest over students' union
body: Here's the latest protest news from across India:
Jamia Millia Islamia has cancelled its 106th Foundation Day celebrations, citing ongoing protests on campus over the demand to restore the students' union.

Adding to this, The celebration, dubbed ‘Talimi Mela’, was scheduled from October 29 to November 1 at the campus in New Delhi to showcase the university’s cultural and educational heritage. (Hindustan Times File) The celebration, dubbed ‘Talimi Mela’, was scheduled from October 29 to November 1 at the campus in New Delhi to showcase the university’s cultural and educational heritage.

Meanwhile, “The protesting students have not yet agreed to the proposed resolution, and normalcy has not yet been restored on campus. In view of this, and keeping the safety and well-being of our students, guests and participants foremost in mind, it has been decided with deep regret to cancel Talimi Mela 2026, scheduled from 29 October to 1 November 2026,” JMI’s Dean of Students’ Welfare shared this in an internal communication dated October 21, addressed to heads of departments and deans.

Notably, The protest demanding the restoration of the Jamia Millia Islamia Students’ Union, which was dissolved in 2006, entered its 10th day on October 22, following the start of an indefinite hunger strike by five students—Ebin Basil, Mohd Jasim Khan, Rehan Haider, Rehan Pawar and Faizan Ali Khan—on October 12.
As per the latest buzz, Since then, a series of demonstrations has been held on the JMI campus.

In further updates, Over the past ten days, JMI has taken several measures in response to the ongoing campus agitation. The university shut down the Dr Zakir Husain Library and the Old Library for a day, citing security concerns. It initially constituted a high-level committee to engage with the protesting students and address their concerns.

On top of that, On October 21, the university also revealed the formation of a five-member committee to draft a constitution for the students’ union, which has been suspended since 2006 amid growing demands for its restoration. Additionally, JMI had suspended three students in connection with the agitation.
However, in a notification issued on October 21, the university shared it would review disciplinary action taken against students involved in protests between October 12 and 21.

title: AR Rahman reveals fan's email from 2014 that predicted he would create music for Ramayana
body: Here's the latest update from the Bollywood world:

Music maestro AR Rahman ’s association with Ramayana comes with an unusual backstory. At the movie’s album launch event in Chennai on October 21 by Amazon Music, the composer recalled receiving an email more than a decade ago from a man who claimed to have dreamt about Rahman creating music for the epic. Today, with the composer working on the soon-to-release adaptation alongside Hans Zimmer , that old message has taken on a new meaning.

Adding to this, AR Rahman reveals 2014 email predicted his Ramayana journey at the music launch in Chennai. What AR Rahman shared Remembering the incident, AR Rahman told the audience that a man named Sathish had contacted him in 2014 with details of his dream. “There is something I wanted to share. In 2014, a gentleman called Sathish manifested that I would be composing the music for Ramayana,” he shared before reading out the message.

Meanwhile, The email read: “You appeared in my dream early in the morning. I believe it will come true. You were doing musical shows throughout India and the world, presenting the great epic Ramayana.”

Notably, Rahman is now part of Ramayana: Rise of a Legend, a two-part live-action adaptation of Valmiki’s epic. He is composing the music with Hans Zimmer, the Oscar-winning musician known for his work on major Hollywood productions.

As per the latest buzz, Yash, who plays Ravana in the movie, was also present at the Chennai event. The star spoke about his admiration for Rahman and shared how the composer’s music helped him connect with Tamil. “All of us are huge followers of AR Rahman sir. I learnt Tamil because of his songs. I used to dance to songs from Gentleman. Your contribution to the Tamil industry is massive,” Yash shared.

In further updates, He went on to explain why Rahman’s music holds a special place for him. “If I hear Tamil songs in Hindi, I feel something is missing. I am happy that you are composing the music for Ramayana and that I am able to perform to it," the star added.

On top of that, The star also expressed his happiness at being able to perform in a movie featuring the composer’s work. “When I played Ravana, a lot of people shared why do you want to play ravana, because at the end of the day it’s the most hated, we all know. But what I can say is we all are playing a role. And everywhere there are different energies. And this song gave me that energy and I think while playing Ravana I heard Shiva song, and Thank you sir (thanking AR Rahman), you have given me a wonderful song, I used to listen to a lot of Shiva songs, now I listen to this Shiva Tandava and I think I can take energy,” he shared.
Directed by Nitesh Tiwari and written by Shridhar Raghavan, Ramayana: Rise of the Legend is being produced by Prime Focus Studios, visual effects company DNEG and Yash’s Monster Mind Creations.

title: BJP accuses Annamalai of 'double standards' on SIR as he slams response to CJP protests
body: Here's the latest protest news from across India:

After former Bharatiya Janata Party (BJP) leader K Annamalai launched a tirade against the Centre over the crackdown on protests against the ongoing Special Intensive Revision, the party hit back at him for switching his earlier stance on the SIR. Annamalai, who criticized the government and police response to protests and the detention of Cockroach Janta Party (CJP) activists, was accused of double standards as BJP claimed he had earlier defended the electoral roll revision exercise.

Adding to this, Former BJP leader and We The Leaders Foundation Chief Mentor K Annamalai holds the Indian national flag. (@annamalai_k X) Annamalai's criticism of the BJP-led government came months after he left the party in June this year. In an X post on Wednesday, the former Tamil Nadu BJP president alleged that those raising their voice against the government could be "jailed indefinitely" or "labelled anti-nationals or foreign agents". His remarks followed the arrest of CJP leaders Saurav Das and Ashutosh Ranka , who were rolled out on Wednesday after seven days in custody. Annamalai further shared that while he did not approve of the tactics used by CJP, he was "completely" in support of the questions they want to raise in regards to the electoral process.

Meanwhile, He was met with a sharp response from Tamil Nadu spokesperson Narayanan Thirupathy, who accused Annamalai of double standards on the issue of SIR. Thirupathy also condemned Annamalai's questions against Delhi Police, saying he should understand the demands of maintaining law and order as a former IPS officer. Defending police action, the BJP leader shared, "Annamalai's questions deliberately blur the line between peaceful protest and deliberate law-breaking."

Notably, Annamalai, who was an IPS officer before he joined politics, has backed the citizens' right to protest and question the government. "In 2011, the then Chief Minister of Gujarat, Narendra Modi, shared that if his hands had not been tied, he would have gone to Delhi and waged a war against the Central government. In my opinion, what the Hon PM shared then was absolutely right, and there is nothing wrong about it".

As per the latest buzz, Referring to Das and Ranka's arrest after they trespassed into the Jantar Mantar area despite the place being de-notified as a site of protest, Annamalai shared, "Today, you could be jailed indefinitely; your surety bonds could be rejected; and, surprisingly, a Special Executive Magistrate will play circles around you when he/ she is empowered to deal with preventive bond cases."

In further updates, "If you question the violation of due process of law in a democracy, you would be called names, and a barrage of attacks would follow, including being labelled a Foreign Agent," Annamalai shared in his post.

On top of that, Clarifying that he does not agree with CJP's tactics, Annamalai backed their right to protest. "I might not agree with the tactics of the CJP, and I think many of theirs are misguided. But if you ask me whether they have a right to oppose/argue/protest on an issue that they think is important, I would categorically say - YES," he shared.
"So, I would like people to ask the questions again, even if it makes some of them uncomfortable, and I wish the Central Government would answer them instead of resorting to whataboutism," he argued.

title: Manipur violence: Protesters’ bid to storm CM's event foiled as tensions escalate
body: Here's the latest protest news from across India:

A bandh called against the killing of a 45-year-old Kuki man the day before paralysed Kangpokpi district on Wednesday amid a spike in ethnic violence in Manipur . It coincided with the second and last day of a shutdown in Imphal Valley against the killing of three Meiteis in an ambush in Imphal East on Monday.

Adding to this, A security person stands near a barricade during a 48-hour statewide shutdown called by the Native People's Committee Manipur (NPCM) to protest the killing of three civilians and demand action against those responsible for the attack, at Lamlong in Imphal East. (ANI/ Representational) Meanwhile, a protest against the killings in Imphal turned violent on Wednesday, with protesters attempting to storm the Khuman Lampak Indoor Stadium in Imphal West, where chief minister Yumnam Khemchand Singh and home minister Govindas Konthoujam were attending the inaugural function of the first Manipur State Poomsae Taekwondo Championship, with delegates from South Korea also present, officials shared.

Meanwhile, The protesters demanded that the CM and home minister address the prevailing law and order situation instead of attending a sports event while civilians were being killed. Security forces fired several rounds of tear gas shells to disperse the mob, injuring at least three protesters. The injured were taken to a nearby hospital, officials shared.

Notably, Later, protesters gathered at Khurai Lamlong in Imphal East and made another attempt to press their demands. Police used several rounds of tear gas shells, smoke grenades and stun bombs to disperse them. Two people sustained injuries, including a woman as per reports hit by a stun grenade on her right foot, shared police. The injured were taken to a nearby hospital, and tension remained in the area, officers requesting anonymity shared.

As per the latest buzz, Militants ambushed 14 Meitei men collecting firewood in the Sunurok hills of Kangpokpi district on October 19, killing three of them. The families of the victims alleged that the attackers belonged to the Kuki community.

In further updates, Additional director general of police Lhari Dorjee Lhatoo shared three people had been arrested in connection with the ambush. Two of them admitted to being part of the group that killed the three men, he shared. “The role of the third arrested man in this heinous crime is being probed, and the investigation is on to identify the others who are involved in the case.”

On top of that, The Joint Action Committee (JAC), formed after the killings, shared the bodies would not be accepted until the government booked all those involved. It revealed a one-day cease-work protest on Thursday, with sit-ins at respective locations, and appealed to schools, colleges and other institutions to support the protest.

On Monday, protesters had left two bodies at the main gate of the chief minister’s residence to protest the failure to protect civilians. Security forces fired tear gas shells after the mob breached security and parked a truck carrying the bodies outside the residence.

Meanwhile, It asked citizens to check official channels for updates on possible disruptions to transport services across French cities. “In case of any emergency, Indian nationals can contact: Embassy of India, Paris: +33 6 48 34 00 63 | cons.paris@mea.gov.in,” it shared.

As per the latest buzz, “Indian nationals are advised to exercise caution, avoid crowded areas and locations where protests are taking place, and follow local news about such events,” the advisory rolled out on Monday shared.

In further updates, France has of late seen some of its worst unrest in years. Protests over the rising cost of living, declining public services and concerns about education turned violent, with looting, arson and clashes with police reported in Paris, Marseille and Lyon, among other cities.

On top of that, High school students have raised concerns over a lack of funding for schools, poor facilities and staff shortages, especially in lower-income neighbourhoods. Some have also complained that school days, which often run from 8 a.m. to 6 p.m., are exhausting. They have also questioned the complexity and fairness of the university admissions system.
France has seen two consecutive nights of calm since the unrest over the weekend. Curfews remain in force in parts of several major cities, including limited areas of Paris.

title: National Award-winning VFX expert Arun Kumar says criticism around Ramayana, Jailer 2 visuals based on growing confusion on CGI vs AI | HT Exclusive
body: Here's the latest update from the Bollywood world:

It has been 30 years since CB Arun Kumar began working in animation and visual effects (VFX), a time when computer-generated imagery (CGI) and artificial intelligence (AI) were jargon rather than in common use. The filmmaker who won a National Award for his animation work says the criticism of the visuals of films such as Ramayana , Jailer 2, and Dada reflects growing confusion among audiences.

Adding to this, The makers of Ramayana, Jailer 2 and Dada have been accused of using AI for their promotional material. “When I started in the industry in the 1980s, exposure to visual material was highly limited,” Arun exclusively tells Hindustan Times, adding, “The real problem now is whether AI is making content more engaging, and I fear not.” The dean of communications, movie and gaming at Pearl Academy talks to me about changes in the visual field over the last three decades and why promotional material for big-ticket films has increasingly made audiences sceptical.

Meanwhile, Arun says that when he began his career, there was only one TV channel, and movies had to be seen in cinemas or on private screens. “Movie and TV criticism was limited to a handful of people with access to newspapers, magazines and other platforms. And they shaped our perceptions,” he explains, adding, “Soon there were TV channels, VHS tapes, VCDs and DVDs. In the 2000s, online movie piracy became common. Every citizen had unprecedented access to content, and everyone was a critic.”

Notably, Since then, he says that there has been a tsunami of change that transformed the world. “The widespread use of AI in the last three years is just the tip of the iceberg. Everyone now does deep research on everything, frame by frame, becoming both critic and creator. Which is why we are now seeing the so-called nitpicking of every frame,” adds Arun. He also says the audience doesn’t realise that the marketing team, when putting out trailers and other promotional materials, often uses AI to enhance elements the movie might not even include.

As per the latest buzz, When Arun says this, I refer to the recent accusations that the makers of films such as Ramayana, Jailer 2, and Dada used AI in their promotional videos and posters. “The controversies around these films reflect a growing confusion among audiences about how contemporary digital imagery is actually created,” he says, adding, “What we need to understand is that CGI, VFX compositing and generative AI are not interchangeable terms. A visual anomaly, an unrealistic-looking image, or even a hyper-real look is not necessarily evidence of AI.”

In further updates, He also explains that the actual use of AI doesn’t make anything inferior. “The sad truth is that saying, that’s AI, is becoming a convenient label for anything we don’t like visually. It’s unfair to both traditional VFX artists and filmmakers exploring AI as a creative medium. The filmmakers need to be far more transparent about their creative processes. Showing audiences the behind-the-scenes efforts will help build appreciation and trust in the final product,” he adds. In fact, Arun says the audience's mistrust is so high that even Christopher Nolan has to go the extra mile to prove his work is entirely real, without the use of VFX, in films like Odyssey.
On top of that, View this post on Instagram A post shared by RajKummar Rao (@rajkummar_rao)

“AI is copying the digital look, and creators are using existing VFX classics to train their AI video models. It’s becoming harder for the lay audience to distinguish genuine VFX shots from pure AI shots. This is going to get worse as AI takes over the next couple of years. Everything will then look like AI, because it can imitate anything that has already been done by humans,” he rounds off with a warning.

title: Ranbir Kapoor apologises for saying ‘goodness perishes’ in his Dussehra speech in Kolkata; quotes Rockstar song during Ramayana promotions in Chennai
body: Here's the latest update from the Bollywood world:

Bollywood star Ranbir Kapoor has apologised for getting his words mixed up during a Dussehra celebration in Kolkata while promoting Ramayana : Rise of a Legend. A video of the speech made its way to social media, drawing attention after the star accidentally shared that goodness and honesty perish instead of triumphing over evil.

Adding to this, Ranbir Kapoor apologises for Dussehra speech mistake as widely shared Ramayana event clip sparks reactions online. (PTI) Ranbir Kapoor apologises Ranbir addressed the moment at a promotional event in Chennai on Wednesday event at the song launch, admitting that he had made a mistake and explaining what he had intended to say. “I would like to actually take this opportunity to apologize about an incident that happened yesterday. I was at the Dussehra event and I had a slip of tongue, like a slip of a tongue, they say,” the star told the audience.
Meanwhile, He then clarified his message about the festival and the victory of good over evil in Hindi, “No matter how powerful evil may be, in the end, goodness and truth will prevail.”

Notably, Ranbir also brought up his work with A.R. Rahman on Rockstar while explaining how words do not always come out the way one intends. Referring to the movie’s song, he shared, “So, this reminds me of a collaboration that I had with A.R. Rahman sir and Rockstar—what I want to say is, ‘Jo bhi main kehna chahun, barbaad kare alfaaz mere’. So, I truly apologise for that.”

As per the latest buzz, The Ramayana team was in Kolkata on October 20 for a Dussehra celebration in Salt Lake City. Ranbir and his co-star Yash attended the event alongside West Bengal Chief Minister Suvendu Adhikari. Ranbir opened his speech with “Jai Shri Ram” before thanking the people present and expressing his happiness at being part of the festivities: “My greetings. It gives me great pleasure, and it's an honour to celebrate Dussehra with all of you in the holy land of Kolkata. I thank the CM and every present here from my heart.”

In further updates, The speech took an awkward turn when the star spoke about the message of Dussehra. He shared, “Dussehra reminds us of something beautiful. That no matter how strong evil is, at the end, it is goodness and honesty that perishes,” reversing the meaning of what he wanted to convey. Those sharing the stage with him appeared to exchange glances and clap as he carried on with his address. Ranbir went on to urge people to spread love, choose happiness and follow the right path before wishing everyone a happy Dussehra on behalf of the Ramayana team.

On top of that, The Kolkata event also brought an announcement from Suvendu Adhikari, who shared Ramayana would be made tax-free in West Bengal. The chief minister spoke about the state’s decision while addressing the movie’s team and the media.

In conversation with ANI, he shared, “The Ramayana movie has been made tax-free. title: HT Exclusive: Ranbir Kapoor, Yash's Ramayana to stream on JioHotstar through pay-per-view model after theatrical release on Diwali
body: Here's the latest on what's streaming and coming up:

Namit Malhotra’s Ramayana : Rise of the Legend is set to reach audiences beyond cinema halls, with JioHotstar and Prime Focus Studios announcing a partnership to bring the movie to Indian homes after its theatrical run. Instead of arriving as part of a regular streaming subscription, the movie will be available through a pay-per-view option, allowing viewers to purchase access separately.

Adding to this, Ramayana: Part One to stream on JioHotstar after theatrical rollout through pay-per-view model. Nita Ambani says Ramayana will reach families across India The movie is scheduled to rollout worldwide in theatres on November 5, 2026, coinciding with Diwali, and will also be screened in IMAX 3D. Hindustan Times has exclusively learnt that once the movie's theatrical window ends, viewers in India will be able to watch it on JioHotstar through a dedicated on-demand purchase option. The partnership is aimed at reaching audiences who may not have access to the movie in cinemas, while offering the best possible viewing quality supported by their devices.

Meanwhile, Nita M. Ambani, chairperson of JioStar, shared the collaboration was an opportunity to bring the story and values of the Ramayana to a wider audience, including a new generation of viewers. She shared, “Ramayana is one of India’s greatest civilisational treasures - a story that has shaped our conscience, inspired our imagination, and guided the way we live for centuries. As India enters a new era of storytelling, we have an extraordinary opportunity to carry our cultural legacy forward. At JioHotstar, our vision is to use technology to bring the finest stories within reach of every Indian. It is our privilege to present this grand cinematic vision of Ramayana to families across the country, and introduce a new generation to its eternal values of duty, love, courage, and goodness.”

Notably, Namit Malhotra shared the team wanted audiences to experience the movie on the biggest screen possible, particularly in IMAX 3D. However, he pointed out that not everyone in India has access to the necessary cinema infrastructure, making the digital rollout an important part of the movie’s wider reach.

As per the latest buzz, “I believe Ramayana should be experienced on the biggest screen possible, in IMAX 3D. But our country’s cinema infrastructure cannot reach everyone who holds this epic close. Ramayana belongs to every Indian, and our ambition must reflect that. JioHotstar has time and again shown how technology can bring a nation together through its sports and entertainment offering. That made them a natural partner to take Ramayana into people’s hands and living rooms, after its theatrical run," he added.

In further updates, Ramayana: Rise of the Legend is being made as a two-part live-action movie series directed by Nitesh Tiwari, with Shridhar Raghavan adapting Valmiki’s epic for the screen. Prime Focus Studios is producing the project alongside DNEG, the eight-time Academy Award-winning production and visual effects studio, and Yash’s Monster Mind Creations.

On top of that, The movie has brought together an international team for its music, visuals and action sequences. Academy Award-winning composers Hans Zimmer and A. R. Rahman are working on the music, while Ravi Bansal and Ramsey Avery are responsible for production design. Terry Notary and Guy Norris are handling the action, with the production planned for IMAX and other premium cinema formats.

Ranbir Kapoor plays Lord Rama, with Sai Pallavi as Sita, Yash as Ravana, Sunny Deol as Hanuman and Ravie Dubey as Lakshman. The supporting cast includes Arun Govil, Lara Dutta, Rakul Preet Singh, Vivek Oberoi, Kunal Kapoor and Kajal Aggarwal, among others.

title: No Jantar Mantar protest call until it remains de-notified: CJP's Saurav Das, Ashutosh Ranka to court
body: Here's the latest protest news from across India:

A Special Executive Magistrate on Wednesday ordered the rollout of Cockroach Janata Party (CJP) co-convenors Saurav Das and Ashutosh Ranka from judicial custody after they undertook in writing not to call for protests at Jantar Mantar until the site is notified as a designated protest venue in accordance with law.

Adding to this, Saurav Das and Ashutosh Ranka were rolled out after 7 days custody by a SEM court on Oct 21. (PTI/X/@Ratnasingh) In their written undertakings furnished before ACP Ritu Raj, who is functioning as the SEM of New Delhi district, the two leaders also promised “not to commit any breach of peace” and expressed faith in the judiciary and the SEM court.

Meanwhile, Their undertakings shared, “That we reiterate our undertaking and commitment towards peace, law and order, public tranquility and further we specifically state that we will not make any calls for protest at Jantar Mantar till such a time that it is de-notified in accordance with law”.
Notably, The undertakings further reiterated that any protest undertaken by them would be done “within the four corners of the constitution”.
As per the latest buzz, The court thereby, accepted the undertakings and ordered their rollout on furnishing personal bonds and surety bonds of ₹ 50,000 each.

In further updates, “The immediate measures contemplated under Section 135(3) BNSS for the prevention of a breach of the peace or disturbance of public tranquillity can, in the present circumstances, be adequately secured by the execution of a bond for keeping the peace, supported by the written undertakings now given today in the Court,” the magistrate shared, holding that further incarceration was no longer warranted.

On top of that, The rollout came two days after the SEM extended their judicial custody , observing that the leaders showed “no respect for law”. The court had also questioned the adequacy of their earlier sureties, observing that they had “no control over the respondents”.
During Wednesday’s proceedings, the investigating officer sought a fresh three-day extension of their judicial custody, arguing that “the threat to law and order persisted”.

title: Viraj Ghelani and Arjun Tanwar starrer Party Animals trailer out ahead of November 20 release
body: Here's the latest update from the Bollywood world:

Set on New Year’s Eve, the trailer follows a group of friends whose reunion quickly turns into an unpredictable series of events. Featuring cops, goons, a party bus, romantic complications, petty fights and even a drunk horse, the movie builds its comedy around a string of mishaps. Every attempt by the characters to resolve one problem only leads to another, setting the stage for a night filled with confusion and questionable decisions.

Adding to this, The trailer has also generated conversations online, with viewers reacting to its unconventional humour and chaotic storytelling. One user quipped, “This looks like the group chat got a production budget,” while another exclaimed, “I don’t know what I just watched, but I need the full story immediately.” Drawing from internet culture, Party Animals appears to embrace the absurdity of its situations, using the characters’ misadventures as the basis for its comedy.
Meanwhile, A post shared by Yoodlee Films (@yoodleefilms)

Notably, Beyond the humour, the movie explores contemporary friendships, the fear of missing out (FOMO), the confusion of growing up and the confidence with which a seemingly bad idea can turn into an elaborate plan late at night. Bringing the format of Hollywood ensemble comedies into an Indian setting, the movie centres on one night that takes increasingly unexpected turns.

As per the latest buzz, Speaking about the movie, Viraj Ghelani says, “Party Animals is the kind of madness that’s hard to explain but a whole lot of fun to experience, especially with your gang of friends. From the music and the madness to the moments of pure unfiltered masti, the movie celebrates that crazy energy, unbreakable bhaichara and collective bad decisions that make for the best stories. I had a blast being part of this chaos, and I can’t wait for audiences to experience it together on the big screen.”

In further updates, Siddharth Anand Kumar, Senior Vice President, Saregama India Ltd., adds, “With Party Animals, we wanted to create a comedy that embraces its own madness and doesn’t take itself too seriously. It’s bold, irreverent and best enjoyed with your gang, where every terrible decision becomes a story worth telling.”

On top of that, Directed by Ravi Chhabriya and produced by Vikram Mehra and Siddharth Anand Kumar under the banner of Yoodlee Films, Party Animals features Viraj Ghelani as Mann Patel and Arjun Tanwar as Armaan Khanna. The ensemble cast also includes Pragati Nagpal, Naqiyah Haji, Alam Khan, Saqib Ayub, Kamlesh Sawant, Anil Charanjeett, Aaron Koul, Vijay Patkar and Manoj Joshi. The movie is written by Ali Haji, Khush Mullick and Veer Panchal.

With its focus on friendship, impulsive choices and escalating chaos, Party Animals brings a group of friends together for a night that promises to be anything but predictable. The movie releases in cinemas on November 20, 2026.

title: Security beefed up outside Salman Khan’s Galaxy Apartment after Tiger Shroff firing incident
body: Here's the latest update from the Bollywood world:

The development comes days after three motorcycle-borne assailants opened fire at Tiger Shroff’s car in Mumbai’s Juhu area on October 18. Tiger escaped unharmed, while his driver and a passerby were injured in the incident. Seven rounds were as per reports fired at the star’s vehicle.
Adding to this, (Full video available on PTI Videos - https://t.co/d8jp61yd2p) https://t.co/FukCn4pd5w

According to these reports, the alleged attackers considered Salman their initial target but abandoned the plan after finding the security around his residence difficult to breach.

As per the latest buzz, Following these reported revelations, additional police personnel and vehicles have been deployed around Galaxy Apartments. Reports have also mentioned armed personnel and officers wearing bulletproof jackets outside the residence.

title: The biggest competitor for King is not another superstar or another film. It is Shah Rukh Khan's own box-office history
body: Here's the latest update from the Bollywood world:

The excitement surrounding King is understandable. The movie reunites Shah Rukh Khan with his Pathaan director, promises high-octane action and features an ensemble cast including Deepika Padukone, Suhana Khan and Abhishek Bachchan. However, beneath all the anticipation lies an interesting question: Has Shah Rukh Khan raised the bar so extraordinarily high that even a hugely successful movie might now be considered a disappointment?

Adding to this, Before Pathaan and Jawan , a worldwide collection of Rs. 300-400 crores was considered an impressive achievement for many Bollywood films. But Shah Rukh Khan changed the conversation by delivering two consecutive Rs. 1,000 crore rupees blockbusters, and in doing so, possibly created an unusually high benchmark for himself.

Meanwhile, Today, the discussion around King isn't merely about whether it will succeed. Followers and trade observers are already speculating about whether it can cross Rs. 1,000 crores, surpass Pathaan or even challenge Jawan . Imagine a scenario where King collects Rs. 600-700 crores worldwide. Such numbers would be extraordinary for most Hindi films, yet there is a possibility that sections of the industry and social media would term the performance underwhelming simply because Shah Rukh Khan has delivered bigger hits in the past.

Notably, Adding to the expectations is the movie's reported scale. In July, Bollywood Hungama reported that King was being mounted on a production budget of approximately Rs. 450 crores, excluding publicity expenses and Shah Rukh Khan's remuneration. Siddharth Anand subsequently disputed the circulating budget reports, and hence, the actual cost remains unconfirmed. Nevertheless, the movie is being positioned as an ambitious action spectacle, and its commercial performance will naturally attract considerable attention.

As per the latest buzz, Its December 24 rollout also comes with challenges. The Christmas and New Year holidays provide an excellent opportunity for a huge opening, but December 2026 is packed with major releases, including Hollywood spectacles like Avengers: Doomsday and Dune: Part Three . Competition for screens and premium formats could affect King , particularly if the movie hopes to enjoy the kind of extended theatrical run that helped Pathaan and Jawan achieve their historic numbers.

In further updates, Shah Rukh Khan's prolonged absence from cinemas could work in his favour, as audiences haven't seen him in a leading theatrical role since Dunki (2023). However, there is an important difference between his return with Pathaan and his soon-to-release rollout.

On top of that, Pathaan marked his comeback after a difficult phase at the ticket-window, and audiences were eager to see whether he could reclaim his position. With King , there is no such question about his stardom. Instead, audiences are expecting another spectacular entertainer, complete with memorable dialogues, breathtaking action and larger-than-life moments.

The reunion with Siddharth Anand adds to these expectations. Having delivered a historic smash hit together, the two will inevitably face comparisons with Pathaan . The challenge for King will be to offer something fresh rather than merely recreate the formula that worked so brilliantly in 2023.

title: EXCLUSIVE: CBFC censors shot of blood on the Indian map in Udta Teer
body: Here's the latest update from the Bollywood world:

Udta Teer was passed with a U/A 13+ certificate. However, the makers had to make just one major cut. The shot showing blood on the Indian map was asked to be removed. To cover up the cut, the CBFC asked the makers to extend the preceding shot.

Adding to this, Secondly, the makers were asked to add the anti-smoking disclaimer, 'Smoking Kills', in five scenes. An anti-liquor disclaimer was asked to be added in a scene of alcohol consumption. Thankfully, no changes were made in the dialogues or in action scenes.

Meanwhile, Once these changes were made, Udta Teer was passed by the Central Board of Movie Certification (CBFC). The length of the movie, as mentioned on the censor certificate, is 137.41 minutes. In other words, Udta Teer is 2 hours, 17 minutes and 41 seconds.

Notably, Udta Teer stars Ayushmann Khurrana, Sara Ali Khan, the late Mukul Dev and several others. Written and directed by Akash A Kaushik, the movie is produced by Karan Johar, Adar Poonawalla and Apoorva Mehta's Dharma Productions, along with Guneet Monga Kapoor and Achin Jain's Sikhya Entertainment.

As per the latest buzz, The movie tells the story of a Pakistani spy who infiltrates India but ends up losing his memory. In an unexpected turn of events, he begins believing that he is a hardcore Indian patriot, leading to chaos and madness.
