title: Were Salman Khan, Aamir Khan and Akshay Kumar on the target list? Police official CLARIFIES after Tiger Shroff firing incident
body: Here's the latest update from the Bollywood world:

Speaking about the arrests, Praveen Tripathi, Deputy Commissioner of Police (Special Cell), shared the four accused were allegedly involved in the weapon supply network linked to the case. He explained that their role was limited to procuring firearms, transporting them to Mumbai and delivering them to the intended recipients.

Adding to this, When asked whether any other star had been targeted, Tripathi told ANI, “Nothing of that sort emerged during our interrogation, as these individuals were merely part of the weapon supply network. Their knowledge was limited strictly to where to procure the weapons and where to deliver them...”

Meanwhile, His statement does not confirm that Aamir Khan, Akshay Kumar or Salman Khan were on the target list. It specifically addresses what investigators learnt from the four people questioned in connection with the alleged supply of weapons.

Notably, Reports citing investigation sources have claimed that Salman Khan was initially targeted, but the alleged plan was reconsidered after the accused conducted a recce of his Galaxy Apartments residence and found the security arrangements difficult to overcome. According to these reports, Tiger Shroff was subsequently identified as a comparatively easier target.

As per the latest buzz, Other reports have also claimed that the accused moved around Mumbai posing as ordinary visitors and surveyed locations associated with several Bollywood celebrities, including Amitabh Bachchan, Aamir Khan and Akshay Kumar. These claims have been attributed to investigation sources and should not be treated as verified by Tripathi’s statement.

In further updates, The police official’s remarks are significant because they distinguish the alleged role of the four arrested individuals from the wider investigation into the attack. His statement does not establish whether the alleged target list included other celebrities, nor does it independently confirm the reported reconnaissance at their residences.

On top of that, According to Tripathi, a special team arrested four people: two women, Radha and Babita, and two men, Kunal and Sumit. He shared Kunal, who had of late been rolled out from jail in connection with another case, allegedly travelled to Amritsar with Sumit to collect weapons on the instructions of Anil Pandit.

Tripathi alleged that Kunal subsequently used Radha and Babita to transport the weapons to Mumbai. The women allegedly delivered them to a minor near a railway station. He added that Kunal was in contact with Pandit through encrypted communication and had previously carried out a shooting incident in Panipat at his behest.

title: Ranbir Kapoor makes gaffe in his good vs evil speech while promoting Ramayana in Kolkata on Dussehra
body: Here's the latest update from the Bollywood world:

On Tuesday, for Dussehra, the Ramayana team was in Kolkata to promote the movie and attend an event in Salt Lake City with West Bengal Chief Minister Suvendu Adhikari. The lead stars, Ranbir Kapoor and Yash, were present at the event on October 20. Ranbir spoke about the victory of good vs evil in his speech, but he made a gaffe, clips of which are now circulating on social media.

Adding to this, Ranbir spoke in Hindi and began his speech with ‘Jai Shri Ram’ in Kolkata. “My greetings. It gives me great pleasure, and it’s an honour to celebrate Dussehra with all of you in the holy land of Kolkata. I thank the CM and every present here from my heart,” he shared, with those present on stage clapping.

Meanwhile, He then made the mix-up and shared, “Dussehra reminds us of something beautiful. That no matter how strong evil is, at the end, it is goodness and honesty that perishes,” while he meant to say that good will always be victorious over evil. Those present on stage looked at each other and awkwardly clapped as Ranbir added, “So, spread love and happiness. And always try to walk a righteous path. I wish you all a happy Dussehra from the team of Ramayana.”
Notably, Clips of Ranbir’s speech are now circulating widely on social media, with people reacting in varied ways.

As per the latest buzz, At the event, WB CM Suvendu Adhikari opened up that Ramayana has been made tax-free in the state. Announcing the tax exemption, he shared that Ramayana would join other films that have received tax-free status in the state. He also spoke about the possibility of films based on other Indian epics and mythological figures.

In further updates, “The Ramayana movie has been made tax-free. The Kerala Story, The Kashmir Files and The Bengal Files, all of these will be or have been made tax-free, and the same will apply to Ramayana. In the days to come, we will see films on Shri Krishna and Arjuna, as well as the Mahabharata,” the CM told ANI.

On top of that, Ramayana is directed by Nitesh Tiwari and produced by Namit Malhotra and Yash . It stars Ranbir as Ram, Sai Pallavi as Sita, Yash as Ravana, Ravi Dubey as Lakshmana, Sunny Deol as Hanuman, Lara Dutta as Kaikeyi, Rakul Preet Singh as Shurpanaka, Kajal Aggarwal as Mandodari, and others in key roles. The first part is hitting screens on November 5 for Diwali, while the second will be rolled out in 2027.

title: Amitabh Bachchan advised strict rest, apologises to fans as health update from 84-year-old actor sparks concern
body: Here's the latest update from the Bollywood world:

Megastar Amitabh Bachchan has told followers he will take a break from his usual social media updates after being advised to rest and recover. The 84-year-old star shared the news on Wednesday, apologising to his followers for being unable to write as regularly as he usually does. He did not reveal what prompted the medical advice, leaving followers hoping that he recovers soon.

Adding to this, Amitabh Bachchan advised strict rest, leaves followers concerned with messages about his health. (AFP) What Amitabh Bachchan wrote on X Taking to X, formerly Twitter, Amitabh revealed the doctor's advice and wrote in Hindi, "Apologies. I seek forgiveness. I have been advised to take a few days off to rest and recover, so I am unable to write anything at the moment."

Meanwhile, The message followed a similar update on his personal blog a day earlier. While extending his Dussehra wishes, the star shared he had been given strict instructions to focus on his recovery and avoid communication for the time being.

Notably, "First Dussehra greetings to all .. love happiness, fulfilment, prayers. Under very strict rest and recuperation .. so am not allowed to communicate .. do excuse .. my apologies," he wrote. He also added, “But do take this as my respected response .. more hopefully later.”

As per the latest buzz, Amitabh's message comes as the police investigate the firing incident involving Tiger Shroff's car. Reports about the case suggest that the suspects had allegedly surveyed other prominent personalities before deciding on their target. According to several reports, the accused had considered the residences of Amitabh Bachchan, Akshay Kumar and Aamir Khan. However, they as per reports dropped the idea after assessing the security arrangements around the actors' homes.

In further updates, The police are also looking into allegations that the suspects sent photographs and videos of the locations they had surveyed to gangster Anil Pandit, who is believed to have links to the Lawrence Bishnoi gang. They allegedly sought guidance on how to proceed. The investigation into the incident is ongoing.

On top of that, Amitabh Bachchan remains active on the professional front, with several projects keeping him in the public eye. He was last seen in the Tamil movie Vettaiyan, directed by TJ Gnanavel, alongside Rajinikanth.

He is also set to return in the sequel to Nag Ashwin's science-fiction movie Kalki 2898 AD , which stars Prabhas and Kamal Haasan. On television, the star continues to host the 18th season of Kaun Banega Crorepati , the long-running quiz show closely associated with him.

title: ‘I am telling you he was part of the problem’: Palash Sen says Salman Khan also took part in paid negative PR in Bollywood
body: Here's the latest update from the Bollywood world:

During a Bigg Boss 20 Weekend Ka Vaar episode, Salman Khan criticised trolls for making harsh comments about actors when their films fail at the ticket-window. He also spoke about allegations that some actors pay for negative PR campaigns against their peers. Now, singer, songwriter and star Palash Sen has weighed in on the issue in an interview with Screen, alleging that Salman himself was part of the problem.

Adding to this, Palash Sen questions whether Salman Khan's Bigg Boss rant against trolls, paid pr was genuine. Palash Sen questions Salman Khan's Bigg Boss rant Palash recalled an instance when a movie trailer featuring an A-list female star received more dislikes than likes, leading YouTube to disable its dislike feature. He shared it was difficult to determine whether such reactions were organic or funded.

Meanwhile, Speaking about Salman calling out paid negative PR, Palash shared, "He’s a part of starting this. Let’s not forget that. Problems never arise from the bottom of the hierarchy; it starts from the top. I am not pointing a finger at anyone, but if you live by the sword, you are also going to get killed by the sword. Everybody in the movie industry who has maintained their position for many, many years, obviously has played with the PR guys; we all know it."

Notably, He added, "One day, you can start saying things and sound like a saint. Though it was very, very brave of him to say what he did. I am telling you he was part of the problem. We all know it. Even the fact that he did this on this show (Bigg Boss 20)…100 per cent, we don’t know whether this was scripted or it was really organic. It has become so difficult for all of us to figure out"

As per the latest buzz, During a Weekend Ka Vaar episode, Salman criticised the culture of trolling and defended Katrina Kaif when she faced online criticism over gaining weight after giving birth. He also called out sections of the movie industry and media, speaking about allegations that actors run paid negative campaigns against their peers.

In further updates, Salman shared, “I know who trolls me. We have so many fan clubs that we know who does what. We just choose not to react. They are making money by putting you down, and there might be heroes or producers who would encourage this by paying some money. Then people talk about corruption. For money, they give four or five stars to films. That is also a huge corruption. So are you in any position to talk about ethics or morals?”

On top of that, Palash Sen trained as a doctor before pursuing music professionally. He founded Euphoria in 1998, and the band went on to become one of India's prominent independent music acts in the late 1990s and early 2000s. Euphoria is known for songs such as Dhoom Pichuck Dhoom, Maaeri, Phir Dhoom, Aana Meri Gully and Mehfuz.

Sen has also acted in films, including Filhaal (2002), which starred Tabu and Sushmita Sen. In August 2026, he and Euphoria marked nearly three decades in music with the rollout of their album Dhoomsday.

title: EXCLUSIVE: Gulshan Devaiah DEBUNKS Wikipedia's claim that he made his debut in Salman Khan's Dil Ne Jise Apna Kahaa: “Even I have seen it and I laugh at it!”
body: Here's the latest update from the Bollywood world:

When asked whether he visits cinemas to gauge audience reactions or relies on social media to see how people are responding to his films and performances, Gulshan Devaiah made an honest confession. He shared, “I don't even check social media. My job is done, and now it's up to the audience to decide. This is also a way of self-preservation for me so that I don't get stressed. It's human tendency – 100 people would have lauded you, but that one negative comment will bother you (laughs). You forget that 100 people have shared good things.”
Adding to this, He added, “It also depends on my mood. At times, I do actively check how the movie is doing and look into its business aspects.”

Meanwhile, Meanwhile, Wikipedia mentions that Gulshan Devaiah appeared in the 2004 Salman Khan-Preity Zinta-Bhumika Chawla starrer Dil Ne Jise Apna Kahaa . The website further claims that he played a DJ in the romantic drama. Interestingly, when we revisited the movie, we spotted a DJ in the background of the song ‘Go Balle Balle’ . A few shots even focused on the DJ, but he didn't appear to be Gulshan.

Notably, Hence, we decided to ask Gulshan Devaiah himself whether he had indeed appeared in Dil Ne Jise Apna Kahaa . The star clarified, “That's not true. 2011 was my debut year. That Girl In Yellow Boots ' festival screening happened in 2010. However, in 2002, I did an English movie called Brides Wanted . I did it when I was in Bengaluru. However, it never got rolled out.”

As per the latest buzz, He continued, “Even I have seen the Dil Ne Jise Apna Kahaa mention on my Wikipedia page, and I laugh at it! Hopefully, in the future, Amitabh Bachchan will ask about my debut on KBC (Kaun Banega Crorepati), and both That Girl In Yellow Boots and Dil Ne Jise Apna Kahaa will be among the options (laughs).”

title: Renuka Shahane calls attack on Tiger Shroff terrifying: ‘Poor guy was just living his ordinary life’
body: Here's the latest update from the Bollywood world:

Several Bollywood celebrities have come out in support of Tiger Shroff after a firing incident in Mumbai on Sunday. The incident has sent shockwaves through the movie industry, with star Renuka Shahane calling it ‘truly terrifying’ and thanking God that Tiger was not hurt.

Adding to this, Renuka Shahane spoke about Tiger Shroff firing incident. ‘The poor guy was just going about his business’ In conversation with ANI, Renuka Shahane shared, “It’s a truly terrifying thing. The poor guy was just going about his business, living his ordinary life. I thank God that he wasn’t harmed. This news has left everyone shaken. Such elements must be completely eradicated. Since today is Dussehra, I believe that any such elements, those who use intimidation, take up arms, or act in defiance of the law, must absolutely be destroyed. I truly hope that is what happens.”

Meanwhile, Following the incident, the first photos and videos of Tiger emerged when he met Maharashtra Deputy Chief Minister Eknath Shinde. The star was seen with bandages in the images. On Tuesday, however, Tiger was seen without bandages in new pictures shared by Maharashtra minister Ashish Shelar, who visited him following the firing incident. The photos offered some relief to followers concerned about his well-being.

Notably, Sharing the pictures on social media, Ashish Shelar wrote, “Visited Tiger Shroff and enquired about his well-being following the unfortunate firing incident in Juhu. Such acts of violence have no place in our society. Wishing him strength and a speedy recovery.”

As per the latest buzz, The firing took place in Mumbai's posh Juhu area when Tiger was leaving a football club in his car, with his driver at the wheel. Three assailants as per reports approached the star's car and opened fire. After his driver was injured, Tiger quickly took the wheel and drove away from the spot. Following the incident, Mumbai Police arrested three suspects in Rajasthan's Kota. Delhi Police later arrested four people, including two women, in connection with the firing incident.

In further updates, Following the attack on Tiger, reports have emerged of heightened security around Bollywood celebrities. Reports of increased security around Salman Khan have been doing the rounds. It has also been reported that Akshay Kumar has stepped up security at his home. According to a report by NDTV, Akshay Kumar's home might get a bulletproof glass shield amid security concerns.

title: Tiger Shroff’s team issues statement after firing in Juhu, says actor made “no statements” about incident
body: Here's the latest update from the Bollywood world:

The statement comes two days after the star’s car was targeted in a firing incident near Pushpa Park in Juhu on October 18. Shroff was leaving the area after playing football when unidentified men on a motorcycle allegedly opened fire at his vehicle. The star escaped unharmed, while his driver and another person were injured, according to police and media reports.
Adding to this, Addressing the misinformation circulating online, Team Tiger categorically denied that the star had spoken publicly about the incident or authorised any communication.

Meanwhile, The team shared in its statement, “We would like to categorically clarify that Tiger Shroff has made no statements, rolled out no videos, and authorised no communication regarding the recent incident or any related developments.”

Notably, It further alleged that several social media pages and digital platforms were sharing fabricated stories and AI-generated videos while presenting them as statements or reactions from the star.

As per the latest buzz, The statement read, “It has come to our attention that several social media pages and digital platforms are circulating fabricated stories, AI-generated videos and scripted narratives, falsely attributed to Tiger. These are completely false, unauthorised and intended to mislead the public.”
In further updates, Team Tiger also made it clear that neither the star nor his team had any association with such material.
On top of that, “We do not endorse, support, or have any association with such content,” the statement shared.

title: Janhvi Kapoor to pay tribute to mother Sridevi at IIFA 2027
body: Here's the latest update from the Bollywood world:
The 27th edition of the IIFA Awards will take place at Abu Dhabi’s Etihad Arena on January 22 and 23, with Janhvi expressing excitement about returning to the stage.

Adding to this, In conversation with ANI, Andre Timmins shared details about the planned tribute and shared that Janhvi was excited about the opportunity. He also opened up that her father, producer Boney Kapoor, was particularly enthusiastic about the performance. "Janhvi will pay tribute to her mother, Sridevi, who's a brilliant artist that we had on this planet. I think that's the only tribute right now, and she's excited about it and more than her, her father, Boney, is more excited about it, so I think it'll be exciting," he told the portal.

Meanwhile, If verified as part of the final programme, the tribute would bring together Janhvi’s personal connection to Sridevi and the late star’s enduring legacy in Indian cinema. Sridevi, one of Hindi cinema’s most celebrated performers, left behind a body of work spanning several languages and genres.

Notably, Meanwhile, Janhvi has also expressed her excitement about returning to IIFA, recalling the experience of her first performance at the awards ceremony in Abu Dhabi. In a statement, the star spoke about the energy of performing before an international audience and the significance of the event in celebrating Indian cinema.

As per the latest buzz, “My first IIFA performance in Abu Dhabi will always hold a very special place in my heart. I remember the excitement, the nerves and the incredible energy of that night, and to now return to the IIFA stage feels like coming back with so much more love and excitement. IIFA is such a beautiful celebration because it brings together artists, audiences and the global Indian community through something we all love, cinema. Performing at IIFA is an experience like no other. There is something incredibly special about seeing an audience from across the world come together and celebrate Indian music, films and performers with so much enthusiasm. Abu Dhabi gave me such a memorable first IIFA experience, and I am thrilled to return to Yas Island for another chapter. I cannot wait to dance, perform and hopefully create another moment that stays with the audience long after the lights go down,” she shared.

In further updates, On the work front, Janhvi Kapoor is next expected to feature in Lag Jaa Gale , co-starring Lakshya and Tiger Shroff. The star also has an untitled project directed by Umesh Bisht, featuring Sreeleela alongside her, apart from other projects in the pipeline.

On top of that, With the 27th edition of IIFA approaching, the possibility of Janhvi paying tribute to Sridevi has added an emotional dimension to the celebrations. Further details about the performance are awaited.

His remarks roughly translate to, “As a student of art, I want to share something with you. The way a respected minister shared hurtful things and used indecent language against a legendary singer whose voice has touched people for decades, does not suit someone holding such a position.”

Meanwhile, He added, “It seemed like you bought the art itself, which simply cannot be bought. Art is life, and you should respect life. title: Was it necessary to go up on stage and humiliate him like that: Anupam Kher on Daler Mehndi row
body: Here's the latest update from the Bollywood world:

New Delhi, To publicly accuse someone like this is wrong, shared star Anupam Kher as he defended Daler Mehndi after the Punjabi singer's performance at a cultural event was interrupted midway by a politician who accused him of being drunk.

Adding to this, Was it necessary to go up on stage and humiliate him like that: Anupam Kher on Daler Mehndi row Mehndi, known for hits such as "Tunak Tunak Tun", "Bolo Ta Ra", "Ho Jayegi Balle Balle" and others, was performing at the Siddhpeeth Maa Kunjapuri Tourism and Development Fair in Uttarakhand's New Tehri on Sunday night when Cabinet minister and Narendra Nagar MLA Subodh Uniyal expressed his displeasure with the singer's performance.
Meanwhile, The minister went up to the stage, stopped the performance and alleged that the singer was inebriated. The allegations, however, could not be verified.

Notably, A video of the incident has gone widely shared on social media. In the video, Mehndi appeared lost as Uniyal shouted at him. "Why are you making a fool of the people? Are you drunk ? You can't even speak, so how are you going to sing," the minister is heard saying in the video.
As per the latest buzz, Calling Mehndi "one of the finest human beings" he had ever met, Kher shared he knew personally that the senior artist doesn't drink.

In further updates, "Couple of days ago, I saw a video in which Daler Mehndi ji was singing on stage and some minister got up and spoke to him insultingly. I wasn't there so I don't know but I've known Daler ji for 25 to 30 years. I know that he does not drink and he is one of the finest human beings that I have met. I personally know that he has not been keeping well for two-three years," Kher shared in a video on X.
On top of that, The veteran star also shared a lengthy note on the social media platform, saying that he felt bad after seeing the video of Mehndi being humiliated publicly.
"Nobody should speak to anybody like this and that also on a public forum. This is not fair. To publicly accuse someone like this is wrong. Daler ji I am so sorry," he shared.

title: Dhurandhar's marketing head Varun Gupta reveals why Ranveer Singh didn't promote film, recalls Aditya Dhar's calm reaction to criticism before release
body: Here's the latest update from the Bollywood world:

Aditya Dhar and Ranveer Singh 's Dhurandhar became a major box-office success, breaking several records and establishing itself as one of the highest-grossing Indian movie franchises. However, before its rollout, the movie faced criticism over its marketing strategy, with some followers expressing disappointment over the lack of buzz. In a conversation with the Everyday Empires podcast, Varun Gupta, founder of Max Marketing, the agency behind the promotional campaigns for Dhurandhar and Dhurandhar: The Revenge, revealed why Ranveer did not promote the movie and recalled Aditya's reaction to the criticism before its rollout.

Adding to this, Dhurandhar's marketing agency founder reveals why Ranveer Singh didn't promote the movie. Varun Gupta on Dhurandhar's marketing strategy Varun shared he could not recall any Hindi movie releasing a 3.5-minute-long promotional asset six months before its rollout prior to Dhurandhar. He added that while such a practice was common in Hollywood, it had not been seen in Hindi cinema. He also opened up that his team came on board for Dhurandhar even before the star cast was finalised and heard the script at that stage.
Meanwhile, He shared that while the movie is now being hailed as a major success, the team faced criticism before its rollout, with people questioning its marketing, promotions and lack of buzz.

Notably, He shared, "There were times when articles would come out saying the promotions were bad and there was no buzz. Aditya would just send them to me and say, ‘It’s all okay.’ There were no questions asked. That kind of trust makes you want to do anything for them. You become their warriors. I’m happy the movie worked because everyone put a lot into it. But Aditya and Ranveer Singh, specifically, put in a lot beyond what they should have as a director and an star. I’m happy for everyone associated with it."

As per the latest buzz, Varun also spoke about the alleged paid smear campaigns targeting films ahead of their rollout. He shared that when a movie starring a particular star is about to rollout, certain sections unnecessarily criticise it. He pointed out that filmmakers face criticism regardless of whether they take the lead star out for promotions. If the star participates in promotional activities, people question why such a big star needs to promote the movie and argue that newer actors would attract more attention. However, if the star does not participate, people claim that the makers are promoting the movie without generating enough buzz.
In further updates, Varun also explained why Ranveer did not promote Dhurandhar, contrasting the decision with Ranbir Kapoor's promotional activities for Animal.

On top of that, He shared, "Ranbir had Tu Jhoothi Main Makkaar before Animal rolled out, Ranveer Singh had not had a great run before Dhurandhar. There was a very conscious decision between us, the director, the producer and the star. We were like, ‘Okay, let the movie and its assets talk. Let the actors not talk.'"

Varun's company has previously worked on promotional campaigns for films such as RRR, Animal, Kalki 2898 AD and Chandu Champion. It is also associated with SS Rajamouli's soon-to-release movie Varanasi, starring Mahesh Babu, Priyanka Chopra and Prithviraj Sukumaran in lead roles.

title: Marco Rubio dismisses question on India protests as domestic matter, calls ‘UN experts’ an oxymoron
body: Here's the latest protest news from across India:

US secretary of state Marco Rubio described the Cockroach Janta Party-led protests against Chief Election Commissioner Gyanesh Kumar as India's "domestic matter", while calling UN experts an "oxymoron" over their criticism of the police response to the demonstrations.

Adding to this, US Secretary of State Marco Rubio will be visiting Gujarat's Jamnagar on Wednesday to complete his second trip to India in four months (REUTERS) Reacting to the remarks made by UN experts on the CJP protests and the police response, Rubio shared, “Oh, UN experts, my favourite. The UN experts are the oxymoron.”

Meanwhile, “It is a domestic political matter. I am not going to comment on it. This is a democracy, they have elections here. I am not going to opine on their domestic, political matters. We have protests every day in US,” shared Rubio while talking to reporters.

Notably, UN experts had criticised the Indian police's “heavy-handed” response to youth-led demonstrations in Delhi. They urged the authorities to protect peaceful protests and ensure justice for alleged human rights violations during these and earlier demonstrations.

As per the latest buzz, Speaking during a discussion on the agenda item concerning the Working Group on Enforced Disappearances, Barkha Tamrakar, deputy secretary in the ministry of external affairs, highlighted the constitutional and institutional safeguards in place in India to address allegations of human rights violations.
In further updates, More than 20 UN human rights experts in Geneva had expressed alarm over what they called a "repeatedly heavy-handed police response" to youth-led protests in the national capital.

On top of that, She shared, “Human rights should not be used as an instrument of political pressure or selective country targeting. India engages with international human rights mechanisms, but such engagement must be based on dialogue, consultation and cooperation, with non-selectivity and transparency as guiding principles.”

Tamrakar shared India was willing to address specific cases supported by proper documentation through established channels. However, she opposed any “attempt to convert unverified allegations, incomplete statistics or a report that contains no India country observation into a negative characterisation of the world's largest democracy”.

title: Ramayana: Part 1 tax-free in West Bengal: CM confirms exemption for Ranbir Kapoor starrer
body: Here's the latest update from the Bollywood world:
Directed by Nitesh Tiwari, the mythological epic stars Sai Pallavi as Sita and Yash as Ravana, alongside Sunny Deol, Ravi Dubey and Arun Govil in pivotal roles.

Adding to this, “The Ramayana movie has been made tax-free. The Kerala Story , The Kashmir Files and The Bengal Files , all of these will be or have been made tax-free, and the same will apply to 'Ramayana'. In the days to come, we will see films on Shri Krishna and Arjuna, as well as the Mahabharata,” the West Bengal CM told ANI.

Meanwhile, The announcement could make Ramayana: Part 1 more accessible to audiences across West Bengal, potentially supporting its theatrical prospects in a key market. The exemption is expected to draw attention to the movie’s rollout in Kolkata and other parts of the state, although the precise implementation and impact on ticket prices will depend on the applicable tax arrangements.

Notably, Conceived as the first instalment of a planned two-part cinematic saga, Ramayana: Part 1 is a Hindi-language mythological movie based on the ancient Sanskrit epic attributed to Valmiki. Directed by Nitesh Tiwari, who has co-written the screenplay with Shridhar Raghavan, the movie will bring the story of Prince Rama of Ayodhya, his exile and the trials surrounding his journey to the big screen on an ambitious scale.

As per the latest buzz, The movie features Ranbir Kapoor as Lord Rama, with Sai Pallavi portraying Sita. Kannada superstar Yash, widely known for his work in the K.G.F franchise, takes on the role of Ravana. Ravi Dubey will portray Lakshmana, adding another prominent name to the movie’s ensemble.

In further updates, Further additions to the ensemble include Adinath Kothare as Bharata, Lara Dutta as Kaikeyi and Indira Krishnan as Kausalya. Veteran star Arun Govil, who became synonymous with Lord Rama after portraying the character in Ramanand Sagar’s iconic 1987 television series, will play King Dasharatha in the soon-to-release movie. His casting adds a nostalgic dimension to a project revisiting one of Indian mythology’s most enduring stories.

On top of that, Ramayana: Part 1 is being mounted on an ambitious scale by producer Namit Malhotra, associated with visual effects company DNEG, and Yash. The production aims to bring the epic’s characters, settings and pivotal events to life through large-scale visual effects and an expansive cinematic treatment.
The movie’s music is being composed by A. R. Rahman and renowned German composer Hans Zimmer, bringing together two internationally recognised composers for the project.

title: New Ramayana song Ravana Tandav gets mixed reactions online: Yash gets applause but some fans want AR Rahman replaced in sequel
body: Here's the latest update from the Bollywood world:

The makers of Ramayana have rolled out the movie's second song, Ravana Tandav, featuring Yash as Ravana, on the occasion of Dussehra. While Yash's performance has impressed viewers, AR Rahman 's music has left many online disappointed, with several criticising the composer for making a track they expected to be energetic sound dull.

Adding to this, Yash's Tandav impresses, but AR Rahman's music lets followers down in Ramayana's Ravana Tandav. AR Rahman's music in Ravana Tandav disappoints internet The video features Yash as Ravana in Nitesh Tiwari's soon-to-release movie. The one-minute-and-55-second sequence showcases Ravana's devotion to Lord Shiva and is set to the Shiv Tandav Stotram. It opens with Ravana cutting his palm with a dagger and applying a Tripundra tilak to his forehead before performing a ritual. He then performs aarti in front of a large idol of Lord Shiva before performing the Tandav. The video also offers glimpses of Yash's commanding and intense presence as Ravana through a series of montage shots.

Meanwhile, Written by Dr Kumar Vishwas and composed by AR Rahman, the Hindi version of the song has been sung by Vishal Dadlani. While followers lauded Yash's performance and the Tandav choreography, many expressed disappointment with the music. Some social media users called Rahman a "bad choice" for the movie, while others even demanded that he be "replaced in the sequel".

Notably, One comment read, "AR Rahman is a bad choice for the movie." Another wrote, "Absolutely mid music from Rahman. Choosing him was a mistake for this movie." A third comment read, "Namit, it's not too late. I hope they change him in part 2, man; I was waiting for a banger." Another social media user suggested, "Replace Rahman with Ajay-Atul in sequel, they would kill it for sure." One more comment read, "ARR is past his prime. I knew taking Rahman was risky but boy is this disappointing."

As per the latest buzz, AR Rahman is collaborating with German composer Hans Zimmer on the project. Zimmer, known for his work on films such as The Lion King, Gladiator and Dune, is making his debut in Indian cinema with the epic.

In further updates, Directed by Nitesh Tiwari, Ramayana is as per reports mounted on a budget of ₹ 4,000 crore rupees across its two parts. Based on Valmiki's Sanskrit epic, the movie stars Ranbir Kapoor as Lord Rama, Yash as Ravana, Sai Pallavi as Sita, Sunny Deol as Lord Hanuman and Ravi Dubey as Lakshman. The movie also features Arun Govil, Rakul Preet Singh, Lara Dutta and Vivek Oberoi, among others, in key roles.
On top of that, Backed by Namit Malhotra and Yash, the movie is scheduled to rollout in two parts, with the first instalment set to arrive in theatres on November 5, 2026.

title: Police Company release date: Ram Gopal Varma’s crime saga starring Harshvardhan Rane to hit theatres on June 4, 2027
body: Here's the latest update from the Bollywood world:
Harshvardhan Rane will portray Mumbai encounter specialist Daya Nayak in the action thriller, which also features Fardeen Khan, Fatima Sana Shaikh and others.

Adding to this, Known for exploring the underbelly of Mumbai through films like Satya and Company , Ram Gopal Varma is revisiting familiar territory with a narrative that shifts the focus from gangsters to the police officers who confronted them. In Police Company , Harshvardhan Rane will portray Daya Nayak, the Mumbai police encounter specialist whose operations became a significant part of the city’s underworld history.

Meanwhile, Inspired by true events and real-life police officers who operated during the late 1990s and early 2000s, the movie will delve into the functioning of Mumbai’s encounter squad during a particularly volatile period. The narrative is expected to explore the circumstances, aggressive policing tactics and high-stakes operations that shaped the battle against organised crime in the financial capital.

Notably, The movie will revisit an era when gang-related violence and the underworld’s influence formed a significant part of Mumbai’s crime landscape. According to the movie’s announcement, the story will trace the operations through which the encounter squad neutralised around 300 gangsters, eventually dismantling the underworld’s terror network in the city. By placing law enforcement at the centre of the narrative, Police Company aims to offer a different perspective on a chapter that has frequently inspired crime dramas in Hindi cinema.

As per the latest buzz, Alongside Harshvardhan Rane, Police Company features Fardeen Khan, Fatima Sana Shaikh, Paresh Rawal, Saurabh Shukla, Makarand Deshpande and Ashwini Kalsekar in pivotal roles. The ensemble brings together several established performers, including actors who have previously been associated with Ram Gopal Varma’s distinctive brand of crime cinema.

In further updates, The casting also marks a creative reunion for several veteran actors whose work has contributed to Varma’s crime-movie legacy over the decades. Their presence adds to the movie’s focus on an intense, character-driven narrative set against the backdrop of Mumbai’s underworld and the police operations mounted against it.

On top of that, Presented by Gulshan Kumar and T-Series, Police Company is directed by Ram Gopal Varma and produced by Bhushan Kumar, Krishan Kumar and Ram Gopal Varma. The movie is being made under the banners of T-Series Films and RGV Company Production.

With its real-life inspiration, portrayal of a defining period in Mumbai’s underworld history and Harshvardhan Rane stepping into the role of Daya Nayak, Police Company marks Varma’s return to a genre closely associated with his filmography. The crime drama is slated for a nationwide theatrical rollout on June 4, 2027.

title: HT Interview: Isha Koppikar says she regrets turning down Sonali Kulkarni's role in Dil Chahta Hai
body: Here's the latest update from the Bollywood world:

From Ek Vivaah Aisa Bhi to Company and Don 2, star Isha Koppikar’s career spanned across genres and industries. In an exclusive interview with HT Lifestyle, the star reflected on her movie career, choosing meaningful roles, embracing diverse genres, self-acceptance, personal style and building habits that last beyond motivation.

Adding to this, Isha Koppikar made her feature movie debut with the Telugu movie W/o V. Vara Prasad in 1997, followed by her Tamil debut in Kaadhal Kavithai in 1998 and her Bollywood debut with Fiza in 2000. From romantic dramas like Ek Vivaah Aisa Bhi to crime thriller web series like Suranga, her journey across genres and movie industries reflects her evolution as an star, with each project bringing new experiences and opportunities to explore diverse roles.
Meanwhile, View this post on Instagram A post shared by Isha Koppikar (@isha_konnects)

Notably, Reflecting on her journey, Isha shared, “The best thing you can do as an star is adapt and evolve with age. As actors, we often feel we never age, but we must embrace change and explore diverse roles. It is important to break the monotony because people get bored seeing you in the same role again and again.”

As per the latest buzz, Isha also expressed her desire to explore diverse genres, including biopics, action, spiritual and mythological films. A Taekwondo black belt, she believes action roles would be a natural fit for her.

In further updates, The song Khallas from the movie Company introduced audiences to a different side of Isha Koppikar. Reflecting on the role, she shared, “I was not really prepared for it because, before that, I had done very conservative, girl-next-door roles and never thought I would fit the bill. But my director ensured that he brought out the ‘Khallas’ girl in me.”

On top of that, Ek Vivaah Aisa Bhi is one of the memorable films from Rajshri Productions and remains a notable part of Isha Koppikar’s filmography. Reflecting on her character Chandni, Isha shared, “I resonate with the simplicity that Chandni brought to the character because, in real life, I am fairly simple.” She also described working with Rajshri Productions and Sooraj Barjatya as a great experience, recalling her time with co-star Sonu Sood fondly. “He's a very fine human being. We were in Bhopal for almost a month, and I had a great time. It touched my soul and made me realise that such people exist.”

title: Ramayana records a stellar start, advance booking collection crosses ₹3 crore 15 days before release; even tickets worth ₹2,700 are sold out in Mumbai
body: Here's the latest box office buzz making the rounds:

The advance booking for Ramayana , starring Ranbir Kapoor and Yash , opened on October 20, coinciding with Dussehra. Within 24 hours, the highly anticipated movie has recorded an encouraging start, with advance bookings worth over ₹ 3 crore rupees across India, 15 days before its theatrical rollout. Here's a look at the movie's day 1 advance booking figures ahead of its November 5 rollout.

Adding to this, Ramayana's Hindi screenings account for about 95% of the gross, while bookings for Tamil and Telugu shows have yet to open. Ramayana advance booking day 1 According to Sacnilk, Ramayana has collected ₹ 3.13 crore rupees in advance bookings, excluding blocked seats. The movie has sold 86,187 tickets across 3,537 shows in 104 cities. Its current occupancy stands at 11%.

Meanwhile, On BookMyShow, advance bookings for the November 5 rollout are filling up quickly in the limited shows that have opened across cities. In New Delhi, some morning shows, including the 7:10 am screenings, have only a few seats left. In Mumbai, the PVR Phoenix Palladium IMAX screening, with tickets priced at ₹ 2,770, is sold out, while another tickets, priced at ₹ 1,550, is almost full.

Notably, The Hindi version is driving the movie's advance booking, accounting for around 95% of its gross collection through 3,474 shows. The Kannada market has also shown early interest, contributing around ₹ 25 lakh through 61 shows. The makers appear to be tapping into Yash's popularity in Karnataka, although only a limited number of Kannada shows have opened for advance booking so far. Bookings for Tamil and Telugu shows have yet to open.

As per the latest buzz, Ranveer Singh's Dhurandhar: The Revenge remains one of the biggest ticket-window successes of 2026, and it remains to be seen whether Ramayana can challenge its dominance. In the first 24 hours of advance booking, Dhurandhar: The Revenge collected ₹ 7.80 crore rupees for its opening day, excluding blocked seats.

In further updates, In comparison, Ramayana has collected ₹ 3.13 crore rupees without blocked seats in the first 24 hours of advance booking. However, with more shows expected to open, the movie's advance booking figures could change as its rollout date approaches.

On top of that, Directed by Nitesh Tiwari, Ramayana is an adaptation of the Hindu epic of the same name. The movie stars Ranbir Kapoor as Lord Ram, Sai Pallavi as Sita and Yash as Ravana, with Sunny Deol playing Lord Hanuman. Produced by Namit Malhotra, the movie is planned as a two-part cinematic saga, with music by Hans Zimmer and AR Rahman. The first part is scheduled to rollout in theatres on November 5, 2026.

title: India slams UN over ‘selective targeting’ after experts flag crackdown on protests
body: Here's the latest protest news from across India:

India shared that human rights must not be used to exert political pressure or selectively target countries, after more than 20 UN human rights experts in Geneva expressed alarm over what they called a "repeatedly heavy-handed police response" to youth-led protests in the national capital.

Adding to this, Barkha Tamrakar made the statement on India's behalf at the UN General Assembly's Third Committee on Tuesday. (X/@IndiaUNNewYork) Barkha Tamrakar, deputy secretary in the ministry of external affairs, made the statement on India's behalf at the UN General Assembly's Third Committee on Tuesday. She was speaking during a discussion on the agenda item concerning the 'Working Group on Enforced Disappearances'.
Meanwhile, Delivering the remarks, Tamrakar pointed out the constitutional and institutional safeguards in place in India to address allegations of human rights violations.
Notably, She shared, "Human rights not to be used as an instrument of political pressure or selective country targeting,” Tamrakar shared in her statement.

As per the latest buzz, “India engages with international human rights mechanisms, but such engagement must be based on dialogue, consultation, cooperation with non-selectivity and transparency as guiding principles,” she added.

In further updates, She shared India was willing to address specific cases supported by proper documentation through established channels. However, the country opposed any "attempt to convert unverified allegations, incomplete statistics or a report that contains no India country observation into a negative characterisation of the world's largest democracy".
On top of that, Tamrakar also called for accountability, transparency and cooperation to address enforced disappearances at the UN General Assembly's Third Committee.
Describing India as a vibrant democracy governed by the rule of law, she shared constitutional provisions and independent institutions served as safeguards against alleged enforced disappearances.

title: Yami Gautam performs Ravan Vadh at Delhi’s Luv Kush Ramleela during Dussehra celebrations, calls it a beautiful feeling
body: Here's the latest update from the Bollywood world:

Yami Gautam of late brought her on-screen portrayal to life as she participated in the Ravan Vadh celebrations at Delhi's iconic Luv Kush Ramleela. The star, along with filmmaker-producer Aanand L Rai , attended the Dussehra festivities at the historic Red Fort Ground, where she performed the symbolic act of shooting an arrow at Ravana's effigy.

Adding to this, Yami Gautam at Dussehra celebration in Delhi. Yami Gautam performs Ravan Vadh A video from the event has been doing the rounds on social media, showing Yami shooting the symbolic arrow at Ravana in front of thousands of spectators. Her participation also drew attention to her role in Nayyi Navelli , in which she performs a similar act.

Meanwhile, Yami posted her photo from the celebration which shows her pointing the arrow at the Ravana's effigy and wrote, "At the iconic Luv Kush Ramlila 🙏🏻 Such a beautiful feeling to experience sea of people gathered to celebrate the true spirit of ‘Vijaydhashmi’ as 1 heartbeat 🙏🏻 Jai Shri Ram 🙏🏻 Happy Dussehra 🙏🏻."
Notably, View this post on Instagram A post shared by Yami Gautam Dhar (@yamigautam)

As per the latest buzz, Speaking about the occasion, Arjun Kumar, president of the Luv Kush Ramleela Committee, shared, “It is a matter of immense pride and honour for us that Hon'ble Vice President of India, Shri C.P. Radhakrishnan, graced our Dussehra celebrations and performed Ravan Dahan. His presence made this historic occasion even more memorable.”

In further updates, Explaining this year's theme, Kumar shared, “Our theme this year is 'Respect for Women'. Through Yami Gautam's participation, we wanted to convey that women represent courage, dignity and strength. Ravana is not merely a mythological character but also symbolises arrogance, injustice and the evils prevailing in society. The participation of Yami Gautam sends a strong message of women's empowerment and their important role in defeating evil.”

On top of that, Over the years, the Luv Kush Ramleela's Ravan Dahan have seen several prominent movie personalities participate, including Akshay Kumar, Ajay Devgn, John Abraham, Prabhas and Kareena Kapoor.

Nayyi Navelli stars Yami Gautam and Adinath Kothare and blends horror with comedy. Written by Himanshu Sharma and Divy Nidhi Sharma, the movie is directed by Kollywood filmmaker Balaji Mohan, marking his Bollywood directorial debut. It is produced by Aanand L Rai and Himanshu Sharma. The movie received mixed-to-negative reviews from critics.

title: Anupam Kher backs Daler Mehndi, says minister publicly ‘insulting’ singer was unfair
body: Here's the latest update from the Bollywood world:

Punjabi singer Daler Mehndi has received support from star Anupam Kher amid the row surrounding his performance at a cultural event in Uttarakhand. The row erupted after state Cabinet minister Subodh Uniyal publicly reprimanded the singer during the Maa Kunjapuri Mela in Tehri Garhwal, accusing him of performing after consuming alcohol. After the video went widely shared, Daler's brother Mika Singh, comedian Kapil Sharma and singer Badshah came out in his support. Anupam has now defended the singer and urged members of the movie industry to speak up for him.

Adding to this, Anupam Kher defends Daler Mehndi, says singer has been unwell for 2-3 years. Anupam Kher backs Daler Mehndi On Wednesday, Anupam posted on Instagram to share a video in support of Daler. Revealing that he was currently abroad, the star shared he had watched the video of the singer's performance. He shared he had known Daler for 25-30 years and vouched for his character, adding that the singer did not drink and was one of the finest human beings he knew.

Meanwhile, Anupam also shared that Daler had been unwell for the past two to three years and shared he knew this through a doctor they both knew. He suggested that the singer might have had prior commitments to the event organisers and had chosen to honour them despite his health concerns.

Notably, "I can say he doesn't drink and he's one of the finest human beings. He is not well, and I personally know this because we have a common friend, a doctor, and I have met him there several times. He has been ill for 2-3 years. Maybe he had earlier commitments with the organisation and he couldn't say no to them; that's his professionalism, that he stuck with his commitment," Anupam shared.
As per the latest buzz, View this post on Instagram A post shared by Anupam Kher (@anupampkher)
In further updates, He further urged members of the movie industry to stand up for Daler, arguing that even if the singer had lip-synced, he did not deserve to be reprimanded publicly.

On top of that, "Maybe he did lip-sync, but nobody should speak to anyone like that. That too on a public forum, it's not fair. To put allegations on someone like this is wrong. I think our industry should talk about this; it's not only Mika Singh's responsibility to defend his brother. We should all take a stand for the people that we know. I felt bad, and I want to tell you, Daler ji, that I trust your judgement, professionalism and your greatness and may God bless you and you get well soon. I am sorry you had to go through this," he added.

Alongside the video, Anupam also shared a caption in which he questioned the minister's decision to reprimand Daler publicly. He acknowledged that the minister may have had concerns about the performance but argued that the issue could have been addressed privately and respectfully.

title: As actors get more physical, Bollywood embraces intimacy coordinators
body: Here's the latest update from the Bollywood world:

India's movie industry, where scenes featuring nudity or sex often rely on improvisation and mutual trust, is gradually welcoming professionals tasked with choreographing intimacy to protect actors and ensure consent.

Adding to this, As actors get more physical, Bollywood embraces intimacy coordinators Once unheard-of in Bollywood, intimacy coordinators are becoming an increasingly familiar presence on sets as filmmakers embrace stricter standards after the #MeToo movement put a spotlight on sexual exploitation in entertainment industries around the world.
Meanwhile, The shift comes as streaming platforms have pushed storytelling into a more nuanced territory, creating greater demand for realistic portrayals of sexuality.

Notably, "Just like a stunt director handles a fight scene... for scenes of intimacy, we map out exactly where the hand goes and where the hair goes so nothing is left to awkward improvisation," shared Aastha Khanna, one of a small but growing group of intimacy coordinators in Bollywood.
As per the latest buzz, Most arrive on set armed with "modesty tools" that allow performers to simulate intimacy while minimising unnecessary physical contact.

In further updates, The emergence of such coordinators reflects a broader transformation in an industry where intimate scenes traditionally relied on trust between actors and directors, often with few formal safeguards.
On top of that, Khanna shared coordinators are usually hired before casting begins.
"The idea is that actors know there are intimate scenes in the script and can decide whether they are comfortable with them before signing on," she told AFP.

title: Ranbir Kapoor, Yash and Sai Pallavi's Ramayana made tax-free in West Bengal ahead of release, CM Suvendu Adhikari announces on Dussehra
body: Here's the latest update from the Bollywood world:

Filmmaker Nitesh Tiwari 's ambitious adaptation of the Hindu epic Ramayana, starring Ranbir Kapoor as Lord Rama and Yash as Ravana, has been made tax-free in West Bengal. Chief Minister Suvendu Adhikari made the announcement on Dussehra, ahead of the movie's theatrical rollout on November 5, 2026.

Adding to this, Ramayana will rollout worldwide on November 5. Ramayana revealed tax-free in West Bengal In conversation with ANI on Tuesday, Adhikari shared, "The Ramayana movie has been made tax-free. The Kerala Story, The Kashmir Files, and The Bengal Files—all of these will be (or have been) made tax-free, and the same will apply to Ramayana. In the days to come, we will see films on Shri Krishna and Arjuna, as well as the Mahabharata..."

Meanwhile, The Chief Minister also expressed grief over the stampede at a Durga Puja pandal in Kolkata's Chorbagan area. He shared, "We also carry a deep pain in our hearts regarding the incident at the Durga Puja pandal in Chorbagan area. From this very stage, we offered prayers for those affected as well. We observed a moment of silence. Everyone stands with the grieving family."

Notably, Directed by Nitesh Tiwari and backed by Namit Malhotra, Ramayana stars Ranbir Kapoor as Lord Rama, Yash as Ravana, Sai Pallavi as Sita, Ravi Dubey as Lakshman and Sunny Deol as Lord Hanuman. The movie also features Rakul Preet Singh, Vivek Oberoi, Arun Govil, Lara Dutta, Sheeba Chaddha, Shobana and Faisal Malik, among others, in key roles.
As per the latest buzz, Mounted on a reported budget of ₹ 4,000 crore rupees for its two parts, the movie is being planned as an ambitious cinematic adaptation of the Indian epic.

In further updates, When the makers unveiled the movie's first look, featuring Ranbir as Lord Rama, it received mixed reactions online. While some viewers questioned the star's casting, others criticised the visual effects. However, the movie's subsequent trailer received a more positive response from many viewers, with some noting the improvements made by the makers following audience feedback.

On top of that, The movie's distribution plans include Dil Raju in the Telugu-speaking states, Karan Johar in the Hindi-speaking market and Sony Pictures for its international rollout, according to the information provided.

Backed by Namit Malhotra's Prime Focus Studios, Yash's Monster Mind Creations and DNEG, the movie is planned as a two-part rollout. The first part is scheduled to arrive in theatres on November 5, 2026, coinciding with Diwali.

title: UN experts slam India’s ‘heavy-handed’ crackdown on youth-led protests
body: Here's the latest protest news from across India:

United Nations’ experts have criticised the Indian police’s “heavy-handed” response to youth-led protests in Delhi and elsewhere over the past three months, urging authorities to protect peaceful agitations and ensure justice for alleged rights violations during these and earlier demonstrations.

Adding to this, Security personnel detain a National Students’ Union of India (NSUI) worker during their protest against the Chief Election Commissioner, Gyanesh Kumar, demanding his resignation near the NSUI headquarters, in New Delhi. (ANI) “This crackdown reflects a broader, troubling pattern,” the experts shared in a note issued in Geneva on Tuesday. “We have repeatedly alerted the Indian authorities to undue restrictions on peaceful assembly, excessive use of force, arbitrary detentions, enforced disappearances, and the targeting of student activists, amongst others.”
Meanwhile, There was no immediate reaction from the Indian government or authorities at the time of filing this report.

Notably, The statement comes as the protests, which began over government decisions on the education system, have widened into a sustained challenge to the Union government. The latest trigger is the Election Commission’s Special Intensive Revision (SIR) of electoral rolls.

As per the latest buzz, The experts shared the SIR process affects 130 million people, or 13 crore rupees, a number roughly equal to the population of Mexico. They shared those affected as per reports belong to the Muslim minority, Scheduled Castes and Scheduled Tribes.

In further updates, The unrest over the SIR has gathered pace since late September, after reports that two deputies of Chief Election Commissioner Gyanesh Kumar raised internal concerns about the exercise. The youth-led Cockroach Janta Party and student groups have sought Kumar’s resignation and a halt to the SIR exercise. They have described their latest phase of protests as “Season 2”.

On top of that, However, the Bharatiya Janata Party (BJP) at the Centre and the Election Commission have denied any manipulation of the rolls, and the BJP has defended the revision as a clean-up of voter lists. Opposition parties and several independent analysts have also alleged the Muslims have been disproportionately affected, though researchers note that religion-wise data has not been published, so such estimates rest on name analysis.

India has also pushed back against international criticism. Earlier this month, the Ministry of External Affairs called a UN statement on the protests selective and an “unwarranted interference in the internal affairs of India”.

title: Society, not protests, can trigger change: RSS chief Mohan Bhagwat
body: Here's the latest protest news from across India:

Rashtriya Swayamsevak Sangh (RSS) chief Mohan Bhagwat on Tuesday shared that andolan, or agitation, does not bring about change; and solutions to problems often come from within society, adding that when protests are political or instigated, they can create tension and anarchy, and disrupt public order.

Adding to this, RSS chief Mohan Bhagwat in Nagpur on Tuesday. (HT Photo) “Experience shows that it is neither the government alone that can resolve all the problems of society, nor is it true that problems can be resolved only through agitations. Solutions can also emerge through the active participation of the society and dialogue among its members,” Bhagwat shared, delivering the annual Vijaydashami lecture in Nagpur .

Meanwhile, The RSS chief’s comments come against the backdrop of ongoing street protests by the Opposition and the Cockroach Janta Party demanding electoral reforms and the removal of chief election commissioner Gyanesh Kumar over alleged irregularities in the conduct of the special intensive revision (SIR) .
Notably, The Opposition, particularly the Congress, has accused the poll panel of working at the behest of the ruling Bharatiya Janata Party , the political arm of the Sangh.
As per the latest buzz, The RSS chief shared that the people of India needed to be cautious that there were forces in the West that wanted India derailed from its path of becoming a developed nation.

In further updates, “ A storm has swept in from the West, driven by a demonic resolve to destroy and devastate all that is decent, auspicious, and rooted in cultural and human values, both in Bharat and across the world. Even the so-called developed nations across the world are afflicted by this storm and find themselves helpless before it. However, over the past decades, Bharat has gradually carved out a place for itself in the world through its own strength and sound policies,” he shared.
On top of that, He cited France , Albania, Nepaland Bangladesh as examples of foreign interference that tried to push regime change as a means of finding solutions.

“Look at what has been happening in France, Albania, Nepal and Bangladesh in recent days. They want to make similar attempts in Bharat as well. But a change of regime does not change anything. Look at the situation there,” he shared.

title: ‘Doosra, Delhi Belly both got A certificates’: Filmmaker Abhinay Deo says he has never fought with CBFC, reveals his experience with the board | Excl
body: Here's the latest update from the Bollywood world:

When Sourav Ganguly took off his shirt and waved it from the Lord’s balcony after India’s memorable NatWest Series victory in 2002, it became one of the defining moments in Indian cricket. While the celebration is remembered for its sheer audacity, filmmaker Abhinay Deo sees it as a statement of confidence from a team that was no longer willing to play second fiddle. That spirit of defiance forms the heart of his soon-to-release movie Doosra, which connects the Indian cricketer’s rebellious streak with the story of Tara, a young woman growing up in a conservative household in Rajasthan who begins questioning the restrictions imposed on her.

Adding to this, Filmmaker Abhinay Deo says he has never fought with the CBFC, recalls getting A certificates for Doosra and Delhi Belly. Starring Plabita Borthakur as Tara, the movie uses a landmark moment in cricket to explore a much more personal struggle for freedom. Beyond its central theme, the movie has also received an A certificate from the Central Board of Movie Certification (CBFC), raising questions about how filmmakers navigate the certification process while trying to preserve their stories. Abhinay, however, says his experience with the board has been largely hassle-free, unlike the challenges other filmmakers have spoken about.

Meanwhile, According to several reports, CBFC flagged a few scenes in Doosra, including a brief shot of a nude photograph in an adult magazine that Tara's father catches her looking at as a child. The board also raised concerns about a reference to the Babri Masjid episode and sought changes to the scene. However, director Abhinay Deo was reluctant to alter footage he considered important to the story and chose to accept an A certificate instead of making the requested cuts.

Notably, Abhinay points to his 2011 dark comedy Delhi Belly as an example of how smoothly the certification process has worked for him. In conversation with Hindustan Times, he says, “My experience with anything that could be considered objectionable goes back to Delhi Belly, my first movie, and now Doosra, my latest movie. Interestingly, both films were adult-rated, and both were passed without cuts. My meeting with the board lasted seven or eight minutes, maybe ten. They asked what rating I was expecting, and I shared a U/A rating would be great, but if that meant cuts, I would rather go without them.”

As per the latest buzz, He explains that the board asked him to change just one word in Doosra, much as it had done with Delhi Belly. “It’s a very interesting story because both my films were adult-rated with just one word changed. I have never had a fight with them,” he adds.

In further updates, Abhinay is quick to clarify that his experience may not reflect what other filmmakers have gone through. For Doosra, he says, the team was comfortable with an A certificate because it felt the movie was not necessarily meant for younger viewers to watch on their own. However, he believes its themes could still resonate with them. “We were very clear that we were fine with an adult certification. This is not a movie for a 13-year-old to come and watch on their own, though it is a very important movie for a 13-year-old to see as well,” he explains. He adds that he has no issue with the movie eventually reaching audiences on a streaming platform.

On top of that, At around 78 minutes, Doosra is considerably shorter than most mainstream theatrical releases. Abhinay believes the movie's length and intense storytelling make it well suited to a continuous screening without an interval. While the team had hoped to avoid a break, the director admits that the final decision is not entirely in their hands.

“In a 78-minute movie that is an intense drama, I think it can very easily go without a break. There are some films where the first half itself is longer than 78 minutes these days,” he says. While he understands that exhibitors have commercial considerations, including selling refreshments during intervals, he believes the movie's viewing experience deserves equal consideration. “I understand that they need to sell popcorn, but at the end of the day, they exist because of films. They need to be a little more sensitive towards the films as well,” he explains.

title: ‘So much blood and mayhem’: Shashi Tharoor reviews Ranveer Singh's Dhurandhar, questions propaganda, gruesome violence and portrayal of India-Pakistan
body: Here's the latest update from the Bollywood world:

Congress Member of Parliament Shashi Tharoor has lauded Ranveer Singh ’s Dhurandhar films for their filmmaking and performances, but he has reservations about the violence and political messaging in the franchise. After watching both parts of Aditya Dhar ’s spy thriller, the politician shared he enjoyed the sequel Dhurandhar: The Revenge more than the first movie. However, he felt several violent scenes were unnecessarily graphic and questioned how the films portray India-Pakistan relations. The two installments, rolled out in December 2025 and March 2026, have as per reports collected more than ₹ 3,100 crore rupees worldwide.

Adding to this, Congress Member of Parliament Shashi Tharoor has lauded Ranveer Singh’s Dhurandhar films for their filmmaking and performances, but he has reservations about the violence and political messaging in the franchise. Shashi Tharoor says Dhurandhar 2 is better than the first movie In an almost seven minute video posted on his official YouTube channel, Shashi shared his thoughts on both films and made it clear that the second instalment stood out for him. “As a work of fiction, as a work of entertainment, there is no doubt that the second part is superb,” he shared.

Meanwhile, While he appreciated the sequel as a work of entertainment, he was critical of the violence shown in the franchise. He felt the filmmakers could have told the story without relying on so many disturbing scenes. “There was no need to show so much violence, blood, mayhem, cruelty and some of the most disgusting scenes ever seen in Indian cinema,” he added, describing the graphic content as “totally excessive and over the top.”

Notably, The Congress MP also spoke about the political messaging in Dhurandhar. The films have faced criticism over their portrayal of Pakistan, and Shashi acknowledged that such themes could influence how audiences view the relationship between the two countries. He referred to reports of bans in Pakistan and several Gulf nations, where concerns were as per reports raised about the films potentially worsening tensions between Indians and Pakistanis.

As per the latest buzz, “Things that I don't like; there is far too much gruesome violence. It was totally excessive and over the top. There was no need to show so much of violence, blood and mayhem, cruelty and some of the most disgusting scenes ever seen in Indian cinema,” he shared. “There is a lot of propaganda stuff built into it obviously and I gather the movie has been banned in many countries, not just in Pakistan, but many of the Gulf countries have banned it, saying it would needlessly create bad blood between Indians and Pakistanis, so I can understand those feelings,” the politician added.

In further updates, He also wondered how Pakistani viewers might react if they watched the films. He suggested that some dialogues might be received with humour, while other parts could lead audiences to reflect on actions carried out in their country's name. “I don’t know how Pakistanis will react if they see this. Some of the lines, I think Pakistanis will laugh. Some of the other things, I think Pakistanis will realise how much wrong has been done in their name,” he went onto say.

On top of that, Dhurandhar follows an undercover intelligence operative Jaskirat Singh Rangi alias Hamza Ali Mazari, with the story featuring secret missions and high-stakes operations. Shashi shared his own interactions with intelligence officials had been very different from what the films show. He explained that his experience involved discussions, analysis and sharing information, rather than the dramatic, covert operations depicted on screen.

“I have dealt with a lot of our intelligence people but in a very civilised way, having analysis, conversations, information exchanges but not really getting into any cloak and dagger stuff. I am certainly not aware of commands being given that lead to explosions in faraway capitals. That’s not the world I have ever lived in,” he explained.

body: Here's the latest update from the Bollywood world:

With Udta Teer nearing its theatrical rollout, actors Ayushmann Khurrana and Sara Ali Khan took some time out to seek blessings at the Golden Temple in Amritsar on Dussehra. Sara Ali Khan shares Dussehra wishes Sara gave followers a glimpse of the visit by sharing a picture with Ayushmann at the holy shrine. Both actors wore white outfits, with Sara covering her head with a dupatta as they stood with their hands folded in prayer. Along with the photograph, Sara wrote, "Happy Dussehra. Wishing everyone love, luck and laughter," sharing her festive wishes with her followers.

Meanwhile, View this post on Instagram While the photographs captured a peaceful moment, a video from their visit has since gone widely shared on the internet. The clip shows Sara appearing visibly overwhelmed with emotion, moved to tears as she stood in prayer at the Darbar Sahib.

Notably, View this post on Instagram All about Udta Teer The Golden Temple visit comes ahead of the rollout of Udta Teer, which is scheduled to arrive in theatres on October 23. The movie was initially set to rollout on October 9 before its date was pushed back.

As per the latest buzz, The movie marks the directorial debut of Akash A Kaushik and brings together a sizeable ensemble cast. Along with Sara and Ayushmann in the lead roles, it features Rahul Bose, Ram Kapoor, Suhail Nayyar, Gulshan Grover, Mukul Dev, Raghubir Yadav, Brijendra Kala, Sandeep Anand, Supriya Pilgaonkar and Smita Tambe.

In further updates, Of late, it was reported that the movie will not be screened publicly in Nepal, after the country’s Ministry of Communications and Information Technology refused to grant it permission for exhibition. The decision followed a review by Nepal’s Central Movie Censor Board, which found the movie in violation of a provision of the country’s cinema law.

On top of that, A letter was issued by the ministry’s Audio-Visual and Broadcasting Division in which the Central Movie Censor Board examined the movie on Ashwin 19, 2083, as per the Nepali calendar. Following the review, the board concluded that the movie’s production violated Section 8(3) of the National Cinema (Production, Exhibition and Distribution) Act, 2026. Based on the board’s findings, the ministry decided against granting permission for the movie’s public screening in the country.

Udta Teer is produced by Karan Johar, Adar Poonawalla, Apoorva Mehta, Guneet Monga Kapoor and Achin Jain. The project also marks another collaboration between Dharma Productions and Sikhya Entertainment. This marks Ayushmann and Sara's second collaboration after Pati Patni Aur Woh Do. The movie is set to open in cinemas on October 23.

title: Anurag Kashyap, Vasan Bala back Panchayat actors Chandan Roy, Faisal Malik's short film Aakhri Ride, to release on Halloween
body: Here's the latest update from the Bollywood world:

Filmmakers Anurag Kashyap and Vasan Bala have come together to present short movie Aakhri Ride, an atmospheric thriller set to premiere globally on Halloween, October 31. The short movie brings together Panchayat actors Chandan Roy and Faisal Malik, along with Aamir Dalvi, who was part of Kashyap's Kennedy. The movie features the three actors in pivotal roles.

Adding to this, Chandan Roy in a still from Aakhri Ride. About Aakhri Ride Aakhri Ride follows a tense, character-driven narrative centered on a Mumbai ride-share driver pushed to the ultimate edge over the course of one desperate, chilling night.

Meanwhile, The short movie is written and directed by debutants Vijesh Rajan and Yashoda Parthasarthy. It is bankrolled by Ranjan Singh, Vishesh Agrawal, Rajan EPK and Kashyap. The movie will rollout on the YouTube channel Oh Short Flips, which is curated by Kashyap.

Notably, Anurag shared the reason behind backing this movie. He shared, “I have worked with Vijesh and Yashoda from GoW days and always believed they are excellent storytellers with a unique visual language. So when they finally decided to turn writer-directors, it was as an easy decision to back them. And now, I am quite excited to see the audience response to their first movie - Aakhri Ride, when it releases on Halloween Day.”
As per the latest buzz, View this post on Instagram A post shared by Flip Films (@ohflipfilms)

In further updates, Calling the short “quirky and with a beating heart,” Vasan Bala shared, “Vijesh was the Wiz Kid we were introduced to by filmmaker Srinivas. We were always in awe of what he could do with his VFX skills but there there was always a sensitive and fun storyteller in him. When he and Yashoda went to make the movie, we all rooted for them. I was beyond excited to watch their short movie. It’s sharp, fun, quirky and with a beating heart. So coming on board was a nano second decision a no brainer.”

On top of that, Detailing the real-life inspiration behind the movie, writer-directors Vijesh Rajan and Yashoda Parthasarthy added, “Aakhri Ride grew out of our long cab journeys home from meetings across Mumbai. We’d be sitting in the back seat, talking about work or sitting in silence, while the driver was often carrying a completely different world on his phone: family back home, money worries, things we may never fully know. We began to notice an invisible social divide: we were enjoying the comfort of being driven home, while he was trying to make ends meet. We shared a small space, but knew so little about each other’s lives.

“That distance stayed with us, and we wanted to explore it through horror and humour: the idea of a man so consumed by everyday troubles that he doesn’t notice what he’s picked up. We hope viewers laugh, get spooked, and maybe think a little about the person driving them home.”
