Adding to this, Mika wrote, “The way Daler Mehndi was treated on stage was disappointing. A respected minister came on stage and made allegations about him drinking alcohol. But before publishing such claims, shouldn’t we verify the facts and give the artist a chance to present his side?” He also questioned whether a similar approach would be taken with an international act, writing, “Would anyone dare to behave like that with an international band like Coldplay?”

Meanwhile, In the video, Mika defended Daler against the allegation that he had been drinking during the performance. He shared, “He has been a superstar for the last 30 years. Have you ever seen a glass of alcohol in his hand in your life?”

Notably, Mika added that Daler has been unwell and is recovering from a recent operation. “If he is not able to stand or he is not able to sing well, he was not feeling well. Because he had a big operation of late,” he shared.

As per the latest buzz, Mika further explained that artists sometimes honour professional commitments despite being unwell. “As much as I get sick, if I come to know that I have a show the day after tomorrow, and I have shared yes, even if the budget was less or more, doesn't matter. I have to be there,” he shared.

In further updates, Daler Mehndi was performing at the annual Siddhpeeth Maa Kunjapuri Tourism and Development Fair in Tehri district on October 18 when Uttarakhand Cabinet Minister and local MLA Subodh Uniyal interrupted the performance.

On top of that, In a video circulating online, Uniyal questioned Mehndi’s ability to sing and alleged that he appeared to be under the influence of alcohol. The minister also questioned the performance in relation to the reported fee.
Mika acknowledged that the minister could question the quality of the performance but objected to the alcohol allegation without proof.

title: Tiger Shroff's team releases first statement after firing attack, warns of legal action over AI-generated videos and fake claims
body: Here's the latest update from the Bollywood world:

A firing incident involving Tiger Shroff has raised serious concerns in the movie industry and beyond. The incident took place around 7 pm on October 18 in Mumbai , as the Bollywood star was leaving a football club. A video of the shooting showed the attackers opening fire at his car from close range. Tiger escaped without injuries, but his driver and a bystander were as per reports hurt in the incident. The firing has since drawn attention to concerns over the star’s safety, with the incident prompting questions about the circumstances surrounding the attack and the people responsible. Now, the star's team has rolled out first statement.

Adding to this, Team Tiger Shroff issues strong warning against deepfakes and AI-Generated misinformation. (AFP) What the statement says Tiger's team has issued a strong warning against the spread of fake news and AI-generated content falsely linked to the star. In a statement, the team clarified that Tiger has not made any public comments or rolled out videos about a recent incident, and warned that those responsible for spreading misleading content could face legal action.

Meanwhile, The statement comes amid concerns over social media pages and digital platforms using fabricated material to create confusion and spread unverified claims. Team Tiger has urged people to rely on official sources instead of believing or sharing content without checking its authenticity.

Notably, View this post on Instagram The team clarified that the star has not addressed the matter publicly. “We would like to categorically clarify that Tiger Shroff has made no statements, rolled out no videos, and authorised no communication regarding the recent incident or any related developments,” the statement read.

As per the latest buzz, The statement also raised concerns about the misuse of artificial intelligence and the circulation of misleading stories online. According to the team, several platforms have been sharing “fabricated stories, AI-generated videos and scripted narratives, falsely attributed to Tiger.” It described such material as “completely false, unauthorised and intended to mislead the public.”

In further updates, Team Tiger also called on media organisations and digital platforms to exercise caution before publishing or sharing content about the star. The team stressed that it does not support or endorse any of the fabricated material and urged publishers to verify information rather than prioritise clicks or revenue. It asked them to “refrain from creating or amplifying misinformation for engagement or monetary gain.”

On top of that, The statement went on to warn social media users and content creators that sharing such material could have legal consequences. “Any individual or page found creating, promoting or circulating such fabricated content will face appropriate legal action. We are taking cognisance of these instances and reserve the right to pursue all available legal remedies against those responsible,” the notice shared.

The team concluded by asking the public to remain cautious about unverified claims and check information through the star’s official channels. It urged “everyone to rely only on verified communication from Tiger Shroff and his official team.”

title: Prince William calls Karan Johar an ‘icon’, promises to watch Kabhi Khushi Kabhie Gham after meeting filmmaker in London
body: Here's the latest update from the Bollywood world:

Prince William may soon be catching up on one of Bollywood’s most loved family dramas. The Prince of Wales has called Karan Johar an “icon” and shared he would watch Kabhi Khushi Kabhie Gham (K3G) after a journalist suggested the movie during a conversation about their recent meeting in London.

Adding to this, Prince William praises Karan Johar’s contribution to Earthshot Prize. The meeting took place during an event linked to the Earthshot Prize , the environmental initiative founded by Prince William and The Royal Foundation. Karan has been helping the project build a stronger presence in India, and the Prince acknowledged his contribution while speaking about their interaction. The conversation took a Bollywood turn when the journalist asked whether William had watched any of the filmmaker’s movies.

Meanwhile, Asked how the meeting went, Prince William had warm words for Johar and his work with the initiative. He told BBC Asian Network, “Really cool. I mean, he's again an icon, and he's been so helpful in kind of being able to help the Earthshot prize land, well in India. We want to make it a truly Indian Earthshot Prize. It's the biggest one we've done.”

Notably, The Prince also referred to Karan as “modest” while discussing his involvement with the project. The journalist then brought up the filmmaker’s movies, pointing out that some of his best-known films have become familiar to audiences well beyond India. William admitted that he had not watched any of his films yet, but seemed open to changing that. He replied, “No, he's being very modest. But I'm sure as time goes on, he'll introduce some more films to me.”

As per the latest buzz, The journalist had a specific recommendation in mind: Kabhi Khushi Kabhie Gham, the 2001 family drama starring Amitabh Bachchan, Jaya Bachchan, Shah Rukh Khan, Kajol, Hrithik Roshan and Kareena Kapoor Khan. Encouraging William to give it a watch, the journalist shared: “Yeah, we all say K3G anyway. If you meet Karan again, 'Tell him, I'm going to watch your movie K3G, he'll love you.'” William agreed, saying: “Okay got it, I'll mention that too when I see him.”

In further updates, View this post on Instagram What is happening at the Earthshot Prize in India? The Earthshot Prize Summit will bring together people from across business, environmental innovation, funding and community organisations for two days of discussions and collaboration. The aim is to connect promising environmental projects with the resources and partnerships they need to grow.

On top of that, The summit will lead up to the sixth Earthshot Prize Awards Night on November 17, 2026. Fifteen finalists will be recognised, with five winners set to receive £1 million each to help develop and expand their solutions. The initiative focuses on supporting ideas that can make a meaningful difference to the planet.

Away from his Earthshot Prize work, Johar has several projects keeping him busy. His star chat show Koffee with Karan is nearing the end of its run. Following the premiere of season 9 with Salman Khan, Vijay Deverakonda and Rashmika Mandanna are also set to appear on the show while promoting their movie Ranabaali.

title: Nick Jonas gets candid about Jonas Brothers’ split with mother-in-law Madhu Chopra, recalls being in a ‘pressure cooker’
body: Here's the latest update from the Bollywood world:

Nick Jonas of late sat down with his mother-in-law, Madhu Chopra , mother of Priyanka Chopra, for a conversation in which he opened up about the reasons behind the Jonas Brothers ' split in 2013 and their eventual reunion in 2019. The singer also reflected on a personal flaw he has recognised in himself.

Adding to this, Nick Jonas spoke about his one flaw to Madhu Chopra, (Instagram) Nick Jonas opens up about being in a 'pressure cooker' during early years of success Although Nick's podcast conversation with Madhu Chopra is yet to be rolled out, she shared a few clips from the interview on social media. In one of the clips, Nick discussed the factors that led to the Jonas Brothers' breakup.

Meanwhile, “There was a fraying that was happening. From our last album till the time we broke up, it was a combination of growing up, being in a pressure cooker of having reached this level of success and having not quite reached that success for a number of years, finding that we weren't extending our collaborators because we were afraid that maybe if we reached out, people wouldn't want to work with us,” he shared.

Notably, View this post on Instagram Nick Jonas reveals the one flaw he sees in himself During the conversation, Madhu lauded Nick for balancing his responsibilities as a father, husband and rockstar. She then asked him to identify the one flaw he sees in himself. Responding to her question, Nick shared, “You should probably ask that to your daughter.”

As per the latest buzz, He went on to explain that his biggest flaw is his tendency to overthink certain aspects of the creative process. “My major flaw is my tendency to overthink certain things in the creative process and I always describe it as I am tightening the screw until eventually the wood breaks and you reach a sweet spot where you are giving as much effort as you can but you can also overcook it. So, just find that perfect balance where you have done your best that you feel you can do and leave it in the hands of others,” he shared.

In further updates, View this post on Instagram 4:59 embed 2 View this post on Instagram About the Jonas Brothers The Jonas Brothers, comprising brothers Nick Jonas, Joe Jonas and Kevin Jonas, rose to fame with their music in the 2000s. The band revealed its split in 2013 amid creative differences and tensions among the brothers.

On top of that, After pursuing individual projects, the trio reunited in 2019, marking their comeback with the single Sucker. The song became a major hit and signalled a new chapter for the band as the brothers returned to making music together.

body: Here's the latest protest news from across India:

Adding to this, Taking a dig at the Congress leader, the ruling party suggested that he was tired of the protests and had taken a break. Taking a swipe at the Congress leader, the BJP suggested that he was taking a break from the protests.

Notably, The official handle of BJP Goa also took a dig at Gandhi. Tagging INC handle on X, it shared, “To ‘RECOVER’ from yesterday's FLOP yatra and that 10-minute walk in Goa organised by your 'Non-Dimaagi Naxals' Goa Congress, the clown is already tired and escaping to Vietnam.”
As per the latest buzz, BJP accused the Congress leader of creating chaos, fueling anarchy and running away for vacation and hoped for him to have a “colourful” time.

In further updates, “His business model is clear: Create chaos in India, fuel anarchy, and run away for vacation. Part-time anarchy, full-time vacation - that's his job profile. Anyway, hope he enjoys his colourful time there,” it added on X.

On top of that, BJP MP Praveen Khandelwal claimed that this was not the first time Gandhi had travelled abroad. He accused the Congress leader of “creating a row” in India before leaving on foreign trips.

"Rahul Gandhi is not doing this for the first time. He often spends more time travelling abroad. His only job is to come to India, create a row over an issue and then leave on foreign trips. Where does he go abroad and whom does he meet? Nobody understands this, and nobody knows,” he told news agency PTI .

title: Protests barred at 3 Bhopal sites for 2 months, no alternative site designated
body: Here's the latest protest news from across India:

Police have prohibited sit-ins, demonstrations, agitations, strikes, and burning of effigies at three popular protest spots in Bhopal for the next two months without designating any alternative place.

Adding to this, Bhopal police commissioner Sanjay Kumar declared the three sites and the stretches between them as restricted zones. Bhopal police commissioner Sanjay Kumar declared Polytechnic Square, Akashvani Square, Kilol Park Square, and the stretches between them as restricted zones for protests under Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita (BNSS) Section 163.

Meanwhile, In the order issued on Monday, Kumar shared these intersections lie on the main road leading to important places like the airport, Hamidia Hospital and Gandhi Medical College. It added that it is the only convenient route and there is no alternative. “Frequent applications are received from communities, organisations, political parties, committees and delegations to hold dharna, protest, demonstrations, agitations and effigy burning at Polytechnic Square, which disrupts traffic and causes severe inconvenience to the public.”

Notably, The order cited the movement of emergency services like ambulances and fire brigades and VIPs and VVIPs and shared the agitations, protests and demonstrations could endanger the lives of patients due to delays. It added that, therefore, it appears necessary to declare the area as a restricted zone.

As per the latest buzz, Kumar exercised powers under Section 163 (1) of BNSS and prohibited all such programmes in the area. His order under Section 163 (2) of BNSS will remain in force for two months from the date of implementation. It shared any violation will attract action.

In further updates, Opposition Congress leader Anand Jat accused the Bharatiya Janata Party government of suppressing people’s voices by issuing such an order. “They are now afraid of people’s voice, but these restrictions will not stop people from raising their voice,” shared Jat.

On top of that, Tens of thousands of people this month took to the streets in Delhi seeking chief election commissioner Gyanesh Kumar’s resignation over irregularities in the Special Intensive Revision (SIR) of the electoral roll and demanded the scrapping of the exercise.

Authorities ordered Metro closures, Internet shutdowns, imposed prohibitory orders and deployed 40,000 security personnel to turn Delhi into a virtual fortress. Many protesters were dragged, manhandled, and detained.

title: Ranbir Kapoor surprises Hyderabad fans with Telugu speech at pre-release Ramayana event: ‘I hope I have not said anything wrong’
body: Here's the latest update from the Bollywood world:

His attempt was met with loud cheers, while co-star Sai Pallavi, who plays Sita, watched with a smile.

Adding to this, 11. Ranbir Kapoor promises a grand cinematic experience at Ramayana event, thanks Telugu followers in their language. The event was organised ahead of the movie's theatrical rollout in Andhra Pradesh and Telangana, where it will be distributed by Dil Raju's Sri Venkateswara Creations (SVC). With its ambitious scale and a star cast led by Ranbir, Sai Pallavi and Yash, the movie has been building anticipation among audiences.

Meanwhile, At the event, Ranbir first spoke in English, thanking followers for accepting him and his work. He assured them that he would give his best to make the movie a memorable experience in theatres. He shared, “To all my Telugu-speaking friends, all my brothers and sisters from all over the world. I want to thank you for accepting me and my work. I will promise that I will always work hard so that I can give you all some cinematic experience on the big screen.”

Notably, He then continued in Telugu, earning an enthusiastic response from the audience. "Hyderabad ku raavadam naaku epudu pratyekame. Mee prema, abhimaanam naaku chala villuvenavi (Coming to Hyderabad is always special for me. Your love and affection are very valuable to me)," he continued.

As per the latest buzz, Keeping the moment light-hearted, Ranbir added, "I hope I have not shared anything wrong." Sai Pallavi appeared delighted by his effort to speak to the crowd in their language.

In further updates, During his address, Ranbir spoke about the values at the heart of the epic and what audiences could expect from the movie. He described Ramayana as a story that continues to resonate across generations, going beyond its place in mythology.

On top of that, “Jai Shri Ram! Greetings to everyone. Some stories do not need to be told because they live on with us. Ramayana is one such story. Ramayana is a wonderful journey that teaches us how to be a great father, a good son, a loving husband and a true friend. When you watch this movie, it will not feel like you are simply watching a movie. You will undoubtedly experience something extraordinary. This is a movie that inspires goodness in all of us."

He added, “Namit Malhotra has brought this movie to life with an extraordinary vision. Director Nitesh Tiwari has crafted it beautifully, and I thank him for making me a part of this movie. Rakul’s performance in this movie is very different and will surprise all of you. My journey with Sai Pallavi on this movie has been a memorable experience. Whenever I saw her on the sets, I genuinely felt as though I was looking at Goddess Sita herself. I cannot imagine anyone other than her playing this character. If I had a brother, he would be like Ravi. Rocking Star Yash is a wonderful family man. He left his family, his city and everything behind to be a part of Ramayana. I have never seen anyone work as hard as he does.”

title: Screenwriter Apurva Asrani says he won’t be surprised if people are thrown into Tihar jail for disliking Ramayana
body: Here's the latest update from the Bollywood world:

Yash of late urged audiences not to nitpick the VFX in Ramayana and extend their full support to the much-awaited movie, which stars him as Ravana and Ranbir Kapoor as Lord Rama. Now, screenwriter Apurva Asrani, known for critically acclaimed films such as Shahid and Aligarh, seemingly criticised Yash's comments, comparing them to a sign of dictatorship.

Adding to this, Ramayana will rollout worldwide on November 5. ‘Won’t be surprised if they throw us in Tihar Jail for disliking the movie’ Apurva took to X (formerly Twitter) and wrote, “I won’t be surprised if they throw us in friggin’ Tihar Jail for disliking the new Ramayana, refusing to bang a thali to solve the oil crisis, or daring to eat a chicken burger on a Tuesday. Maybe even for switching off the TV during the supreme leader’s speech.”

Meanwhile, Apurva went on to link Yash's comments to the India's current political climate. He also referred to the arrest of Cockroach Janta Party (CJP) leaders Saurav Das and Ashutosh Ranka, who have been held in Delhi's Tihar Jail for allegedly trespassing and entering the Jantar Mantar protest site after it was removed from the list of authorised demonstration venues.

Notably, Apurva wrote, “That’s how far down the road to dictatorship India is sliding. Watching how Saurav & Ashutosh are being treated, it is sad to see how the Constitution of India has been reduced to a mockery. Raise your voice now, before even a joke, a question or the slightest disagreement becomes grounds for state retaliation.”

As per the latest buzz, At a recent Ramayana pre-rollout event in Hyderabad, Yash urged audiences to support the movie and refrain from nitpicking over its visual effects. He also shared India needed to protect filmmakers such as producer Namit Malhotra, who are striving to take Indian cinema to a global platform.

In further updates, Yash shared, “Anybody can dream of making a movie, but only a few people will have that kind of passion, dedication, determination and madness. As an Indian, I am telling you, we need to protect this guy. It's our responsibility because this man was comfortably doing business in LA. Every time I met him, he always spoke about one thing, ‘We all are doing so much and Indians have done so much, but we should do something for our Indian movie industry and I want to do it. I am getting Oscars, but I am not happy. I want our country to be placed at that level and that's the day I am going to be happy.’ This is what he told me.”
On top of that, Earlier, at Ramayana's trailer launch event in Bengaluru, Yash verified that the two-part epic has a combined budget of ₹ 4,000 crore rupees.

title: 30-foot cockroach effigy in Delhi to be burnt alongside Ravana on Dussehra amid CJP protests
body: Here's the latest protest news from across India:

A 30-foot-tall cockroach effigy has been put up in Delhi's Pitampura to be burnt alongside the traditional effigies of Ravana, Kumbhakarna and Meghnad on Dussehra. The move is seen as a jibe at the Cockroach Janata Party (CJP), which has been protesting over alleged irregularities in the Special Intensive Revision (SIR) of electoral rolls.

Adding to this, The installation comes amid protests by the Cockroach Janata Party (CJP) in the national capital although the committe has denied any political motivation. (ANI Screengrab) CJP leader Abhijeet Dipke reacted to a video of the effigy shared by news agency ANI, writing, “Thank you for the free publicity.” The video showed the cockroach figure standing alongside the traditional effigies of Ravana, Kumbhakarna and Meghnad, which are burnt during the festival.

Meanwhile, CJP legal head Ratna Singh also commented on the installation, writing, “Tamasha Kara lo bas is desh mein” (Just keep putting on a spectacle in this country). Both leaders' remarks drew reactions on social media, with several users linking the proposed burning of the cockroach effigy to the triumph of good over evil.

Notably, The Shree Keshav Ramlila Committee, which erected the effigy, has shared the move is not politically motivated. Committee president and Bharatiya Janata Party (BJP) MLA Ashok Goel told news agency PTI that the cockroach represents filth and dirt, and that burning it is intended to promote cleanliness under the Swachh Bharat and Swachh Delhi campaigns.
As per the latest buzz, “Our goal is to eliminate filth from three areas: our homes, our immediate surroundings and society at large,” Goel shared.
In further updates, He added that the committee has introduced additional effigies to highlight social issues in previous years, including figures representing Naxalism and terrorism.

On top of that, The CJP has been staging protests in the national capital over various issues. The group initially demonstrated against former education minister Dharmendra Pradhan and later joined protests demanding the resignation of Chief Election Commissioner Gyanesh Kumar.

In June and July, CJP members staged a protest at Jantar Mantar for more than a month before marching towards Parliament on July 20. The group has since joined opposition parties and student organisations in demonstrations over alleged irregularities in the SIR of electoral rolls.

title: Protesters must focus on solutions, not divisions: RSS chief Mohan Bhagwat
body: Here's the latest protest news from across India:

Rashtriya Swayamsevak Sangh (RSS) chief Mohan Bhagwat on Tuesday shared that protesters must focus on finding constructive solutions rather than creating divisions in society as he addressed a range of social concerns and global challenges at the annual Vijayadashami event

Adding to this, RSS chief Mohan Bhagwat in Nagpur on Tuesday. (ANI) His reference to the protests came against the backdrop of the Cockroach Janta Party and the Congress’s agitations demanding the chief election Commissioner Gyanesh Kumar’s removal. Tens of thousands of people have taken to the streets seeking Kumar’s removal and the scrapping of the electoral roll Special Intensive Revision (SIR) over alleged irregularities.

Meanwhile, Speaking at the RSS headquarters in Nagpur on the occasion of the organisation’s 101st anniversary, he cited protests in India and Western countries, describing them as part of a disruptive cultural storm coming from the West that opposes systemic conduct and institutional security. “We are hearing such news from France. We know what happened in Nepal, Bangladesh too,” he shared. “Such things are happening in India too, but a problem is rarely solved with agitation.”

Notably, Bhagwat accused certain global powers and domestic forces of actively trying to weaken India and exploit social differences. He urged people not to let cheap publicity overcome their wisdom, emphasising that national unity and society’s rise as a whole provide the best solutions.

As per the latest buzz, Bhagwat shared that changing governments or regimes has historically never resolved a country’s deep-seated problems, citing past and present political upheavals in nations to illustrate his point. He noted similar agitational politics is happening in India.

In further updates, Bhagwat cautioned that it is extremely rare for complex societal problems to be solved purely through street agitations. He alleged that certain narrow-minded global powers and domestic political opponents are actively trying to weaken India. Bhagwat shared that these external and internal forces exploit existing social differences, amplify feelings of victimhood and public dissatisfaction, and attempt to distance citizens from the collective social order.

On top of that, He shared such efforts are designed to foster hatred toward governance systems and create widespread disorder. Bhagwat observed with satisfaction that the younger generation is displaying a growing sense of national pride, which he shared has become a matter of concern for forces seeking to dismantle India’s stability.

Bhagwat called for an immediate and strict ban on drugs and narcotics, announcing that the RSS will actively work on combating this menace. He advocated for the proper regulation of OTT content to safeguard cultural values and protect younger audiences.

title: SCOOP: Ramayana advance booking may get DELAYED due to revenue-sharing tussle; distributors demand 60% share in Week 1
body: Here's the latest update from the Bollywood world:

A trade source told Bollywood Hungama, “Usually, for big films, the distributor's share is 52.5% in Week 1, 45% in Week 2 and 37.5% in Week 3. But the distributors of Ramayana are as per reports demanding a 60% revenue share in the first week, 50% in the second week and 40% in the third week. This is significantly higher than the usual sharing terms followed for big-budget films. As a result, exhibitors, who are understandably concerned, are reluctant to agree to these terms and negotiations are currently underway.”

Adding to this, The source continued, “Unless both parties arrive at a mutually acceptable agreement, the advance booking could get delayed. Everyone is keen to rollout Ramayana on a grand scale, but there has to be mutual consensus when it comes to commercial terms.”

Meanwhile, It remains to be seen whether the two sides can resolve their differences soon and ensure that advance bookings begin across the country. As of 9:30 am, INOX Korum Mall in Thane is the only cinema in the Mumbai Metropolitan Region to have opened bookings for Ramayana. title: HT Exclusive | Anurag Kashyap says only devotional or patriotic films are being greenlit in Bollywood, making films is difficult today
body: Here's the latest update from the Bollywood world:

Many are calling 2026 the year of patriotic and devotional films in Hindi cinema. With the success of movies like Dhurandhar and Hanuman Ansh, there is a wave of patriotic and devotional titles being revealed. Filmmaker Anurag Kashyap believes that the two genres now have hegemony in Bollywood, with other diverse genres struggling to even surface. In a chat with Hindustan Times, the filmmaker opens up on why making diverse films is challenging these days.

Adding to this, Anurag Kashyap opens up on the state of Indian cinema. Anurag Kashyap on devotional and patriotic films Anurag is backing the independently made children’s movie Little Thomas , starring Gulshan Devaiah and Rasika Dugal, and directed by Kaushal Oza. Talking about his role as an executive producer, Anurag says, “I see myself more as an enabler.”

Meanwhile, The filmmaker elaborates, “It is just about faith and upping somebody’s morale. I see myself as someone who keeps morale high and helps them complete and rollout a movie. I don’t think anybody knows what to make today. Movie banana hi difficult hai (It is difficult to make films). Whether it’s a children’s movie or an adult movie, making your own movie is difficult today.”

Notably, Anurag says the wave of patriotic and devotional films being revealed shows that Hindi cinema is now following that trend. He explains, “I was talking to a producer the other day, and they shared, ‘We don’t know what to do’. You can make either a patriotic or a devotional movie. Otherwise, nothing else is getting greenlit. That is a fact and a tragedy.”

As per the latest buzz, Three of the four biggest hits from Bollywood this year fit in this bracket - Dhurandhar 2, Hanuman Ansh, and Border 2. Several more have since been revealed. But Anurag feels that this also creates an environment ripe for slice-of-life films like Little Thomas. “Hopefully, this movie will sneak in, because this is not like any other movie out there,” he says.

In further updates, The filmmaker also feels that merely because some films have children as protagonists does not make them kids’ films. “For instance, what will you call this recent Telugu movie called Don’t Trouble The Trouble, which stars Fahadh Faasil and is backed by SS Rajamouli. It has Fahadh, so would you call it a children’s movie?” he argues. Conversely, he shares an argument from the other end of the spectrum. “When we go to festivals, we see so many coming-of-age films. The biggest, most talked-about series in the last two years was Adolescence. But they are for adults,” says Anurag.

On top of that, Written and directed by Kaushal Oza, Little Thomas features an ensemble cast led by Gulshan Devaiah and Rasika Dugal and also features child artiste Hridansh Parekh in the titular role. The movie is produced by Anurag Kashyap, alongside Anushka Shah, Charu Oza, Rajnikant Oza, Akshay Thakker, Kabir Ahuja, and Ranjan Singh. It is slated for a theatrical rollout on October 23.

title: Sharad Kelkar says he spoke to Tiger Shroff after firing incident, trusts Mumbai Police to get to the bottom of the case
body: Here's the latest update from the Bollywood world:

The Hindi movie industry was shaken after a firing incident involving Tiger Shroff on Sunday. Shots were fired at the star as he left a football club in Mumbai. While the star escaped unhurt, he did suffer gunpowder burns on his right hand. Of late, star Sharad Kelkar reacted to the incident and called out the 'anarchy in the country'.He also expressed faith in Mumbai Police to get to the bottom of the incident.

Adding to this, Sharad Kelkar spoke about Tiger Shroff firing incident. 'Should never be this kind of anarchy in the country' In conversation with ANI, Sharad Kelkar shared, "It's not just about Bollywood or any famous person. There should never be this kind of anarchy in the country. The Mumbai Police is very on top of things, and everyone has been caught."

Meanwhile, The Tanhaji star also shared that he spoke to Tiger after the incident and assured his followers that he is doing fine. He shared, "And yesterday I even spoke to Jackie Shroff, sent him a message. So everything is alright, it's safe. But yes, what happened was wrong, but I have full faith in the Mumbai Police—they have already caught the culprits, and they will get to the bottom of this."

Notably, Along with Sharad, celebrities like Vidyut Jammwal, Ram Gopal Varma, filmmaker Rahul Dholakia and others also reacted to the incident. Vidyut posted on Instagram on Monday and expressed his concern over the firing incident. He called Tiger "the most fearless person". He also questioned Mumbai Police about the lapse in Tiger's security. He shared, “I would like to tell the Mumbai Police: you have provided him with security, but this must never happen again. If a lapse like this occurs, then you are the ones at fault."

As per the latest buzz, After the firing incident, Mumbai Police arrested three men accused of targeting Tiger Shroff’s car in Mumbai. They were arrested in Rajasthan's Kota on Monday. As per reports, the arrests came after an overnight search involving multiple police teams across states.

In further updates, The accused have been identified as Hritik alias Roshan, from Begusarai in Bihar, Rehan from Sonipat in Haryana, and a third associate. They were arrested from the general coach of the Pune-Jaipur Superfast Express when the train reached Kota railway station at 10:17 am, Kota Superintendent of Police Tejaswani Gautam shared. The police are also probing the alleged Lawrence Bishnoi gang link in the firing incident.

title: Ramayana's Kumbhakarna used Mark Ruffalo's Hulk as reference, reveals Faisal Malik: 'He's massive'
body: Here's the latest update from the Bollywood world:

We have seen giants on screen in The Lord of the Rings and other fantasy franchises. Over the last two decades, Hulk has come to define brute strength on the big screen, with Mark Ruffalo ’s portrayal of the character in the Marvel Cinematic Universe becoming widely lauded. In fact, such is the reverence for the character that star Faisal Malik based his portrayal of the asura Kumbhakarna in Ramayana on him.

Adding to this, Faisal Malik (right) says his Kumbhakarna uses Mark Ruffalo's Hulk as a reference. Faisal Malik on Kumbhakaran In a recent interview with Variety India, Faisal Malik opened up on playing Kumbhakarna in Nitesh Tiwari’s Ramayana. The trailers of the movie have given a good glimpse at the gigantic size of the asura and Ravana’s brother. In the epic, Kumbhakarna is described as 600 bows in height, which could imply a height of 1800-2400 feet. Talking about transforming into the behemoth, Faisal shared, “We have all seen the Hulk and how Mark Ruffalo becomes the big green guy. That is a reference for me when I started imagining how I would look.”

Meanwhile, Best known for playing Prahlad Cha in Panchayat, Faisal has also appeared in small parts in films such as Gangs of Wasseypur. Ramayana’s Kumbhakarna is his highest-profile role yet. Talking about the experience, he added, “My experience of playing Kumbhakarna in Ramayana is a dream come true. We grew up watching Ramayana, so playing a character from it feels like sheer luck. The challenge here is that this world is completely different for me. He isn't a normal human; he's massive, and he was in a deep sleep for six months. To keep all of that in mind and derive a final output is a tricky part.”
Notably, Nalin Dave played Kumbhakarna in Ramanand Sagar’s 1987 TV series, Ramayan. It is considered one of the most defining portrayals of the character.

As per the latest buzz, Produced by Namit Malhotra’s Prime Focus Studios in collaboration with DNEG and Yash’s Monster Mind Creations, Ramayana is planned as a two-part movie. The movie stars Ranbir Kapoor as Lord Rama, Sai Pallavi as Sita, Yash as Ravana, Ravie Dubey as Lakshman, and Sunny Deol as Lord Hanuman. The first part is scheduled for worldwide rollout on November 5, 2026, while the second part is set for Diwali 2027. The films will rollout in Hindi, Tamil, Telugu, Kannada and Malayalam across India.

Meanwhile, Naam - To Live Is War , hence, marks their reunion after nearly 16 years. Although they haven't collaborated during this period, the mutual respect has remained intact. After the rollout of Himesh Reshammiya's 2014 mystery thriller The Xposé , he revealed in an interview with The Times of India that Mahesh Bhatt had personally called to congratulate him. Himesh had shared, “Bhatt sahab called to congratulate me and that was an emotional moment for me. His praise means a lot.”

Notably, Himesh Reshammiya is on a roll. Besides Naam - To Live Is War , he has several interesting films in his pipeline, including Sooraj Barjatya's Yeh Prem Mol Liya , the Emraan Hashmi-starrer Gunmaaster G9 , Anil Sharma's Arjun Naga and Vikram Bhatt's horror movie, 1920: Cold Winter .

As per the latest buzz, Coming back to Naam - To Live Is War , the movie is presented by Mahesh Bhatt under Utsav Entertainment and Productions. Directed by Sidhaant Sachdev, it is produced by Utsav Upadhyay and Riddhi Chawda.

title: Tanishaa Mukerji calls Bigg Boss a game of manipulation, says she was brainwashed into relationship with Armaan Kohli
body: Here's the latest relationship update doing the rounds:

Bigg Boss has often been a breeding ground for drama, unexpected romances and relationships that keep viewers hooked. During the seventh season of the reality show, star Tanishaa Mukerji , sister of Kajol , grew close to fellow contestant Armaan Kohli . Years later, Tanishaa has opened up about the relationship in a recent podcast, describing Bigg Boss as a game of manipulation and claiming she was ‘brainwashed’ into getting involved with Armaan.

Adding to this, Tanishaa Mukerji and Armaan Kohli participated in Bigg Boss 7. Tanishaa Mukerji on relationship with Armaan Kohli In a chat with YouTube channel Unfolding Humans, Tanishaa shared she had entered Bigg Boss without fully understanding what she was getting into. She admitted that she had been naive and unprepared for the experience, adding that people should approach the reality show with a better understanding of the show. She also shared that relationships and friendships in life stem from karmic connections and advised people to be cautious while participating in Bigg Boss.

Meanwhile, She explained that the Bigg Boss team puts people in certain situations to make two people feel like a team and loyal to each other. Tanishaa added, "They manipulate you into these things. They put you together in dump situations, in jail together, so again you are sympathising with each other over your misery. All these experiences build fake emotions in you which are not really yours. The emotions that have been built up are because of the experiences you have had together, which, again, you didn’t choose to have. These are the situations determined by the people controlling the game show. These are the things I realised later."

Notably, She claimed that the makers subsequently placed her and Armaan in the same team, creating more opportunities for them to interact. Tanishaa shared she felt an immediate sense of familiarity with Armaan Kohli because he, too, came from a movie industry family. She added that she found it easy to be around him because he had a movie industry vibe that nobody else in the house shared.

As per the latest buzz, She added, "And then the situations put us into those moments where there was a lot of trauma bonding. After I came out, I had to go to a psychiatrist. It took me six months to break out of Bigg Boss brainwashing. You have to be very careful when you go into these reality shows, and today kids are a lot more sorted. I think it is because of the background I come from, as I was living in a bubble. I was in a very live-and-let-live, easy space. I didn’t experience manipulation until I entered the Bigg Boss house."

In further updates, Armaan and Tanishaa's relationship began during their stint on Bigg Boss 7 in 2013. Their closeness on the reality show, including their romantic moments frequently made headlines. After the show ended, the couple continued to be linked romantically, with Armaan describing Tanishaa as an important part of his life. However, their relationship ended in 2014, after dating for about a year. Tanishaa later shared that they were very different people with different ideologies.

title: Daler Mehndi was paid ₹35 lakh for Uttarakhand event, says minister after criticising singer’s professionalism
body: Here's the latest update from the Bollywood world:

Punjabi singer Daler Mehndi made headlines after Uttarakhand cabinet minister Subodh Uniyal rebuked him during the cultural evening of the historic Siddhpeeth Maa Kunjapuri Tourism and Development Fair in New Tehri on Sunday night, objecting to his conduct on stage. Now, the minister has opened up that the singer was paid ₹ 35 lakh to perform at the event.

Adding to this, Daler Mehndi was reprimanded by Uttarakhand cabinet minister. Daler Mehndi was offered ₹ 35 lakh to perform In conversation with ANI, Subodh Uniyal shared, "He is a big artist. If a big artist doesn't do justice to their art...He seemed disoriented on stage and didn't seem to be able to even keep standing. Besides this, he was only lip-syncing to his songs. I told him that he is a big artist and he should do justice to his art; he had been offered ₹ 35 lakh to come and perform, but he was not even singing. So, I expressed my resentment."

Meanwhile, Daler Mehndi was performing at the celebration when Subodh Uniyal interrupted him mid-performance and reprimanded him for appearing disoriented on stage. It was alleged that the singer was under the influence of alcohol and was barely able to sing but these allegations cannot be independently verified.
Notably, During the programme, the minister objected to the singer's performance and was heard saying, "You cannot even speak, so how are you going to sing?"

As per the latest buzz, As per a report by PTI, addressing the singer on stage, Subodh Uniyal shared that the audience had come to hear Daler perform and that he was therefore expected to meet the standards they anticipated. The minister also stressed the importance of maintaining decorum, noting that the event was taking place during the religious period of Navratri.

In further updates, A video of the incident has also been doing the rounds on social media. In the clip, the minister can be heard telling Daler Mehndi, "We called you so that our people could be entertained. You are making a fool of us. This is wrong. It's wrong. You have a big name; we should respect that. You were called because you have a big name."

On top of that, Daler Mehndi is one of India's best-known Punjabi pop singers and is widely recognised for popularising bhangra and Indian pop music. He rose to prominence in the 1990s with hit songs such as Bolo Ta Ra Ra, Dardi Rab Rab and Ho Jayegi Balle Balle.
Over the years, Mehndi has also lent his voice to Hindi movie soundtracks, including songs such as Na Na Na Re from Mrityudata and Rang De Basanti's Paathshaala.

title: Dil Raju confuses Ranbir Kapoor with Ranveer Singh while praising him at Ramayana event, quickly apologises
body: Here's the latest update from the Bollywood world:

Filmmaker Nitesh Tiwari’s Ramayana is one of the most anticipated films of the year and is set to rollout in theatres this Diwali. Ahead of its rollout, the makers held a grand event in Hyderabad, where they revealed Dil Raju as one of the movie’s distributors. While addressing the audience and praising the team, Dil Raju accidentally mixed up Ranbir Kapoor’s name with Ranveer Singh’s, leaving the internet amused.

Adding to this, Dil Raju mistakenly refers Ranbir Kapoor as Ranveer Singh. Dil Raju confuses Ranbir Kapoor's name with Ranveer Singh During his speech, Dil Raju opened up that Ramayana would be distributed by Karan Johar in North India, Sony Pictures in Hollywood and his company in the Telugu-speaking states. He then went on to say that it would be the third Ranbir Kapoor-starrer he would distribute in the Telugu states, following Brahmastra and Animal. Praising Ranbir, he shared, "We seen all his films, one of the best actors, the best hero is Ranveer Singh garu, sorry, Ranbir Kapoor Garu."

Meanwhile, The camera zoomed in on Ranbir Kapoor’s face after Dil Raju’s slip-up. The star maintained a straight face and showed little reaction. The clip quickly surfaced on social media, where users could not stop laughing at the name mix-up.

Notably, One comment read, "Dil Raju Garu you are right, Ranveer Singh is the best star." Another commented, "This is embarassing." A third internet user wrote, "It's an honest mistake but I can't stop laughing." Another wrote, "He didn't have to say so much truth." One comment read, "What an awkward moment." Some Ranbir followers also expressed anger over Dil Raju’s mix-up. One user wrote, "A little advice to the makers: Never hand over the mic to someone who isn’t well-rehearsed, especially when there’s no teleprompter in place."

The movie also features Lara Dutta, Kajal Aggarwal, Rakul Preet Singh, Anupam Kher, Vivek Oberoi, Kunal Kapoor, Arun Govil, Sheeba Chaddha, Adinath Kothare and Shobana, among others, in key roles.

Ramayana: Part One is scheduled to rollout in theatres worldwide on November 5, 2026, while the second instalment is slated for Diwali 2027.

body: Here's the latest update from the Bollywood world:

title: Rakesh Bedi speculates on extortion angle in Tiger Shroff attack, urges government action to restore film industry's confidence
body: Here's the latest update from the Bollywood world:

Bollywood star Tiger Shroff was fired at in Mumbai’s Juhu area on Sunday. The incident sparked conversations about star safety. In an interview with Times Now, Dhurandhar star Rakesh Bedi expressed shock over the incident and urged the government to take action to maintain confidence in the movie industry.

Adding to this, Rakesh Bedi is shocked by Tiger Shroff's shooting incident. Rakesh Bedi is shocked by shooting attack on Tiger Shroff Rakesh opened up that Tiger’s father, star Jackie Shroff, was an old friend and described both father and son as people who stayed away from row. He shared, "Jackie is an old friend of mine, and we have worked together. He is a very non-controversial, happy go lucky person and so is his son. So, this is very shocking for the movie industry because that man has not been involved in anything as such. So I don't know if there's anything that is not visible to the eye. I do not know what Tiger’s connection was or whether he was going to work with Salman Khan in a movie. I have no idea at all."

Meanwhile, Rakesh shared he believed money was the main issue and that the incident could, to some extent, be a case of extortion. However, he added that ideology could also play a role, as some people might target someone they believed did not align with their thinking.

Notably, The star added, "This is a very serious matter. These are not merely verbal threats, where someone comes and says they will kill you or do something to you and then walks away. Shots have been fired and such incidents have happened before. The police, the government, and the relevant agencies must look into this and determine what can be done to maintain confidence in the movie industry and maintain law and order in the city."

As per the latest buzz, Rakesh also spoke about how such incidents could affect celebrities in their everyday lives. He shared that constantly having to consider security arrangements, whether to go out and what time to leave could become a major restriction, forcing them to live in constant fear and making it difficult for them to work in such an environment.

In further updates, The incident took place at around 7 pm when the star was leaving Pushpa Narsee Park after playing football. Three motorcycle-borne assailants allegedly opened fire at his BMW, with at least five rounds fired at the vehicle. Tiger escaped with minor abrasions and no gunshot injuries, while his driver and a bystander sustained injuries. They were taken to hospital for treatment. Mumbai Police have arrested three suspects in connection with the firing and are investigating the motive behind the attack.

title: Yash urges fans not to nitpick VFX in Ramayana: ‘It will never happen again if we lose people like Namit Malhotra now’
body: Here's the latest update from the Bollywood world:

The Ramayana team of late held a grand pre-rollout event in Hyderabad where Yash urged audiences to support the movie and avoid nitpicking over its visual effects, saying India needs to protect filmmakers who dare to take Indian cinema to a global platform. Speaking at the event, the star lauded producer Namit Malhotra ’s passion and ambition, revealing that their conversations inspired him to join the movie as Ravana and a producing partner.

Adding to this, Yash made a request to followers at Ramayana pre-rollout event. Yash makes a special request to followers ahead of Ramayana's rollout Yash shared he had a great time working with director Nitesh Tiwari and expressed admiration for his straightforward approach to filmmaking. He also lauded Namit and made a special request to audiences ahead of the movie’s rollout.

Meanwhile, The star shared, “Anybody can dream of making a movie, but only a few people will have that kind of passion, dedication, determination and madness. As an Indian, I am telling you, we need to protect this guy. It's our responsibility because this man was comfortably doing business in LA. Every time I met him, he always spoke about one thing, ‘We all are doing so much and Indians have done so much, but we should do something for our Indian movie industry and I want to do it. I am getting Oscars, but I am not happy. I want our country to be placed at that level and that's the day I am going to be happy.’ This is what he told me.”

Notably, Yash opened up that Namit’s words inspired him to collaborate with the producer on Ramayana, in which he plays Ravana and serves as a producing partner. He then made a special request to followers, saying, “Sometimes when someone tries to do things like this, he has gambled his reputation and money to put this movie on a global platform. Please don't try to find small faults in the VFX, this and that. It will never happen again if we lose people like him now. It will take more years; we will go back in time. Let's see the movie with an open mind. He has always taken every feedback and criticism and tried to do it better. I request you from my side, for once, if you like the movie, let's come together and show the world.”

As per the latest buzz, When the first glimpse of Ranbir Kapoor’s character in Ramayana was unveiled, the visual effects drew criticism online, with some viewers also calling Ranbir a misfit for the role of Lord Rama. The movie’s asuras were criticised for their cartoonish, video game-like appearance. However, the trailer impressed many followers, with several noticing improvements in the visual effects.

In further updates, Directed by Nitesh Tiwari, Ramayana is a mythological epic based on the ancient Sanskrit text by Valmiki, which chronicles the life and trials of Prince Rama of Ayodhya. The movie stars Ranbir Kapoor as Lord Rama, Sai Pallavi as Sita, Ravi Dubey as Lakshman, Arun Govil as King Dasharath, Sunny Deol as Hanuman, and Yash as Ravana. The cast also includes Kajal Aggarwal, Rakul Preet Singh, Lara Dutta, Sheeba Chaddha, Adinath Kothare, Sonal Jha, Vivek Oberoi, Kunal Kapoor and Faisal Malik, among others.
On top of that, Mounted on a reported budget of ₹ 4,000 crore rupees, the movie is set to be rolled out in two parts, with the first instalment scheduled to arrive in cinemas on November 5, 2026.

title: Yami Gautam brings Nayyi Navelli plot from reel to real; to perform Ravan Vadh at Delhi's Luv Kush Ramleela on Dussehra
body: Here's the latest update from the Bollywood world:

The grand Dussehra celebrations at the historic Red Fort Ground in Delhi will witness a special moment today (October 20) as National Award-winning Bollywood star Yami Gautam performs the symbolic Ravan Vadh at the renowned Luv Kush Ramleela, marking the triumph of good over evil.

Adding to this, Yami Gautam will perform the Ravan Vadh at Delhi's historic Luv Kush Ramleela. Yami Gautam to perform Ravan Vadh Interestingly, Yami Gautam was of late seen performing Ravan Vadh in a scene from her latest movie, Nayyi Navelli . Now, bringing that cinematic moment to life, the star will shoot the symbolic arrow at Ravana in front of thousands of spectators at Delhi's iconic Luv Kush Ramleela.

Meanwhile, Sharing details about this year's celebrations, Arjun Kumar, President of the Luv Kush Ramleela Committee, shared, “The theme of our Ramleela this year is 'Respect for Women'. We believe that a woman is not only a symbol of love, compassion and strength but also possesses the courage to stand against injustice and social evils. With this thought, we have invited National Award-winning star Yami Gautam to perform Ravan Vadh this Dussehra. She will represent the women of Delhi and the entire nation, delivering a powerful message that women play an equally significant role in the victory of good over evil.”

Notably, Arjun Kumar further emphasised that Ravana is not merely a mythological character but also symbolises arrogance, injustice and the evils prevailing in society. By having a woman perform the symbolic Ravan Vadh this year, the committee aims to send a strong and positive message about women's empowerment, dignity and respect.

body: Here's the latest protest news from across India:

CJP National Organisation In-charge Ajinkya Shinde along with CJP Co-Conveners Ashutosh Ranka and Saurav Das inside the Parliament Street Police Station, in New Delhi. Delhi protest LIVE: The judicial custody of Cockroach Janata Party (CJP) leaders Saurav Das and Ashutosh Ranka was extended by two days as a new Special Executive Magistrate (SEM) heard the case on Monday. The duo have been in jail since October 13, after they breached security and entered Jantar Mantar , a day after the site was de-notified as a protest site. ...Read More

Adding to this, Additionally, the Jantar Mantar trespassing case has also been transferred to the Crime Branch. Delhi Police cites public order concerns over Das, Ranka’s rollout Delhi Police on Monday sought further custody of the duo, claiming their rollout could disrupt “peace and tranquility.” However, CJP ’s legal team countered the apprehension, arguing that there was not an iota of evidence to suggest that the duo posed any threat or that their rollout would disturb public order. On the day of their detention, Ranka had shared a video on his X handle showing himself, Das and the outfit's national organisation in-charge, Ajinkya Shinde, climbing the locked gates and entering the venue. Police personnel present at the site then intervened and took hold of them. Last week, the SEM sent the duo to five days of judicial custody after the Delhi Police argued that “there was a presumption that the accused might carry out a crime” if rolled out. CJP founder Abhijeet Dipke on Monday shared party co-convenors Saurav Das and Ashutosh Ranka remained undeterred despite spending days in jail, saying they walked into court with smiles on their faces and their spirits unbroken. "Ashu and Saurav’s first crime was waving the Tiranga at Jantar Mantar. Their second crime? Refusing to back down. Even after five days in jail, they walked into court with smiles on their faces, their spirits unbroken," Dipke shared in a post on X. Dipke on PM Modi In a lengthy Instagram post, Dipke accused Prime Minister Narendra Modi of using the state machinery to intimidate young protesters and suppress dissent. He questioned the government's decision to keep 27-year-old Saurav Das and 30-year-old Ashutosh Ranka in custody for waving the Tricolour at Jantar Mantar. "The great Vishwaguru Narendra Modi must be feeling very strong keeping 26-27-year-old Saurabh Das in jail and keeping 30-year-old Ashutosh behind bars. This is what strength looks like? Hiding behind the police, hiding behind the courts, is this Narendra Modi's strength?" he shared. Dipke alleged that the duo had been denied timely hearings, with proceedings repeatedly postponed. He accused Modi of projecting strength by keeping young protesters behind bars and deploying the police and security forces against those opposing his government.

Meanwhile, Delhi protest LIVE: Ranka and Das were produced before a special executive magistrate (SEM) at the Mandir Marg police station. In a two-page order, seen by HT, the SEM shared that they had “deliberately breached” their October 11 bonds and the grounds of apprehension suggested that the duo’s conduct “is not above board; rather it shows no respect for law and their habitualness in calling protest at de-notified areas”.

Notably, “Considering the imminent apprehension, past conduct of the respondent and the submissions advanced on both sides, I deem it fit that an opportunity be given to the respondents to file and place on record their submissions in writing within 2 days, with advance copy to the Investigating Officer,” the order shared.

As per the latest buzz, Delhi protest live: Cockroach Janta Party convenors Saurav Das and Ashutosh Ranka have been in custody since October 13. The judicial custody was extended by two days on October 19. The two, who had been arrested for trespassing on the of late de-notified Jantar Mantar .

Later, Tiger met Maharashtra Deputy Chief Minister Eknath Shinde. Visuals from their meeting showed bandages on the star’s hand and chest.

As per the latest buzz, The three assailants who allegedly shot at Tiger outside a football ground in Juhu were arrested by Rajasthan Police on Monday afternoon. title: Bombay High Court directs makers of Tu Hai Meri Kiran to deposit Rs. 8.85 crores before release
body: Here's the latest box office buzz making the rounds:
The movie is scheduled to rollout in cinemas on October 23.

Adding to this, Justice Amit Borkar substantially allowed AND Movie Products LLP's petition seeking protection of its investment and contractual rights in the movie. The Court observed that stopping the movie's rollout entirely would disregard the money and effort invested in its production. However, it also shared that the movie should not be commercially exploited without securing the co-producer's investment.

Meanwhile, The dispute stems from a co-production agreement signed on March 27, 2024, under which both parties agreed to contribute Rs. 7.50 crore rupees each, plus GST, towards a movie budget of Rs. 15 crores plus GST. AND Movie Products shared that it invested Rs. 8.85 crore rupees between March 2024 and January 2025 but did not receive repayment as agreed.

Notably, Under the agreement, Echelon was required to repay the investment within 13 months of signing the contract or three weeks before the movie's first rollout, whichever came earlier. The Court held that the repayment deadline expired on April 27, 2025, and the later announcement of the movie's rollout date could not extend it.

As per the latest buzz, The dispute escalated after a cheque for Rs. 7.50 crores issued by Echelon through Vishal Rana was dishonoured in January 2026. AND Movie Products subsequently approached the High Court after the movie's October rollout was revealed.

In further updates, Echelon argued that repayment depended on the movie's earnings and pointed to AND Movie Products' participation in Instagram promotions. However, the Court held that promotional activities did not waive the repayment obligation or remove the requirement for the co-producer's consent before third-party exploitation agreements could be signed.

On top of that, The Court directed Echelon to deposit Rs. 8.85 crores, with 15% annual interest calculated from the respective investment dates, within three working days. If it fails to comply, the movie cannot be commercially exploited.

Echelon must also disclose its existing and proposed exploitation agreements, maintain movie revenues in a separate designated account and provide regular accounts. The company has been directed to obtain AND Movie Products' contractual consent before entering into exploitation agreements and correct or withdraw publicity credits that do not comply with the agreed producer credits.

title: Nepal blocks Ayushmann Khurrana and Sara Ali Khan’s Udta Teer, denies permission for public screening
body: Here's the latest update from the Bollywood world:

Ayushmann Khurrana and Sara Ali Khan ’s soon-to-release Hindi movie Udta Teer will not be screened publicly in Nepal for now, after the country’s Ministry of Communications and Information Technology refused to grant it permission for exhibition. The decision follows a review by Nepal’s Central Movie Censor Board, which found the movie in violation of a provision of the country’s cinema law. The authorities have not yet revealed what exactly prompted the move.

Adding to this, Bollywood actors Sara Ali Khan and Ayushmann Khurrana attend the trailer launch of their soon-to-release Hindi-language movie 'Udta Teer' in Mumbai on September 23, 2026. (Photo by SUJIT JAISWAL / AFP) (AFP) Why has Nepal blocked Udta Teer? According to India Today, a letter was issued by the ministry’s Audio-Visual and Broadcasting Division in which the Central Movie Censor Board examined the movie on Ashwin 19, 2083, as per the Nepali calendar. Following the review, the board concluded that the movie’s production violated Section 8(3) of the National Cinema (Production, Exhibition and Distribution) Act, 2026. Based on the board’s findings, the ministry decided against granting permission for the movie’s public screening in the country.

Meanwhile, The ministry sent the notice to National Cinema Group Nepal Pvt. Ltd., which is based in Aloknagar, Kathmandu. Signed by branch officer Vishal Bhandari, the letter is dated 2083-06-30 in the Nepali calendar and carries the subject line "Regarding permission for public exhibition."

Notably, The communication formally informs the company that the movie will not be allowed a public rollout in Nepal. It refers to Section 8(3) of the Act as the basis for the decision, reiterating the censor board’s finding that the movie’s production did not comply with the provision.

As per the latest buzz, Udta Teer revolves around a Pakistani spy named Bilal Ahmad (Ayushmann), who enters India and suffers from memory loss after an accident, mistakenly believing he is an Indian spy. Responding to a question at the trailer launch about the role, he shared, “It was part of the script. As an star, you are ready to do anything. This is a spy comedy, a patriotic comedy, and a genre bender. I do what the script demands; I'm a director's baby. It is a fantastic script.”

In further updates, Calling the role as ‘the most difficult character’ because of how he had to stay straight-faced amid all the chaos and comedy happening around him. The star shared, “It is the most difficult character because things were happening around him. I had to have that straight face, though there were moments when I felt like laughing, but I couldn't. I had to be normal while there was chaos happening around me.”

On top of that, Akash A Kaushik makes his directorial debut with Udta Teer, which features Ayushmann, Sara, Rahul Bose, Ram Kapoor, Suhail Nayyar, Gulshan Grover, Mukul Dev, Raghubir Yadav, Brijendra Kala, Sandeep Anand, Supriya Pilgaonkar and Smita Tambe in key roles. The movie arrives in cinemas on October 23, 2026.

title: Indian embassy in Italy issues advisory, urges citizens to avoid protest sites, crowded areas
body: Here's the latest protest news from across India:

The Indian embassy in Italy has issued a safety advisory for Indian nationals amid protests over rising living costs and poor public services, some of which turned violent over the weekend. The embassy has urged Indians to avoid crowded areas and protest sites, exercise caution and follow local news for updates.

Adding to this, People sit at an outdoor cafe near a shattered glass panel following weekend clashes between police and protesters in Milan, Italy, October 19, 2026. (REUTERS) “Indian nationals are advised to exercise caution, avoid crowded areas and locations where protests are taking place, and follow local news about such events,” the advisory rolled out on Monday shared.
Meanwhile, “In case of any emergency, Indian nationals can contact the Embassy of India in Rome at +39 331 614 2085 or the Consulate General of India in Milan at +39 3881647527,” it added.

Notably, The advisory comes after Milan police clashed with protesters throwing stones and looting shops during demonstrations against poor services and the rising cost of living on Sunday. The clashes followed similar unrest in several Italian cities a day earlier.

As per the latest buzz, Police in riot gear fired tear gas and used water cannons after several hundred hooded protesters broke shop windows and set bins on fire in the area near central Piazza Duomo, sources with knowledge of the investigation told Reuters.
In further updates, The demonstrations escalated as protesters engaged in acts of vandalism, prompting police to intervene to disperse the crowds and restore order in the area.
On top of that, More than 60 protesters were taken to the police station for further checks, the sources added.
A total of 28 protesters were arrested after similar clashes erupted on Saturday in northern cities, including Milan, Bologna, Brescia, Bergamo and Turin, according to a police report on Sunday.

title: Tiger Shroff firing sparks outrage: Bollywood reacts as Vidyut Jammwal questions security, Ram Gopal Varma calls it never-before-seen phenomenon
body: Here's the latest update from the Bollywood world:

A firing incident involving Tiger Shroff has shaken the industry and beyond. The firing took place around 7 pm on Sunday in Mumbai, when the Bollywood star was leaving a football club. A video of the incident showed the attackers shooting at his car from close range. While the star escaped unhurt, his driver and a bystander sustained injuries. Maharashtra Deputy Chief Minister Eknath Shinde later shared Tiger had suffered gunpowder burns on his right hand.

Adding to this, Tiger Shroff firing leaves Bollywood shaken: Vidyut Jammwal questions security, celebs demand strict action. (PTI) Police registered a case under Sections 109(1) and 3(5) of the Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita and Sections 3 and 25 of the Arms Act. The attack has sparked concern across the movie industry, with several actors and filmmakers calling for strict action and raising questions about the safety of public figures. Vidyut Jammwal urged the Mumbai Police to ensure such an incident does not happen again, while filmmaker Rahul Dholakia questioned the law and order situation, asking who would be held accountable for criminals threatening Bollywood and opening fire on the streets.

Meanwhile, Vidyut Jammwal posted on Instagram on Monday to express his concern over the firing incident involving Tiger Shroff. Calling Tiger "the most fearless person" he knows, the star questioned the security arrangements and urged the Mumbai Police to ensure such an incident never happens again. “I would like to tell the Mumbai Police: you have provided him with security, but this must never happen again. If a lapse like this occurs, then you are the ones at fault,” he shared.

Notably, Vidyut also wondered why the followers present at the scene had not chased the attackers. He ended the video with a heartfelt message for Tiger, speaking about their friendship and shared love for the Bajrang Baan. “Tiger, my friend, we both share a favourite, the Bajrang Baan. Just keep listening to it. Whenever I feel truly alone, I listen to the Bajrang Baan. I know you listen to it too. I love you, brother.”

As per the latest buzz, View this post on Instagram Bollywood reacts Filmmaker Rahul Dholakia questioned the state of law and order after the firing incident, asking why criminals continued to threaten people and target innocents. Expressing his anger on X (formerly Twitter), he wrote, “The ones who are harmless are sent to jail - the ones who are criminals are shooting innocents on the street! A gangster who is in Jail openly threatens Bollywood and shoots at will -and we just allow fear to spread! Who is answerable??”

In further updates, Star-politician Ravi Kishan also expressed concern over the attack, saying he trusted the Maharashtra Police to investigate the case and punish those responsible. In conversation with the media, he shared, “It is very sad. It is a matter of great concern and a matter for investigation. We have full faith in the Maharashtra Police. An investigation will take place, and those found guilty will receive the harshest possible punishment.” Describing Tiger as “a very innocent person”, Ravi added, “I pray to Mahadev and Mata Rani to protect him.”

On top of that, Veteran star Rakesh Bedi shared the shooting had left the movie industry shocked, especially since he believed neither Tiger nor his father, Jackie Shroff, had been involved in any row that could explain the attack. In conversation with Times Now, he shared, "Jackie is an old friend of mine, and we have worked together. He is a very non-controversial, happy go lucky person and so is his son. So, this is very shocking for the movie industry because that man has not been involved in anything as such," he shared.

He also stressed that the incident could not be dismissed as another threat, as shots had actually been fired at the star's car. He urged the authorities to take the matter seriously and ensure the movie industry felt safe. He added, “This is a very serious matter. These are not merely verbal threats... Shots have been fired and such incidents have happened before. The police, the government, and the relevant agencies must look into this and determine what can be done to maintain confidence in the movie industry and maintain law and order in the city.”

title: Shanaya Kapoor's debut web show Student Of The Year: After Dark to premiere November 13 on JioHotstar

With Reema’s genre-defying direction and Shanaya’s powerful double-role performance, we’re setting the stage for something spectacular. Shanaya isn’t just stepping into the spotlight; she’s shattering it, and the first look is just the tip of the iceberg”, shared Karan Johar, Founder & Managing Director of Dharmatic Entertainment.

As per the latest buzz, “At Dharmatic, we champion stories that evolve with the times, and finding a partner like JioHotstar, who shares that creative ethos, is nothing short of remarkable. Our soon-to-release project, Student of the Year: After Dark Web Series, is a testament to this shared vision. It’s not just a reboot, but a bold, genre-defying reimagining for a new generation”, shared Apoorva Mehta, CEO & Managing Director for Dharmatic Entertainment.

In further updates, Director of the series, Reema Maya, who is lauded for her daring narratives, brings her signature realism to this high-gloss world. “This isn’t going to be what you expect. It is Student Of The Year, stripped to its bones and reimagined as a thriller competition web series. Karan Johar has put his faith in my voice and vision, and I’m excited to have fun with this genre. The web series format is giving us a wide canvas for the conversations we want to have with our youth. We had so much fun with the music of the show. The cast is young and incredibly talented! Shanaya is a director’s star - prepared and hardworking.”

On top of that, “Student Of The Year: After Dark Web Series for me is more than just a project; it’s a bold statement. Portraying this character in a contrasting manner is a deliberate choice to challenge expectations and redefine what audiences anticipate from mainstream storytelling. The role is layered, flawed, and unapologetically real. Stepping into her world has been the most challenging and a rewarding experience”, says the enigmatic Shanaya Kapoor.

title: After a soaring festival run, Sayani Gupta’s Aasmani heads to 5 more film festivals in next two weeks
body: Here's the latest update from the Bollywood world:
Aasmani is produced by Sayani Gupta Movies, Nikkhil Advani under Sumitra Gupta Foundation for Arts, and Dia Mirza and Ananya Rane under One India Stories.

Adding to this, It just played at the International Movie Festival of South Asia (IFFSA) in Toronto. The movie was an official selection, with Sayani winning the South Asian Screen Excellence Award. This also coincided with her birthday as she attended as the Guest of Honour and her Masterclass: Becoming a Star, Remaining an Star moderated by Anup Singh Batla, director of Qissa and The Song of Scorpions with Irrfan Khan.
Meanwhile, Sayani also won the Leadership award in Eccellence in Films at iSAFF Vancouver where Aasmani won Best movie honourable mention Excellence in short Filmmaking.

Notably, It also won Best movie at Atlanta Indian Movie Festival and Best Director & Best Child star in Boston. It played at 9 festivals last month, including the DC South Asian, Kerala IDSFFK, Tokyo International Short Movie Festival, Bangalore International Short FF (Oscar-Qualifying), and Chicago South Asian Movie Festival to name a few.
As per the latest buzz, Aasmani has five more official selections lined up in the coming weeks, across the US, Canada, Ukraine and India.

In further updates, First up is the 21st Tasveer Movie Festival in Seattle, running from October 13 to 18. Tasveer is the world's only Oscar-qualifying South Asian movie festival. Aasmani also played at BISFF Bangalore which is India's only Oscar Qualifying festival. After that, the movie will screen at the 55th Molodist Kyiv International Movie Festival in Ukraine, between October 24th and November 1. Right after, the movie will also screen at the 22nd annual LA Femme International Movie Festival, taking place from October 22 to 25 in Los Angeles. After Vancouver and Toronto, Aasmani is playing at a third festival in Canada: the 30th Vancouver Asian Movie Festival (VAFF) from November 5-14th.
On top of that, Sayani returns to India for the 15th Dharamshala International Movie Festival, held from October 29 to November 1 at the Tibetan Children's Village in the Himalayan foothills.

With the movie winning at almost every festival, while Sayani herself was honoured with the iSAFF (Vancouver) Leadership in Movie Award and Screen Excellence at IFFSA, Toronto, it has been a busy year for the first-time writer/director, with more festival selections lined up till March 2027.

title: Tiger Shroff Firing Incident: Three accused arrested by Kota police while travelling on Pune-Jaipur express
body: Here's the latest update from the Bollywood world:
Kota SP Tejaswani Gautam shared the suspects were caught within 15 minutes of receiving information and would be handed over to Mumbai Police.

Adding to this, Speaking about the operation with ANI, Kota SP Tejaswani Gautam shared the police received information about the suspects on Monday morning and acted swiftly to apprehend them. She shared, "This morning, we received information, prompting us to activate our team. We learned that the three primary suspects involved in the firing were travelling by train and were due to arrive in Kota. Acting on this information, our team, within just 15 minutes, set a trap and thoroughly searched the entire train. Through this swift action by the Kota City Police, we have apprehended all three suspects responsible for the firing. We will soon hand the suspects over to the Mumbai Police. The names of these three individuals are: Rehan, alias Sukka, from Sonipat, Haryana; Hritik Kurmi, alias Roshan, from Begusarai, Bihar, who had been residing in Mumbai, Maharashtra, for the past few years; and one minor. We have apprehended and detained all three, and we will now hand them over to the Mumbai Police."

Meanwhile, Gautam further explained that the police covered exit points, platforms and other locations to apprehend the suspects. The team received information at around 9:45 am, and the Mumbai Police have since arrived to take custody of the accused.

Notably, Providing details of the preliminary questioning, Gautam shared, "Based on preliminary questioning, one of the accused is a Rapido rider. Further detailed interrogation will provide more clarity. The other two, one of whom is a minor and the other, Rehan, work as labourers in Sonipat. Preliminary questioning opened up that they intended to travel to Delhi by this train and then escape to Nepal from there. Rehan had previously been in contact with Anil Pandit..."

As per the latest buzz, The firing incident took place at around 7 pm on Sunday when Tiger Shroff was leaving a football club in Mumbai's Juhu area. According to Mumbai Police, the accused allegedly opened fire at the star's car. While Tiger escaped direct gunshot injuries, his driver sustained injuries in the incident.

In further updates, Sources in the Mumbai Police Crime Branch indicated that the attack may have been planned after the accused monitored the star's movements. The shooters allegedly knew that Tiger regularly visited the Juhu football ground on Sundays and had conducted reconnaissance before carrying out the attack. Following the firing, they as per reports travelled along SV Road through Vile Parle and Andheri, abandoned their motorcycle near Andheri West railway station and boarded a train towards Borivali. Preliminary intelligence suggested that the suspects subsequently crossed the Maharashtra border to evade law enforcement.

On top of that, Maharashtra Deputy Chief Minister Eknath Shinde visited Tiger's residence on Sunday night following the incident. He shared the star had sustained injuries to his left hand from gunpowder and glass fragments. Shinde also shared that Tiger and his mother, Ayesha Shroff, were shaken by the incident and assured them of the state government's support.

Meanwhile, security outside Salman Khan's residence at Galaxy Apartments in Mumbai's Bandra area has been tightened following the firing incident. Police personnel wearing bulletproof jackets, along with police vehicles, were seen outside the star's residence.
