title: Ranbir Kapoor, Yash’s Ramayana set for historic world premiere at Academy Museum, guests asked to wear traditional attire | Exclusive
body: Here's the latest update from the Bollywood world:

Ranbir Kapoor -starrer Ramayana is set to make its mark in Hollywood as one of the few Indian films to host its world premiere at the prestigious Academy Museum of Motion Pictures’ David Geffen Theatre in Los Angeles. The grand premiere is scheduled for October 27.

Adding to this, Ramayana will rollout worldwide on November 5. Ramayana’s world premiere in Los Angeles The makers have officially revealed the movie’s grand world premiere in Los Angeles on October 27. The event will take place in the evening at the iconic Academy Museum of Motion Pictures, a prominent institution dedicated to celebrating the history, art and science of filmmaking.

Meanwhile, The museum has hosted several prestigious global events and Oscar-related celebrations over the years, further cementing its position as a landmark in the international movie industry. The premiere marks a significant moment for Ramayana as the makers prepare to introduce their ambitious Indian epic to an international audience.

Notably, With the celebrations coinciding with Diwali , the makers are also bringing India's festive spirit to Los Angeles. Guests have been requested to arrive in traditional Indian festive attire for their red-carpet appearances. The premiere will host a full-capacity audience of 945 guests, including leading Hollywood figures, filmmakers, international press and prominent members of the movie industry. The movie will be screened in 3D.

As per the latest buzz, Directed by Nitesh Tiwari and produced by Namit Malhotra’s Prime Focus Studios in collaboration with DNEG and Yash’s Monster Mind Creations, Ramayana is envisioned as a two-part cinematic epic. The first instalment is scheduled for worldwide rollout on November 5, 2026, followed by the second part during Diwali 2027.

In further updates, The movie will rollout in Hindi, Tamil, Telugu, Kannada and Malayalam. It is also set for an IMAX rollout, with Sony Pictures handling global distribution outside India and Dharma Productions distributing the movie in the Hindi-speaking market.

On top of that, Of late, Yash verified that the combined budget for both parts of Ramayana stands at ₹ 4,000 crore rupees. The star and producer also explained why the makers have been vocal about the scale of the ambitious project.

Speaking at the movie's new trailer launch in Bengaluru, he shared, “I know that Namit's statement went widely shared on social media. In India, there is a problem. People don't like it when you talk confidently. That's what happened with Namit's statement. But in the West, it's the total opposite. If you tell them we have made a good movie in a humble manner, they will dismiss our movie as a small project. That's exactly why Namit has confidently shared that this movie is mounted on ₹ 4,000 crore rupees. We need to prove the strength of the Indian movie industry to the global market."

body: Here's the latest update from the Bollywood world:

A court in Jhansi, Uttar Pradesh, has issued a non-bailable warrant against star Rakhi Sawant in a 2010 suicide case linked to alleged insulting remarks she made against a local resident on her television show, a government lawyer shared on Saturday.

Adding to this, Rakhi Sawant in legal trouble over comments she made on her TV show Rakhi Ka Insaaf. District Government Counsel (Crime) Mridul Kant Srivastava shared Civil Judge (Junior Division) Anjali issued the warrant on Friday after Rakhi repeatedly failed to appear before the court.

Meanwhile, According to PTI, the case relates to Laxman Ahirwar, a resident of the Hansari Prem Nagar area in Jhansi, who allegedly committed suicide on November 10, 2010, after being humiliated by remarks made by Rakhi on her television show, Rakhi Ka Insaaf, the lawyer shared.

Notably, Laxman's mother, Savitri, had lodged a complaint at the Prem Nagar police station, alleging that Rakhi had used insulting and objectionable language against her son during an episode of the show aired in October 2010.

As per the latest buzz, According to the prosecution, Laxman and his wife, Anita, who hailed from Rajgarh, had been invited to the show following marital discord. Anita had returned to her parental home after disputes between the couple.
In further updates, The next hearing in the case has been scheduled for December 1, Srivastava shared.

On top of that, Rakhi was of late in the news for her public comments on Govinda and Sunita Ahuja's marriage. She also reacted to his rumoured relationship with co-star Komal Rani Swarnkar. In conversation with the paparazzi earlier this month, Rakhi shared she was unhappy with Govinda for neglecting his wife. She shared, “Govinda ji, pura desh naaraz hai aapse (Govinda ji, the whole nation is upset with you). The woman who married you and gave birth to your two kids, who has been with you for 40 years, you left her. And who is this Komal?”

Rakhi then claimed that Komal had been badmouthing her and warned her against confronting her. She shared in Hindi, “She is badmouthing me and talking trash about other celebrities, too. Chichi Bhaiya is the one who gave her these wings. Listen, don't mess with me. I am not Sunita; I will tear you to shreds.” Rakhi went on to call Komal a “pati chor (husband stealer)”.

title: Vicky Kaushal adds garba twist to Tauba Tauba, Kriti Sanon dances to Param Sundari at Jamnagar Navratri celebration
body: Here's the latest update from the Bollywood world:

After Sidharth Malhotra , Varun Dhawan and Shahid Kapoor, actors Kriti Sanon and Vicky Kaushal joined the star-studded lineup at the Reliance Jamnagar Navratri celebrations. Videos and photos of the actors performing at the garba event have been circulating on social media.

Adding to this, Vicky Kaushal and Kriti Sanon at Jamnagar Navratri celebration. Vicky Kaushal adds a garba twist to Tauba Tauba Vicky performed on Saturday, Day 7 of Navratri, and a video of him dancing to his hit track Tauba Tauba with a garba twist has gone widely shared on social media. He was seen wearing black pants and a traditional jacket for the performance. The star appeared to be in his element as he brought his signature moves to the festive stage. Vicky had also shared a poster of the event on his Instagram story.

Meanwhile, Kriti Sanon performed on Day 6 of Navratri at the Reliance township. Dressed in a pink lehenga set, the star set the stage on fire with performances of her hit songs, including Param Sundari and Tere Baaton Mein Aisa Uljha Jiya. Kriti later thanked the audience and shared how much she enjoyed dancing garba with the people of Jamnagar, and also noted that this was her first visit to Jamnagar.

Notably, Several Bollywood stars have been part of the Jamnagar Navratri celebrations this year. Varun Dhawan performed on Day 1, while Malaika Arora took to the stage on Day 3. Shahid Kapoor also entertained the audience with his performance on Day 5. Sidharth Malhotra and Taapsee Pannu had also performed at the Jamnagar Navratri celebration on day 2.

As per the latest buzz, Vicky Kaushal is gearing up for his next major project, Sanjay Leela Bhansali’s Love & War, which also stars Ranbir Kapoor and Alia Bhatt. The movie is among his much-anticipated projects and is scheduled for rollout on January 21, 2027. Vicky will also star in Mahavatar, directed by Amar Kaushik. The soon-to-release mythological drama will feature Vicky as Lord Chiranjeevi Parashurama, the eternal warrior of dharma. The star is expected to begin work on the mythological movie after wrapping up Love & War.

In further updates, Kriti Sanon, meanwhile, was last seen in Cocktail 2, directed by Homi Adajania and co-starring Shahid Kapoor and Rashmika Mandanna. The romantic drama was rolled out in June 2026. Kriti is as per reports set to reunite with Dinesh Vijan's Maddock Films for an untitled horror movie. The project is expected to see her explore a darker genre after her previous collaborations with the production house, including Bhediya and Cocktail 2.

On top of that, Vibha Maru is an Assistant Editor with Hindustan Times Entertainment, based in Delhi. With a decade of experience across digital and print media, she covers Bollywood, Hollywood and web shows. A self-confessed cinephile who breathes Hindi cinema, Vibha can often be found sacrificing sleep after binge-watching films and web series. Though she holds a Commerce degree, she discovered her true calling in journalism after enrolling at the Indian Institute of Mass Communication (IIMC). She began her career covering Delhi's cultural scene, food, nightlife, concerts, and city life at The Times of India, before moving into full-time entertainment journalism with India Today. At India Today, Vibha interviewed some of the biggest names in Bollywood and television while carving a niche for herself through movie reviews, opinion pieces, nostalgic features, star interviews, and trend-driven stories. She later brought her storytelling and editorial expertise to The Indian Express, where she continued to deepen her understanding of cinema through long-form entertainment explainers, retrospectives and feature writing. Now, as Assistant Editor at Hindustan Times Entertainment, Vibha continues to chronicle the world of movies and pop culture. Her work spans breaking entertainment news, exclusive interviews, star features, and stories that capture the conversations shaping Indian cinema. Read More

title: Salman Khan reveals maternal grandfather opposed Salim Khan’s marriage to Salma Khan, didn’t speak to him for 5 years
body: Here's the latest update from the Bollywood world:

While in conversation with contestants on Bigg Boss , Salman Khan often ends up sharing anecdotes from his personal life. Of late, the star recalled how his maternal grandfather did not speak to his father, screenwriter Salim Khan , for years because he disapproved of his marriage to Salman’s mother, Salma Khan.

Adding to this, Salman Khan spoke about his parents, Salim Khan and Salma Khan's marriage. Salman apologises to Salim Khan During the episode, Salman was speaking about the show’s zero-tolerance policy and how contestants often regret their actions. Talking about his personal life, the star opened up that he had of late apologised to his father and asked for his forgiveness if he had ever failed him or shared anything that hurt him.

Meanwhile, Salman went on to share the story of his maternal grandfather, who was upset about Salma’s marriage to Salim Khan. The star explained that his grandfather’s objection was not religious but stemmed from concerns about his daughter marrying someone from the movie industry.

Notably, He shared, “Let me tell you, when my parents got married, there was no religious connotation. Only my (maternal) grandfather was upset because my mom was marrying a good-looking man who aspires to be an star. His objection was that she was getting married to someone from the movie industry. My mom’s siblings were okay with this. They liked my father, but my grandfather wondered how his daughter would live in that atmosphere.”

As per the latest buzz, The star added, “He didn’t speak to my father for five years. When Sohail was born, my nana came from Mahim to Bandra with sweets. He expressed his regret over missing his grandchildren growing up, in conversation with the nicest man ever, because he had something on his mind. He had this regret till his last breath. Once or twice, when mom and dad fought, and mom went back to her house, my nana didn’t let her in. He told her, ‘Go back to your house; you can come anytime, but you will not come here after fighting.’”
In further updates, View this post on Instagram A post shared by JioHotstar Reality (@jiohotstarreality)

On top of that, Salim Khan and Salma Khan’s love story began when Salma, born Sushila Charak, and Salim lived in apartments opposite each other. The two fell in love and got married in 1964. After their marriage, Sushila adopted the name Salma. The couple went on to have four children: Salman, Arbaaz, Sohail Khan, and their daughter Alvira Agnihotri.

Years later, Salim Khan fell in love with star and dancer Helen while he was still married to Salma. The two married in 1981. Salim has spoken about how the decision was initially difficult for his family, while Salman has also recalled that it took time for him and his siblings to accept Helen as part of their family. Over the years, however, the family has spoken about their close bond and the relationship they share today.

title: Screen Ravanas who left a lasting impact: From NT Rama Rao, Arvind Trivedi, Akhilendra Mishra, Nitikin Dheer, Saif Ali Khan to Yash next
body: Here's the latest update from the Bollywood world:

From filmmaker Dadasaheb Phalke ’s Lanka Dahan (1917) to Nitesh Tiwari ’s soon-to-release magnum opus two-part Ramayana, several films and TV shows on Shri Ram have been made, and one character who has outperformed and remained in audience memory has been that of the actors playing Lankapati Ravana.

Adding to this, (Clockwise from top left) Nikitin Dheer, Arvind Trivedi, Yash, NT Rama Rao, Rajniesh Duggal, Saif Ali Khan and Akhilendra Mishra in the role of Ravana From NT Rama Rao to TV’s OG Ravana played by Arvind Trivedi, many actors have essayed the role on screen and brought their own charm to it. Ahead of Dussehra , as we celebrate the victory over evil, we bring you some popular actors and the roles they played Ravana on screen.
Meanwhile, NT Rama Rao , Bhookailas (1958) and Sita Rama Kalyanam (1961)

Notably, One of the biggest icons of cinema, NT Rama Rao is probably the only star who played the roles of Shri Ram and Ravana on the big screen. In Lava Kusha (1963), he played Shri Ram, but prior to that he essayed the role of Ravana in Bhookailas (1958) and Sita Rama Kalyanam (1961). Interestingly, he played the role of Shri Krishna in a record 17 films.

As per the latest buzz, Ramanand Sagar’s cult TV show Ramayana , starring Arun Govil and Deepika Chikhlia in leading roles, saw star Arvind Trivedi playing the role of Ravana. The star became a household name for playing the role and is dubbed the OG Ravana on TV. Later, he was elected to the Lok Sabha, the lower house of the Parliament of India, from Sabarkantha, Gujarat.

In further updates, The star played the role in Anand Sagar’s 2008 Ramayan , where Gurmeet Singh and Debina Bonerjee played Ram-Sita. It is shared that initially Mishra was signed to play the role for six months and had even shot the killing scene and wrapped up his portion, but due to the huge response to the show, the shoot was extended further.

On top of that, Star Narendra Jha essayed the role of Lankapati in the TV serial titled Ravana , which aired from November 2006 and continued for over two years. This remains one of the most popular works of the late star.

title: Saif Ali Khan jokingly complains about not receiving 2 years' worth of ghee he won on Kaun Banega Crorepati yet: ‘Even my cheque's not come’
body: Here's the latest box office buzz making the rounds:

Bollywood star Saif Ali Khan stepped onto the game show Kaun Banega Crorepati, hosted by Amitabh Bachchan, to promote his movie Haiwaan and stepped out a ‘ghee legend’ as followers put it. In the latest episode of Kapil Sharma’s The Great Indian Kapil Show on Netflix, the star jokingly complained that he had not yet received the two-year supply of ghee he won on the show. He added that he didn’t receive his cheque either.

Adding to this, Bollywood star Saif Ali Khan poses for photographs on the sets of Kaun Banega Crorepati. (PTI) Saif Ali Khan wants his KBC cheque and ghee On Kapil’s show, the host remarked on Saif's recent joining of Instagram. He read out a comment in which a fan claimed that the star was so happy to win two years' worth of ghee that he joined the social media platform. Kareena Kapoor , who was also a guest on the show with her husband, clapped and pulled his leg about it too.

Meanwhile, But Saif then joked, “I just want to clear one thing. I haven’t even received the ghee yet,” making Kapil and the audience crack up. He also added, “Even my cheque’s not come,” making Kareena and Archana Puran Singh laugh. “Somebody get him his ghee,” joked one fan, posting a clip of the interaction on Instagram. “He's so unintentionally funny,” wrote another.
Notably, View this post on Instagram A post shared by Namit Malhotra (@eatwatchrepeat)

As per the latest buzz, “Saif needs to have his own show..” thought one fan, while another commented, “I was today years old when i found out there are ppl out there who still don't know abt the Govardhan ghee for 2 saal this is why i came meme.” One fan even tagged Sony TV, writing, “What is this? Your channel promised this poor guy free ghee but he still NOT received & still waiting.”

In further updates, In late September, Saif was a contestant on Amitabh’s KBC with Akshay Kumar. They were there to promote their movie Haiwaan, directed by Priyadarshan. title: Rajpal Yadav thanks Supreme Court for allowing him to present his side in cheque bounce case: ‘Got opportunity after 14 years’
body: Here's the latest update from the Bollywood world:
Star Rajpal Yadav on Saturday expressed his gratitude to the Supreme Court for presenting his side of the argument in the ongoing cheque bounce case against him.

Adding to this, Star Rajpal Yadav at the Supreme Court in connection with a cheque bounce case in which the Court had directed him to deposit ₹2 crore rupees with the Supreme Court registry, in New Delhi on Wednesday. (ANI Video Grab) Rajpal Yadav thanks Supreme Court While talking to ANI, Rajpal shared, "First of all, I want to thank the Supreme Court , because after 14 years, I finally got the opportunity to present my side of the story, and we will follow the Supreme Court's order at any cost. This lawsuit is the most interesting case in Indian history."

Meanwhile, "You've seen one innings for 12 to 14 years, but until the other innings are properly heard, how can this be resolved? If it were a matter of ₹ 5 crore rupees, it could have been settled. The issue is ₹ 22 crore rupees— ₹ 5 crore rupees killed ₹ 22 crore rupees. And even after killing ₹ 22 crore rupees, I am a public star who goes out among the people all over the world. But I shared on the first day that three allegations were made against me, that Rajpal committed fraud of ₹ 5 crore rupees. Rajpal took a loan. Rajpal cheated a businessman. Rajpal doesn't understand how he cheated, given all these checks. I think when there are so many agreements, there is no question of cheating, and someone who has won the hearts of the whole world would commit a ₹ 5 crore rupees fraud? That's mental," shared the star.

Notably, Rajpal also shared he would present his case during mediation in the ongoing cheque bounce case , stressing that he would accept any decision reached after hearing both sides. "Right now, we have the good fortune of mediation (court hearing). I will put my case in mediation; I always want a decision in life, and everyone wants a decision. But whatever decision is made after hearing both sides—that was acceptable before, it is acceptable today, and it will be acceptable tomorrow. One very interesting thing: I want to thank the Supreme Court for saying that there is no drama in court. I have been acting for 42 years, so my stomach is full," shared the star.

As per the latest buzz, "It has happened, but if this is a drama, then either the Governor is creating drama or the opposing party is. The one creating drama needs to be exposed, because I act in reels and I live in reality. I never play around with reality, because I have had the privilege of doing so much in reels," he added.

In further updates, Earlier this month, Rajpal appeared in person before the Supreme Court after the court’s stern warning over his failure to deposit the amount due in a cheque-bounce case. He told the Court that he would pay ₹ 2 crore rupees and showed a demand draft of ₹ 1.15 crore rupees.

On top of that, A buyer of his property, who is to pay the remaining ₹ 85 lakh, was also present in court. A bench of Chief Justice of India (CJI) Surya Kant and Justices Joymalya Bagchi and V Mohana directed Rajpal to deposit ₹ 2 crore rupees towards the amount due to the complainant by October 13.

The case relates to a loan of around ₹ 5 crore rupees allegedly taken by Rajpal from M/s Murli Projects Pvt Ltd in 2010 for his movie Ata Pata Laapata. Seven repayment cheques of ₹ 1.05 crore rupees each were subsequently dishonoured, leading to the cheque-bounce proceedings. The unpaid amount increased over the years with interest and other charges.

title: Ranbir Kapoor makes fans nostalgic as he sings Kabira at Durga puja pandal during Navaratri, Harshdeep Kaur joins him for performance
body: Here's the latest update from the Bollywood world:

On Saturday evening, Ranbir Kapoor visited the North Bombay Sarbojanin Durga Puja pandal in Mumbai during Navaratri. He caught up with his filmmaker friend Ayan Mukerji while there and greeted the paparazzi, even posing for pictures with them. But a moment that caught everyone’s attention was when Ranbir took to the stage with Harshdeep Kaur to sing Kabira from his 2013 hit Yeh Jawaani Hai Deewani, incidentally directed by Ayan.

Adding to this, Videos of Ranbir visiting the puja pandal set up by the Mukerji-Samarth family for nearly eight decades now show him dressed in a red-and-gold kurta paired with white pyjamas. The star could be seen seeking the blessings of Goddess Durga before he folded his hands and posed for a few pictures. He was also seen greeting Ayan and a few other guests at the puja.
Meanwhile, View this post on Instagram A post shared by SnehZala (@sneyhzala)

Notably, Other videos show Ranbir standing on stage with a microphone in hand as Harshdeep sings Kabira. He sings along and even turns the mike towards the audience so they can join them. After he joins her in singing the song, Harshdeep asks the people present there to clap for Ranbir and his performance. Ranbir held back and let the singer handle some of the difficult portions of the song.
As per the latest buzz, View this post on Instagram A post shared by Widely shared Bhayani (@viralbhayani)

In further updates, Followers got nostalgic after seeing Ranbir’s performance. “Omg he is looking so so so handsome here,” read one fan comment. On top of that, It has been a while since Ranbir was seen on-screen; his last films were the rom-com Tu Jhoothi Main Makkaar and the action-drama Animal in 2023. The star who received critical acclaim for his performance as the violent Ranvijay Singh in Sandeep Reddy Vanga’s polarising movie will soon star in Nitesh Tiwari’s Ramayana : Rise of a Legend.

The movie, which will see him play Ram, Sai Pallavi as Sita, and Yash as Ravana, will be rolled out in theatres on November 5 for Diwali. The second part will be rolled out for Diwali 2027. Ranbir also has Sanjay Leela Bhansali’s Love & War lined up for rollout. His first look from the movie, which also stars Alia Bhatt and Vicky Kaushal, was of late rolled out. It will be rolled out in theatres in January 2027.

title: Addinath Kothare overwhelmed with the response to Nayyi Navelli, says the mythological fantasy film got a perfect release during Dussehra | Interview
body: Here's the latest update from the Bollywood world:

Addinath Kothare is on a roll this year. Ahead of the much-anticipated rollout of Ramayana next month (where he plays Bharath), he is back on screen as a lead opposite Yami Gautam in Nayyi Navelli . The mythological fantasy thriller has opened in theatres to positive reviews for the Marathi star, who has been working in the industry since he was a child. Apart from being an star, he is also a director and producer.

Adding to this, Addinath Kothare plays Yami Gautam's husband in the movie. Right after the rollout of Nayyi Navelli, HT caught up with Addinath for an exclusive chat where he opened up about the movie's reception and why he shared yes to the part in the first place.

Meanwhile, The star has read the comments and praise for his work in the movie, in which he is paired opposite Yami Gautam. He plays Raja Awasthi, who brings his newlywed wife Mohini to his house in Meerut, whose arrival in the large joint family triggers an unexpected mythological battle.

Notably, Talking about the response to the movie, Addinath says, “I am very overwhelmed by the appreciation that I am getting for my character and for the movie, in general. The kids are loving it the most, and that is a great sign. It is the festive season, and Nayyi Navelli is a family movie, so it is a great time for a movie like this to be rolled out. We keep working on big projects, and it takes a lot of luck and destiny for things to align, where the right project comes at the right time in theatres. I think there could not have been a better time for a movie like Nayyi Navelli to rollout in the middle of Dussehra.”
As per the latest buzz, View this post on Instagram A post shared by Amazon MGM Studios India (@amazonmgmstudiosin)

In further updates, The star recalls how he was first approached about the movie's script while he was shooting a Television show he was also producing. It was Mukesh Chhabra who called him, and he knew it would be for something exciting. “He asked me, ‘How busy are you?’ and one thing is that as an star, we are very greedy, and when Mukesh Chhabra [casting director] calls you, it is exciting because he works on some of the best projects. He has an eye for great stories and great talent. I took that risk and shared that I was free!”

On top of that, Addinath shared he was really enamoured of the script after hearing it and meeting the team for the first time. “They told me the story, and I went ‘wow!’ It was a dream role. It was a delicious part for any star, and I knew I had to do this. I somehow managed to accommodate my dates after speaking with the channel heads, and that is how the movie happened,” he smiles.
Nayyi Navelli is directed by Balaji Mohan. It is currently playing in theatres nationwide.

title: Delhi protest LIVE: ‘CJP to restrategise after Das, Ranka's release; won’t back down,’ says Dipke
body: Here's the latest protest news from across India:

Delhi protest LIVE: Following his rollout on Friday, Dipke shared he was “waiting for his brothers to be free”. Delhi protest LIVE: Cockroach Janta Party co-convenors Saurav Das and Ashutosh Ranka's five-day judicial custody ends on Saturday, and with the Delhi Police not having filed an extension plea yet, they may be rolled out. While CJP's legal affairs head Ratna Singh shared every required procedure regarding had been completed and they were “merely waiting for formal approval”, the outfit has warned of legal action if Das and Ranka are not rolled out today. The CJP shared they had consulted with senior advocate Kapil Sibal, and alleged “deliberate use of delaying tactics” to keep Das and Ranka “behind bars.” ...Read More

Adding to this, CJP founder Abhijeet Dipke was rolled out on Saturday on conditional bail, a day after he was detained on his way to Connaught Place for the ‘Lehra do Tiranga’ march and then arrested. One of the primary conditions of Dipke's bail bond is to ensure there is no breach of peace on his end for a period of one year. AISA national president Neha Bora had also been detained on Friday, but was rolled out following overnight detention after formal procedures under Section 65 of the Delhi Police Act. The CJP, student organisations and the Opposition have staged continuous protests against Chief Election Commissioner Gyanesh Kumar and the special intensive revision exercise, following reports of objections being raised by the two Election Commissioners on the poll body's decisions. The ECI has, in a statement, maintained that all decisions taken by it are unanimous. ‘Waiting for my brothers to be free’ Following his rollout on Friday, Dipke shared he was “waiting for his brothers to be free”, while sharing a photograph of Das and Ranka. CJP's co-convenors were arrested earlier this week on Tuesday, after they jumped a locked gate to enter Jantar Mantar, which was de-notified as a protest site, and displayed the Tricolour there, along with 12 others. They were subsequently detained. While CJP national organisation in-charge Ajinkya Shinde and 11 others were rolled out, Das and Ranka faced preventive action and were sent to five-day judicial custody. CJP's legal affairs head Ratna Singh had, in a post on X, alleged that Das and Ranka “could not come out” on Saturday because the investigating officer (IO) had come at 6 pm for a 2 pm hearing.

Meanwhile, Delhi protest LIVE: With a 30-foot effigy of a cockroach to be burnt alongside those of Ravan, Meghnad and Kumbhkaran at a Ramlila event here, some social media users are questioning its propriety at a religious celebration while organisers maintain the initiative aims to promote cleanliness.

Notably, The Shree Keshav Ram Leela Committee, which organises the annual event in Pitampura, shared the cockroach symbolises filth and dirt and the initiative aims to spread awareness about cleanliness under 'Swachh Bharat' and 'Swachh Delhi' campaigns.

As per the latest buzz, Committee president and BJP MLA Ashok Goel told PTI that the decision is not politically motivated and is intended to convey the message of the victory of good over evil while highlighting the importance of cleanliness.
In further updates, The cockroach will be depicted among the 'asuras' in Ravan's army, he shared.

On top of that, The development comes amid protests by the Cockroach Janata Party (CJP) in the capital. The group had initially protested against former education minister Dharmendra Pradhan, and has now joined demonstrations demanding the resignation of Chief Election Commissioner Gyanesh Kumar.

Several social media users have questioned the decision, arguing that bringing contemporary political developments into a religious celebration could hurt sentiments and divert attention from the festival's traditional significance.

title: Nayyi Navelli box office collection day 2: Yami Gautam's mythological film sees growth, crosses ₹7 crore
body: Here's the latest box office buzz making the rounds:

Nayyi Navelli ticket-window earnings day 2: Yami Gautam stars in the lead role. Nayyi Navelli ticket-window report The latest update from Sacnilk states that Nayyi Navelli collected ₹ 4.00 crore rupees on Saturday. It is a growth from its opening day haul, which was at ₹ 3.25 crore rupees. This takes the total ticket-window earnings of the movie after two days to ₹ 7.25 crore rupees by 10 PM. Nayyi Navelli played at 5,945 shows on Saturday buy managed to hold on to the momentum, signaling that the movie has received a good response from viewers. All eyes are now on Sunday to see how the movie scores on the first weekend.

Adding to this, Nayyi Navelli performed better than Rajkummar Rao's Prahaar, which collected ₹ 2.35 crore rupees on its opening day. On Saturday too, Nayyi Navelli took the lead and has so far emerged as the first choice for viewers during the Holiday weekend.

Meanwhile, Directed by Balaji Mohan and written by Himanshu Sharma and Divy Nidhi Sharma, the movie also stars Addinath M Kothare, Anurag Thakur, Sunita Rajwar, Mita Vashisht, Aaditya Kulshreshth, Susmita Mukherjee and Pratiek Pachori in pivotal roles. Produced by Aanand L Rai and Himanshu Sharma, the movie features music by G V Prakash Kumar.

Notably, Nayyi Navelli is set in Meerut, and follows a picture-perfect bride (Yami) who transforms a chaotic household into what appears to be paradise, only for her brother-in-law to suspect that his seemingly ideal sister-in-law may actually be a daayan, or witch.

As per the latest buzz, An excerpt from the HT review of Nayyi Navelli read, “Nayyi Navelli is a movie that mistakes excess for entertainment and confusion for complexity. Its basic storyline offers enough scope for a blend of mythology and comedy, but the execution fails to do justice to the ideas. The screenplay needed sharper writing, yet it keeps piling on subplots and eccentric characters, hoping that something will eventually click. Yami tries to hold things together, but even her performance cannot compensate for the narrative's shortcomings. 'Nayyi Navelli' may mean something new, but there is precious little that's fresh about the movie itself.”

Adding to this, Prahaar ticket-window earnings day 2: Rajkummar Rao in a still from Prahaar. title: ‘Issued without inquiry, show-cause notice’: Imran Khan challenges notice to leave the country for taking part in anti-CEC protests, moves Bombay HC
body: Here's the latest update from the Bollywood world:

Star Imran Khan , a US citizen and an OCI cardholder, on Saturday filed a petition in the Bombay High Court challenging a notice issued by the Mumbai Police directing him to leave India by October 28 for allegedly violating rules by participating in a political demonstration. The star, who holds a US passport and an Overseas Citizen of India (OCI) card, was issued the notice following his participation in a protest against Chief Election Commissioner Gyanesh Kumar.

Adding to this, Police detained star Imran Khan among protesters at August Kranti Maidan during demonstrations supporting the Cockroach Janata Party (CJP) protest against chief election commissioner Gyanesh Kumar (HT File Photo/Raju Shinde) Imran's plea before Bombay HC The latest update from news agency PTI states that the 43-year-old star, in the plea filed through his advocate Zulfiquar Memon and MZM Legal, termed the notice as "illegal, perverse, drastic and bad in law." The plea shared that there is no provision under the current law or statutory rules that prohibits an OCI (Overseas Citizen of India) cardholder from participating in a peaceful protest.

Meanwhile, The plea is expected to be mentioned for an urgent hearing before a division bench comprising Chief Justice Mahesh Chandra Tripathi and Justice Advait Sethna. "The notice has been issued without disclosing any reasons, supporting material, or specific statutory contravention. It was issued without inquiry, a show-cause notice, or any opportunity for the Petitioner (Khan) to respond to the alleged violations," the plea shared.

Notably, The row dates back to October 10, when Imran, nephew of Bollywood superstar Aamir Khan, participated in a demonstration organised by the Cockroach Janta Party (CJP). The protest called for Chief Election Commissioner Gyanesh Kumar's resignation over alleged irregularities in the Special Intensive Revision (SIR) of electoral rolls. Imran and his girlfriend, Lekha Washington, were detained by Mumbai Police during the demonstration.

As per the latest buzz, Following his detention, Imran shared a photograph on social media that appeared to show him inside a police van. He captioned it, “Apparently I’m going for a drive”. In conversation with the media at the protest, the star explained why he had joined the demonstration. “I don’t have demands. I’m here as a citizen, as a person who lives in this city. I’m here to see why freedom of movement is being restricted, why people’s voices are being suppressed,” he shared.

In further updates, At the protests, Imran Khan shared he was not present at the protests with any specific demands, but had come forward in his capacity as "a citizen". He shared he wanted to understand why freedom of movement was being restricted and why people’s voices were being suppressed.

On top of that, “I don't have demands. I am here as a citizen, as a person who lives in this city. I am here to see why freedom of movement is being restricted. Why are people's voices being suppressed? That is why I am here,” the star shared in the video widely circulated on social media.

The star, his girlfriend Lekha Washington , his mother mother Nusrat, and niece Zayn (Marie) were detained along with 400 people at during the protest, demanding the resignation of CEC Kumar over alleged irregularities in the Special Intensive Revision (SIR) of electoral rolls.

title: SS Rajamouli hails Nitesh Tiwari and Namit Malhotra for bringing the story of Ramayana to the screen on such a grand scale
body: Here's the latest update from the Bollywood world:

Ramayana, starring Ranbir Kapoor , is among the most anticipated films of the year. The movie features some of the biggest names in the Hindi movie industry, with Ranbir Kapoor as Lord Rama, Yash as Ravana and Sai Pallavi as Sita.

Adding to this, SS Rajamouli has showed support for the rollout of Ramayana. Envisioned as a two-part epic, the movie will bring the story of the Ramayana to the big screen on a grand scale. The first instalment is scheduled to rollout worldwide on November 5, 2026, followed by Part 2 in Diwali 2027. The films are planned for rollout in Hindi, Tamil, Telugu, Kannada and Malayalam across India.

Meanwhile, The makers have rolled out the new trailer of the movie, giving audiences their spectacular new glimpse of Nitesh Tiwari’s ambitious take on one of India’s most celebrated epics. Taking to X, Rajamouli wrote, “#Ramayana is a story every Indian storyteller grows up aspiring to tell. It's a joy to see @niteshtiwari22 and @malhotra_namit bring it to the screen on such a grand scale. Each star brings these timeless characters to life with depth.”
Notably, “Looking forward to 5th November. Best wishes to the entire team,” he added.

As per the latest buzz, The 2-minute 36-second trailer shows new footage and more moments featuring Ram and Ravana. The trailer opens with a voice describing a time when the world lived in harmony, saying, “Before history was written... men walked among gods... and the world existed in perfect order.” It finally shows Kunal Kapoor playing the role of Lord Indra. That peace is soon threatened by Ravana, whose rise to power changes the course of the world. The narration continues, “But from the darkness rose an evil force... Ravana. Born from fire and fury, he bent the gods to his will and made the world his throne.”

In further updates, Ranbir Kapoor's Rama is shown grappling with the responsibility that comes with his destiny. Determined to stop Ravana, he says, “If this is my fate... I will not hesitate to destroy him. If I don't stop him... the world will fall.” The trailer closes on a foreboding note, with Ravana warning, “This is just... the beginning.”

But the fresh new English international trailer shows the movie as a massive epic.

title: SC panel launches portal for complaints, evidence on use of pellet guns, violence during July protest at Jantar Mantar
body: Here's the latest protest news from across India:

The Supreme Court-appointed High Powered Enquiry Committee (HPEC), tasked with inquiring into violence at Jantar Mantar , Delhi, and other places outside Delhi during the CJP protests in July has opened an online portal for people to upload complaints and representations, according to a Home Ministry statement on Saturday.

Adding to this, File photo of A Cockroach Janta Party (CJP) supporters shouting slogans at Jantar Mantar in New Delhi on July 23, 2026 during the protest to demand the resignation of India's Education Minister Dharmendra Pradhan over alleged NEET exam irregularities (AFP) The statement added that priority will be given to complaints of pellet use and harassment of female protesters among others. Track live updates on CJP protest

Meanwhile, “The HPEC shall examine all issues enumerated in paragraphs 12 and 13 of the Hon’ble Supreme Court’s Order dated August 18, 2026, and paragraph 5(i) of the order dated September 10, 2026. Priority will be given to matters pertaining to the use of pellet guns, targeted violence and harassment of female protestors, and excessive violence and destruction of property occasioned on either side,” a government statement shared.

Notably, The paragraphs mentioned in the two SC orders are about the same issues: use of pellets, electric batons, violence against protesters, including police personnel, compensation, and targeted violence.

As per the latest buzz, The statement shared that the portal http://hpec.nic.in has been launched for the convenience of the affected people including victims among police and other security forces during the protests.

In further updates, “The Portal is designed in such a manner as to enable due protection to vulnerable witnesses and also to keep the identities confidential and undisclosed, if so wished by the affected persons. The affected persons and other stakeholders are encouraged to access the portal and upload their complaints/representations making use of the formats as applicable, “the statement shared adding that those who wish to submit the complaints submit the complaints, can do so at the Office of the HPEC at Shiksha Sadan, 17, Rouse Avenue Institutional Area, New Delhi 110002 between 1400 hrs. and 1600 Hrs. on all working days.
On top of that, “Submissions can also be sent by post at the above address or by email at hpec2026.enquiry[at]nic[dot]in,” the statement shared.

HT checked the portal, where one can submit information in four different ways: as an affected person (including police personnel), those who want to submit complaints or are witnesses but wish to remain anonymous, the third is for submitting any other information confidentially, and the fourth is for those with suggestions for the HPEC. For each category, there are different questions along with the option to attach complaints. There is also a question to check if the victim was sexually assaulted. One can also post videos and photographs of the injuries, the incident or the medical reports.

title: Congress gets Delhi Police nod for Ramlila Maidan rally amid SIR protests
body: Here's the latest protest news from across India:
A No Objection Certificate (NOC) has been issued to the Congress for a rally at Ramlila Maidan, shared Delhi Police on Saturday.

Adding to this, The Congress's proposed rally comes amid a broader row over the Special Intensive Revision (SIR) of electoral rolls. (AICC) In conversation with ANI, Deputy Commissioner of Police (DCP) Central Rohit Rajbir Singh shared the ground will be booked from October 25 to November 3.

Meanwhile, This follows Jantar Mantar being de-notified as a designated venue for organising protests and demonstrations in Delhi. The Delhi Police has designated three alternative locations for holding such activities. The three new designated protest venues are Ramlila Ground, Burari Ground and CBD Ground in East Delhi.

Notably, The DCP shared that the Congress first asked the Municipal Corporation of Delhi (MCD) about availability, which shared the ground would be free from October 25 to November 3. "The MCD shared that the venue would be available from October 25 to November 3. After receiving the venue availability certificate, the Congress party approached us," he shared.

As per the latest buzz, "After interacting with them and understanding the security arrangements required, we decided to grant them the No Objection Certificate (NOC). We issued it today. They will now take the certificate back to the MCD, which is the owning agency responsible for the land, and then begin their preparations. The ground will be booked from October 25 to November 3," he added.
In further updates, DCP Singh further shared that any other stakeholder or organiser wanting to book the ground may also follow the same process.

On top of that, The Congress's proposed rally comes amid a broader row over the Special Intensive Revision ( SIR ) of electoral rolls, which has escalated over the weeks as multiple protests erupted in the national capital led by INDIA Bloc and activists. The opposition camp has been demanding the roll-back of SIR and resignation of Chief Election Commissioner Gyanesh Kumar.

The protests also witnessed a police crackdown as over a hundred of demonstrators were detained amid heightened security in central Delhi. Congress has been staging continuous protests against the CEC, with INDIA Bloc allies joining the chorus.

Another comment read, "Baddie before the term was coined." Another fan wrote, “Too good, and I wanted to be you when I was a kid and now i am haha.”

Set against the backdrop of a college arts and puppet show, the video featured Himani as a popular girl who mocks a simple girl who performs puppet shows with Falguni Pathak. Vivan went on to become a familiar face on television and appeared in films such as Dangal (2016), Judwaa 2 (2017) and Raja the Great (2017).

As per the latest buzz, Beyond her appearance in Falguni Pathak’s hit, Himani was a prominent MTV India VJ and model. She also made a cameo in the 2001 Bollywood movie Yaadein and acted in the 2005 movie Rehle Rehle Na.

title: EXCLUSIVE: Frontal nudity gets censor clearance! CBFC retains 2-second adult magazine shot in Doosra; Abhinay Deo calls it an “achievement”
body: Here's the latest update from the Bollywood world:

When asked about the certification Doosra received from the CBFC, Abhinay Deo shared, "It’s an adult-rated movie due to a few scenes. I was there at the censor screening and they asked me, ‘What rating do you want?’. I suggested a U/A rating. They agreed but asked us to cut 3 scenes. I told them, ‘If we can get the movie passed with an A-rating and without a cut, I won’t mind’. They shared, ‘If you are okay with adult-rating, we won’t cut a single shot’. I agreed."

Adding to this, One of the scenes that contributed to the 'A' certification features Tara's father (Ankur Vikal) catching her with an adult magazine during her childhood. The sequence includes a clear, two-second shot of a nude photograph of a woman in the magazine. The CBFC has often been strict about the depiction of nudity on screen, with several films facing cuts over such content. However, in this case, the board allowed the shot to remain intact.

Meanwhile, Abhinay Deo revealed, "Those 2-3 shots, which they wanted to cut, were integral to the movie. One was the magazine shot. Then, we had a reference where we touched upon the Babri Masjid episode. They told me, ‘ Thoda kam kar do , change kar do’ . I confessed that I didn’t want to touch the movie."

Notably, Was Abhinay Deo apprehensive about losing out on the under-18 audience because of the adult certification? He replied, "No, because this is not a movie for teenagers to watch, though it is relevant to them."

title: Ajay Devgn’s team clarifies on partial demolition of Juhu property, confirms BMC-required changes have been made
body: Here's the latest update from the Bollywood world:
Ajay Devgn’s team has issued a clarification after reports emerged that the Brihanmumbai Municipal Corporation ( BMC ) had partially demolished a property owned by the star in Juhu, Mumbai.

Adding to this, Ajay Devgn’s team issued clarification on partial demolition of Juhu property. ‘We are duly complying with all applicable BMC rules’ Ajay’s team has now issued a statement clarifying that the property in question is not the star’s residence but a separate property that has been rented out.

Meanwhile, The statement read, “We would like to clarify that the property in question is not Ajay Devgn’s residence, but a separate property that has been rented out. We have applied to the BMC for the requisite permissions in respect of one of our properties and are duly complying with all applicable BMC rules, regulations and guidelines. The necessary changes, alterations and modifications, as required by the BMC, have been carried out.”

Notably, According to a report by Hindustan Times , the property, measuring approximately 7,802 square feet, is located in Kapol Co-operative Housing Society and is owned by Ajay and his mother, Veena Devgn.

As per the latest buzz, The BMC’s K/West ward had issued a notice under Section 354A of the Mumbai Municipal Corporation Act on September 10, 2026, alleging unauthorised additions and alterations at the property. The notice directed the owners to immediately stop the work and produce the requisite permissions within 24 hours. It also warned that the construction could otherwise be demolished at their risk and cost.

In further updates, In a speaking order dated October 6, the designated officer rejected the owners’ reply, stating that no documents establishing the legality of the construction or permissions from the competent authority had been submitted. Consequently, the civic body treated the work as unauthorised and directed its immediate removal.

On top of that, Ajay Devgn is currently enjoying the box-office success of Drishyam 3, the latest instalment in his popular thriller franchise. The movie has as per reports collected ₹ 336.55 crore rupees in India net collections within 16 days of its rollout and crossed the ₹ 500 crore rupees mark in worldwide gross collections. It also recorded the biggest opening of the star’s career.

The star has several projects lined up, including Rohit Shetty’s Golmaal 5. He is also set to feature in Ranger, an soon-to-release action-adventure movie directed by Jagan Shakti and produced by Luv Ranjan, Ankur Garg, Ajay Devgn and Anand Pandit. The movie will feature Sanjay Dutt as the antagonist. Ajay also has Chauhaan, directed by Neeraj Yadav, in his soon-to-release lineup.

title: Neha Sharma issues stern warning against using her face or likeness to create AI-generated videos or images without her consent
body: Here's the latest update from the Bollywood world:

Misuse of artificial intelligence has raised concerns for people across the world, especially celebrities, with cases of deepfakes, manipulated videos, and other forms of identity misuse through such technology. There has been an increasing number of actors filing lawsuits over such misuse of their identities. The latest addition to that list is star Neha Sharma , who has taken a stand against it and warned those who are creating AI-generated content using her face and likeness.

Adding to this, Neha Sharma has become the latest star to warn about legal action against the deepfakes of her circulating online. Neha's statement Taking to X on Saturday, Neha wrote, “Anyone using my face or likeness to create AI-generated videos or images without my consent is hereby warned to STOP IMMEDIATELY.”

Meanwhile, She added, "Take down all such content already posted and refrain from creating, editing, or circulating any further AI-generated videos or images using my identity. Using my face in this manner to misrepresent me or malign my reputation is completely unacceptable.
Notably, I DO NOT CONSENT TO THE UNAUTHORIZED USE OF MY FACE OR LIKENESS."

As per the latest buzz, Noting that she will have to take the course of legal action, Neha concluded, "Consider this a formal warning: I WILL TAKE LEGAL ACTION AGAINST EVERY INDIVIDUAL RESPONSIBLE FOR CREATING, POSTING, OR CIRCULATING SUCH CONTENT. No one should assume that hiding behind a fake account or the use of AI will protect them from accountability.

In further updates, Neha is among several Indian celebrities who have spoken about deepfakes. In recent times, several actors have approached courts to protect their identity, image, and personality rights from AI-generated misuse. Akshay Kumar, Varun Dhawan, Anil Kapoor, Shilpa Shetty, Preity Zinta, Kartik Aaryan, Mrunal Thakur, Suniel Shetty, and several other stars approached the courts over the unauthorised use of their images and voices, amid growing concerns about AI-driven identity theft.

On top of that, One of the biggest turning points in India's deepfake debate came after Rashmika Mandanna reacted to a manipulated video that went widely shared online. Stating that she was “extremely scarred,” she urged people and authorities to take the issue seriously and called for urgent action from society.

title: Women's groups protest outside Delhi Police headquarters against alleged sexual violence during anti-SIR stir
body: Here's the latest protest news from across India:

Women's organisations on Saturday organised a protest march towards the Delhi Police headquarters over alleged sexual violence by police personnel during the anti-CEC protests, led by the Cockroach Janta Party, in Delhi.

Adding to this, Women's groups protesting outside Delhi Police headquarters, Ashoka Road. (Instagram/@sfidelhi.official) All India Democratic Women’s Association (AIDWA), National Federation of Indian Women (NFIW), All India Mahila Sanskritik Sangathan (AIMSS), All India Progressive Women’s Association (AIPWA) and ALIFA (All India Feminist Alliance) participated in the march along with several other women and student groups like Collective and SFI.

Meanwhile, In a video shared by PTI on X, women protesters were heard raising the slogans of “Delhi Police sharam karo (Delhi Police, shame on you)" and “ tod ke rakhdo vo samaaj, naari jisme bandhi hai aaj (break apart the society that keeps its women shackled)".

Notably, The protesters assembled near Gurudwara Bangla Sahib and marched towards the Delhi Police headquarters to submit a memorandum seeking accountability for the alleged sexual and gender-based violence against demonstrators, news agency PTI reported.

As per the latest buzz, In a joint official statement shared on Facebook, the organisations shared, videos, photographs and personal testimonies had documented alleged sexual harassment and physical violence against women, transgender and non-binary protesters during police action since July 20, with reports increasing from October 2.

In further updates, They also referred to footage that allegedly showed male police personnel assaulting women demonstrators and claimed that incidents of sexual violence had taken place inside police buses and detention centres.

On top of that, “These deliberate actions by the authorities are nothing but misogynistic attempts to silence women's voices and reveal a larger intent to push us out of politics and public life," they alleged.

Delhi ACP, Vivek Bhagat, one of the accused, later alleged that the woman journalist made casteist remarks against him. No FIR has been filed against him while a man from Haryana was arrested for allegedly sharing a fabricated video that falsely showed the officer misbehaving with the woman journalist.

title: Yash confirms Ramayana’s ₹4,000 crore budget for both parts, asks fans to speak about the film with pride
body: Here's the latest box office buzz making the rounds:

At the latest trailer launch event for Ramayana in Bengaluru, Yash addressed the much-discussed ₹ 4,000 crore rupees budget of the movie franchise. The star, who plays Ravana in the soon-to-release epic, is also one of the producers of the movie alongside Namit Malhotra . At the event, Yash verified that the combined budget for both parts of Ramayana is ₹ 4,000 crore rupees.

Adding to this, Yash plays the role of Ravana in Ramayana. ‘Both the movies combined is definitely ₹ 4,000 crore rupees’ As reported by The Hindu, Yash addressed Namit Malhotra’s earlier statement about the budget of the Ramayana duology, which had sparked considerable discussion on social media.

Meanwhile, “I know that Namit's statement went widely shared on social media. In India, there is a problem. People don't like it when you talk confidently. That's what happened with Namit's statement. But in the West, it's the total opposite. If you tell them we have made a good movie in a humble manner, they will dismiss our movie as a small project. That's exactly why Namit has confidently shared that this movie is mounted on ₹ 4,000 crore rupees. We need to prove the strength of the Indian movie industry to the global market,” Yash shared.

Notably, He added, “Ramayana is a two-part project, and the budget for both the movies combined is definitely ₹ 4,000 crore rupees. The budget includes post-production and promotional expenses as well.”

As per the latest buzz, At the event, Yash also thanked his followers for their continued support, even as his soon-to-release movie Toxic received mixed reviews. He assured them that he would strive to deliver an outstanding performance in Ramayana and shared they would be able to speak about the movie with pride.

In further updates, The star also spoke about the ambition behind Ramayana and how they want the movie to reach global audience. He concluded his address by asking the people of Karnataka to bless and support his soon-to-release films.

On top of that, Directed by Nitesh Tiwari and produced by Namit Malhotra’s Prime Focus Studios, Ramayana is a two-part cinematic adaptation of the Hindu epic. The ambitious project features Ranbir Kapoor as Lord Rama, Sai Pallavi as Sita, Yash as Ravana and Sunny Deol as Hanuman. The movie also stars Ravi Dubey, Anupam Kher, Kajal Aggarwal, Rakul Preet Singh, Vivek Oberoi, Kunal Kapoor, Adinath Kothare, Arun Govil, Indira Krishnan and Lara Dutta.
The movie's first instalment is scheduled for a Diwali 2026 rollout (November 5), with the second part planned for Diwali 2027.

body: Here's the latest box office buzz making the rounds:

Nayyi Navelli ticket-window earnings day 1: Yami Gautam in a still from the movie. Nayyi Navelli ticket-window report Nayyi Navelli brings a fantasy entertainer to the big screen, where folklore meets unexpected twists, quirky characters and larger-than-life entertainment. The latest update from Sacnilk states that the movie has collected ₹ 3.25 crore rupees. All eyes are on how the movie performs over the next two days to manage a good opening weekend haul.

Adding to this, Nayyi Navelli has performed better than Rajkummar Rao's Prahaar, which collected ₹ 2.35 crore rupees on its opening day. However, the movie failed to beat the opening day haul of Yami's 2024 rollout Article 370, which had managed ₹ 5.90 crore rupees.

Meanwhile, Set in Meerut, it revolves around a man who accuses his bhabhi (played by Yami) of being a witch, even while her husband and in-laws are fond of her. One day, her husband transforms into a monster, and we are told that it is all linked to Kaal Sheel, a mysterious stone dating back to the Treta Yuga. What follows is a heavy blend of mythology with humour.

Notably, Directed by Balaji Mohan and written by Himanshu Sharma and Divy Nidhi Sharma, the movie also stars Addinath M Kothare, Anurag Thakur, Sunita Rajwar, Mita Vashisht, Aaditya Kulshreshth, Susmita Mukherjee and Pratiek Pachori in pivotal roles. Produced by Aanand L Rai and Himanshu Sharma, the movie features music by G V Prakash Kumar.

As per the latest buzz, An excerpt from the HT review of Nayyi Navelli read, “Nayyi Navelli is a movie that mistakes excess for entertainment and confusion for complexity. Its basic storyline offers enough scope for a blend of mythology and comedy, but the execution fails to do justice to the ideas. The screenplay needed sharper writing, yet it keeps piling on subplots and eccentric characters, hoping that something will eventually click. Yami tries to hold things together, but even her performance cannot compensate for the narrative's shortcomings. 'Nayyi Navelli' may mean something new, but there is precious little that's fresh about the movie itself.”

title: Kriti Sanon approaches Delhi High Court seeking protection against AI-generated impersonation, unauthorised use of identity
body: Here's the latest update from the Bollywood world:

The matter came up before a single-judge Bench of Justice Purushaindra Kumar Kaurav. During the hearing, the court asked Kriti's counsel to place on record relevant judgments, research papers and other material concerning the legal questions surrounding personality rights.

Adding to this, The High Court indicated that it would pass a comprehensive order after examining the judgments and research material submitted by the star's legal team. The matter has now been listed for further hearing on October 29.

Meanwhile, Kriti's plea comes at a time when the unauthorised use of celebrities' identities through digital platforms has become an increasingly prominent legal issue. Apart from the unauthorised commercial use of names and images, courts are also dealing with cases involving AI-generated content, deepfakes, digital impersonation and fake endorsements.

Notably, Personality and publicity rights generally seek to protect aspects of an individual's identity from being commercially exploited or represented without authorisation. The growing use of generative AI has added another layer to these disputes, as digitally created images, videos and other content can closely imitate public figures.

body: Here's the latest box office buzz making the rounds:

Rajkummar Rao’s latest outing, Prahaar : The Ujjwal Nikam Story, has opened to a lukewarm response at the ticket-window. The courtroom drama, based on the life of veteran public prosecutor Ujjwal Nikam and the trial that led to the hanging of Ajmal Kasab, was rolled out in theatres on Friday. Here’s a look at the movie’s opening-day performance.

Adding to this, Prahaar ticket-window earnings day 1: Rajkummar Rao's movie has collected ₹2.35 crore rupees. Prahaar ticket-window earnings day 1 According to the trade website Sacnilk, Prahaar: The Ujjwal Nikam Story opened with ₹ 2.35 crore rupees in net collections in India, while its gross collection stood at ₹ 2.77 crore rupees. The movie had 4,133 shows across the country and recorded an average occupancy of 13% throughout the day. In terms of worldwide collections, the movie grossed ₹ 0.75 Cr, pushing its total worldwide gross to ₹ 3.52 Cr.

Meanwhile, In the National Capital Region (NCR), the movie had 615 shows, with an average occupancy of 10%. Mumbai recorded 411 shows and 20% occupancy, while Ahmedabad had 283 shows with an average occupancy of 7%.

Notably, With an opening-day collection of ₹ 2.35 crore rupees, Prahaar ranks among the lower openers of Rajkummar Rao’s career. His biggest opener remains Stree 2, which collected ₹ 51.80 crore rupees on its opening day in 2024.

As per the latest buzz, The movie has surpassed the opening-day collections of Srikanth and Badhaai Do, which collected ₹ 2.25 crore rupees and ₹ 1.65 crore rupees, respectively. However, it failed to match the openings of several other Rajkummar's films, including Roohi ( ₹ 2.90 crore rupees), Vicky Vidya Ka Woh Wala Video ( ₹ 5.50 crore rupees), Mr & Mrs Mahi ( ₹ 6.75 crore rupees) and Bhool Chuk Maaf ( ₹ 7 crore rupees).

In further updates, Hindustan Times’ Rishabh Suri gave the movie three stars. In his review, he wrote, “Overall, Prahaar has a story that should have been difficult to look away from, yet it occasionally tests your patience with its own digressions. The 26/11 attack remains one of the darkest scars on our nation's memory. A movie about Ujjwal Nikam had the opportunity to capture the fight for justice with the emotional weight it deserved. Instead, it gets caught between a courtroom drama and a family saga, losing some of its grip on both in the process. And yet, there is enough here to keep the movie from becoming a missed opportunity altogether."

On top of that, Prahaar: The Ujjwal Nikam Story is a courtroom drama based on the life and career of Ujjwal Nikam, the veteran public prosecutor. He played a key role in the prosecution of Ajmal Kasab, the lone surviving terrorist captured during the 26/11 terror attacks, who was later convicted and hanged.
The movie stars Rajkummar Rao as Nikam. It is directed by Avinash Arun and produced by Dinesh Vijan.

body: Here's the latest protest news from across India:

title: Heavy security deployment continues across central Delhi a day after ‘Lehra Do Tiranga’ protest
body: Here's the latest protest news from across India:

Heavy security deployment continued across central Delhi on Saturday, with barricades at Jantar Mantar and additional personnel outside the Delhi Police and Election Commission of India headquarters amid the possibility of fresh protests by left-wing organisations, a day after nearly 2,000 people gathered in and around Connaught Place for the “Lehra Do Tiranga” protest. No major protests by the Cockroach Janta Party (CJP) or the Congress party have been revealed so far in the city.

Adding to this, Heavy security deployment continued across central Delhi on Saturday (AFP) Barricades remain in place at Jantar Mantar, which has been de-notified as a designated protest site, and security personnel are manning all three entry and exit points, near the Ashoka Road roundabout and along Tolstoy Marg and Sansad Marg.

Meanwhile, Additional barricades have been put up on Ashoka Road and Jai Singh Road to prevent crowding, as gatherings are prohibited across the New Delhi area under Section 163 of the Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita (BNSS), an officer aware of the matter shared.

Notably, Security has also been stepped up outside the Delhi Police headquarters and the Election Commission of India headquarters following information that some left-wing organisations may hold a women’s march outside the police headquarters, alleging sexual violence by police during the protests.

As per the latest buzz, “Through our intelligence branch officials, we have learnt that some left groups have planned a march outside the police headquarters later in the morning. Since no permission has been given to anyone to hold protests in the New Delhi area, no gathering will be allowed anywhere in central Delhi. Our security arrangements are in place to handle any flash protest,” the officer added.

In further updates, A senior police officer shared that more than 200 companies of central armed paramilitary forces (CAPFs), comprising nearly 20,000 men and women, are available with the Delhi Police to handle protests across Delhi. The largest deployments of the CAPFs have been made in central Delhi, particularly in and around Jantar Mantar, Sansad Marg, the Election Commission headquarters and Connaught Place, as well as outside the residences of Prime Minister Narendra Modi, Union home minister Amit Shah, chief election commissioner (CEC) Gyanesh Kumar and other key ministers. Nearly 10,000 Delhi Police personnel have also been kept in reserve to deal with demonstrations and marches in the city, the officers shared.

On top of that, On Friday evening, nearly 2,000 people gathered in and around Connaught Place for the Cockroach Janta Party’s (CJP) “Lehra Do Tiranga” protest, scheduled to be held at Central Park at 5 pm. As police permission was not granted for the protest, Delhi Police and CAPF personnel were deployed in large numbers in Connaught Place and its adjoining areas from Thursday. By Friday noon, hundreds of personnel had taken over Central Park and closed all its access gates to ensure nobody entered the park.

Outside the park, nearly 200 personnel, particularly from the CAPFs, formed a human chain around it as protesters in small groups began marching around Connaught Place’s inner circle after 5 pm. Senior police officers also conducted flag marches along the pavements and restricted movement near the site, including that of journalists. By 7.30 pm, police dispersed protesters from the Connaught Place area. Nearly 150 people were detained from the area, Mandi House and Janpath by 9 pm and were later rolled out.

title: ‘Can you give some research paper?’: Delhi High Court asks Kriti Sanon legal clarity in personality rights protection case
body: Here's the latest update from the Bollywood world:

Star Kriti Sanon has approached the Delhi High Court seeking protection of her personality rights, with the court on Friday calling for a broader examination of the legal principles governing such claims amid a rise in similar cases.

Adding to this, Kriti Sanon approached the Delhi High Court over protection of her personality rights. (AFP) Justice Purushaindra Kumar Kaurav asked advocate Pravin Anand, appearing for Sanon, to prepare a comprehensive compilation of judgments and research material on personality rights, including the extent of protection available and the jurisdiction of the High Court’s Intellectual Property Division (IPD) to deal with such disputes.

Meanwhile, Observing that such matters are frequently brought before the court, the judge shared the legal issues required a broader examination beyond the facts of the present case. The court asked Kriti 's counsel to explain the contours of personality rights, the attributes of an individual that may receive legal protection and whether such disputes fall within the purview of the IPD.

Notably, Her lawyer, Anand, submitted that personality rights could extend to an individual’s name, voice, face, image, photographs and videos. He also pointed to the commercial use of a person’s identity without their consent or authorisation as an issue arising in such cases. Seeking assistance on the subject, Justice Kaurav asked the counsel to place relevant judicial precedents and research before the court.

As per the latest buzz, “Can you give me some research paper? Please give a compilation. Give me judgments and your understanding regarding personality rights,” the court observed, adding that it would consider passing a comprehensive order after examining the material. Anand told the court that the compilation would be filed during the day and submitted that no jurisdictional issue arose in Kriti's case. The matter has been listed for further hearing on October 29.

In further updates, The proceedings come against the backdrop of an increasing number of petitions concerning personality rights filed by actors, sportspersons and other public figures before the Delhi High Court. Such cases commonly involve allegations of unauthorised use of names, photographs, likenesses, voices and other identifiable aspects of a person’s identity, particularly for commercial purposes.

On top of that, The court has previously dealt with personality rights claims involving several prominent personalities, including actors Kangana Ranaut , Tabu and Vijay Deverakonda , cricketers Abhishek Sharma and Yuvraj Singh, Congress leader Shashi Tharoor and Andhra Pradesh Deputy Chief Minister Pawan Kalyan.

The growing use of digital platforms and artificial intelligence has further complicated the issue, particularly in cases involving allegedly unauthorised digital reproductions, impersonation, deepfakes and the use of a public figure’s identity to promote products or services.

title: PCI sets out dos and don’ts for journalists covering protests
body: Here's the latest protest news from across India:

The Press Council of India (PCI) has issued guidelines for journalists covering protests and demonstrations, emphasising professional neutrality, crowd safety, ethical reporting and coordination between newsrooms and reporters in the field.

Adding to this, Students from the All India Students’ Association (AISA) and other student organisations detained by Delhi Police during the protest Tiranga march at Connaught Place on Friday. (Sanjeev Verma/Hindustan Times) The guidelines, adopted at the council’s meeting on October 14, were dated Thursday, according to a press rollout dated October 15. They seek to facilitate effective media coverage of protests while protecting journalists and promoting responsible reporting.

Meanwhile, PCI is a statutory, quasi-judicial body established under the Press Council Act, 1978. Its jurisdiction covers print media, including newspapers and news agencies, but does not extend to television, radio or internet-based digital news platforms.

Notably, The guidelines advise journalists to carry valid identity cards issued by their media organisations or applicable Press Information Bureau (PIB) or Directorate of Information and Publicity (DIP) accreditation, and keep their press identification visible. They should also secure identity cards and lanyards to prevent them from getting caught during crowd movement or confrontations.

As per the latest buzz, Emphasising professional neutrality, the council has advised journalists against participating in demonstrations, taking sides, provoking confrontations or interfering with protesters, counter-protesters or police. Media personnel should remain respectful, follow police orders and comply with lawful instructions issued for immediate safety, while calmly asserting their press status when necessary.

In further updates, On crowd safety, journalists have been advised to maintain a reasonable distance from confrontations, particularly when tensions escalate or police action is anticipated. They should avoid attaching cameras or recording equipment to police barricades, vehicles or other equipment in ways that obstruct movement or cause damage. The guidelines also call for careful movement through crowds and continuous assessment of potential risks.

On top of that, The council has stressed situational awareness and escape planning. Journalists should monitor changes in crowd behaviour, identify nearby exits, open streets and safe locations, and adjust escape routes as conditions change. In areas affected by smoke or tear gas, they should use visible landmarks and safe routes to exit without moving deeper into the crowd.

The guidelines recommend carrying an emergency kit containing basic first-aid supplies, essential medication, drinking water, high-protein snacks, a flashlight, a washcloth or hand towel, and eye protection or goggles. Protective headgear and body armour may be considered depending on the assessed threat. Journalists have also been cautioned against touching or moving tear-gas canisters, flash-bang devices or smoke grenades.

title: BJP, Oppn trade barbs over protests against CEC, SIR
body: Here's the latest protest news from across India:

Lucknow/New Delhi: Defence minister Rajnath Singh on Friday attacked the Opposition Congress over protests against chief election commissioner (CEC) Gyanesh Kumar and alleged irregularities in the Special Intensive Revision (SIR) of electoral rolls, accusing it of trying to seize power by spreading anarchy, even as the party hit back, saying it wanted to defeat the BJP through democratic means and not extra-constitutional methods.

Adding to this, India News “This fight is not for electoral reforms, not for SIR, not against Gyanesh Kumar, not for bright future of youth. It is a conspiracy to grab power. In democracy there is no licence to spread anarchy and attack constitutional institutions,” Singh shared while addressing a press conference in Lucknow.

Meanwhile, Congress MP Pawan Khera rejected the allegations, accusing the BJP of treating protests as anti-national when it faced public criticism. “The BJP is not used to democracy when it is on the receiving end of it. When it has to face the heat of democracy, answer questions and confront protests, democracy suddenly begins to look like treason and anti-national activity to them,” he shared.

Notably, Tens of thousands of people have taken to the streets seeking Kumar’s removal and the scrapping of SIR, even as authorities ordered Metro closures, Internet shutdowns, imposed prohibitory orders and deployed 40,000 security personnel to turn Delhi into a virtual fortress. Many protesters were dragged, manhandled and detained as the ruling BJP accused the Opposition of trying to deflect attention from its electoral failures.

As per the latest buzz, Singh accused the Congress and its allies of seeking a change of government along the lines of Bangladesh, saying they were using the energy of young people to spread anarchy and undermine democratic institutions.

In further updates, “It appears that the Congress and its political allies, directly and through their supporting organisations, are trying to use the energy of the youth to fuel political confrontation and spread anarchy instead of channelling it towards constructive work and nation-building,” he shared. “The youth of the country are being made pawns in the politics of anarchy,” he added.

On top of that, “They openly say at press conferences that they have drawn inspiration from Bangladesh for regime change, while another speaks openly about bringing down the government. This makes it clear that their only agenda is to dismantle democratic institutions and set the country on fire,” he shared, referring to the uprising in Bangladesh in 2024 that toppled the Sheikh Hasina government.

Khera shared the Opposition wanted to change the government through elections, citing the change of government in 1977 after the Emergency. “How does regime change happen in a democracy like India? Through elections. Changing the regime through elections is precisely the Opposition’s objective,” he shared.

CJP's Saurav Das, Ashutosh Ranka in judicial custody CJP co-convenors Saurav Das and Ashutosh Ranka had been sent to five-day judicial custody on Wednesday after being produced before a special executive magistrate at the Mandi Marg Police Station in Delhi. Das, Ranka and 12 others were detained early on Tuesday (October 13) after they climbed a locked gate to enter the Jantar Mantar, which had earlier been de-notified as a protest site. While CJP national organisation in-charge Shinde and 11 others were rolled out, Das and Ranka were sent to judicial custody.
Meanwhile, CJP protest LIVE: CJP's Abhijeet Dipke and AISA's Neha Bora were taken into preventive custody ahead of the 'Lehra Do Tiranga' protest march at Connaught Place in Delhi on Friday.

Notably, While Bora was rolled out after completing formalities related to their detention under Section 65 of the Delhi Police Act, Dipke was arrested in a fresh case for breach of peace under Sections 126 and 170 of the Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita, police shared.

As per the latest buzz, CJP protest LIVE: After five days of the arrest of Cockroach Janta Party (CJP) activists Saurav Das and Ashutosh Ranka, party national organisation in-charge Ajinkya Shinde on Saturday questioned their detention, alleging that the two were being jailed in their own country for waving the national flag.
