title: Rajpal Yadav deposits Rs 2 crores in cheque bounce case; Supreme Court refers dispute to mediation
body: Here's the latest box office buzz making the rounds:

A Bench comprising Chief Justice of India Surya Kant and Justice Joymalya Bagchi noted that Yadav had earlier proposed selling his ancestral property to arrange the balance payment. The Court, however, shared the parties should attempt to resolve the dispute through mediation before proceeding further with the matter.
Adding to this, The star and the counsel representing Murli Projects agreed to the proposal. The case has now been referred to the Supreme Court Mediation Centre.

Meanwhile, During the hearing, the Bench observed that Yadav had reached a point where he was considering selling his ancestral property to settle the case. The Court shared it wanted both sides to explore an amicable resolution, while noting that it could still examine the matter on merits if required.

Notably, "What we are saying is that you have been brought to the verge of selling your ancestral property only to get rid of this case. Of course, we will hear on merits also, if the occasion arises. But at this stage, after losing before different courts, the scope of interference is known very well. We want that you amicably settle," the Court remarked.

As per the latest buzz, In its order, the Bench recorded that mediation could help resolve the dispute. It shared, "Going by the issues briefly raised on behalf of the parties, it seems that the matter can be amicably resolved through mediation. Consequently, the parties have agreed to mediation before the Supreme Court Mediation Centre."

In further updates, The Court directed both sides to approach the mediation process with an open mind and make an effort to reach a settlement over the remaining dues. It also permitted Yadav to seek the rollout of his passport for professional travel abroad, subject to the conditions imposed by the trial court.

On top of that, The payment follows an undertaking Yadav made before the Supreme Court during the previous hearing on October 7. At the time, the star appeared in person and submitted demand drafts totalling Rs 1.15 crore rupees.

His counsel informed the Court that a prospective buyer of Yadav’s ancestral property would deposit an additional Rs 85 lakhs, taking the total amount to Rs 2 crores. The remaining dues, the counsel submitted, would be arranged through the sale of the property.

title: Nushrratt Bharuccha undergoes successful spine surgery after Bali accident, returns home to recover: ‘Relieved to share that the surgery went well’
body: Here's the latest update from the Bollywood world:

Star Nushrratt Bharuccha has returned home after successfully undergoing spine surgery following an accident in Bali. The star's team has shared a fresh update, confirming that she has been discharged from the hospital and is now focusing on her recovery. While she is doing well after the surgery, her team has shared that complete recovery will take time.

Adding to this, Nushrratt Bharuccha undergoes successful spinal surgery after the accident in Bali. The official statement Sharing the update on October 15, her team shared, “After going through a difficult and challenging phase following her unfortunate accident, Nushrratt Bharuccha has successfully undergone spine surgery. We are relieved to share that the surgery went well, and she has now been discharged from the hospital."

Meanwhile, Their statement further read, “Nushrratt is finally back home, surrounded by care and comfort, as she begins the important journey towards recovery. While the road to complete recovery will take time, she remains positive and is focusing on healing and regaining her strength. We sincerely thank everyone for the overwhelming love, concern, prayers and good wishes extended to her during this difficult time.”

Notably, The star suffered a spinal fracture while in Bali for what her team had described as a work-cum-holiday trip. She was initially admitted to a hospital in Indonesia before being flown to Mumbai in an air ambulance for further treatment. Videos of Nushrratt arriving in Mumbai on a stretcher, wearing hospital clothes with a tube in her nose and an IV drip on her hand, had circulated online, leaving followers worried about her health.

As per the latest buzz, Her publicist had verified the accident in an earlier statement, saying, “Nushrratt Bharuccha, who was in Bali for a work-cum-holiday trip, met with an unfortunate accident and suffered a fracture in her spine.”

In further updates, The team had also stressed that her health was the priority, adding that her “immediate priority is her health and ensuring she receives the necessary medical care.” The statement noted that she would need “time to rest and recover,” and that her professional commitments could be affected over the following weeks.
On top of that, With the surgery now behind her, Nushrratt is back home and beginning her recovery. Her team has thanked followers and well-wishers for their support as she takes time to heal.

Before the accident, Nushrratt had several projects lined up. She was last seen in the Netflix movie Ufff Yeh Siyapaa, a silent comedy thriller also featuring Sohum Shah and Nora Fatehi. Rolled out on Netflix on October 31, 2025, the movie follows an ordinary man whose life turns chaotic after a series of absurd mix-ups. Nushrratt plays Pushpa in the movie.

title: Suniel Shetty joins Marzi by Primus as brand ambassador to promote active ageing
body: Here's the latest update from the Bollywood world:

Through its platform, Marzi brings together like-minded individuals through curated meet-ups, interest-based communities, social events, fitness activities and learning experiences. Marzi Travel extends this philosophy beyond everyday experiences, offering thoughtfully curated domestic and international holidays that bring people together through shared adventures, new destinations and meaningful connections. Adding to this, The association is being launched through a new advertising campaign featuring Suniel Shetty, highlighting the joy of finding people who share one’s interests and passions. The movie concludes with the message: “Be where you belong. With Marzi meet-ups, find your kind.”

Meanwhile, Speaking about the association, Suniel Shetty, star, entrepreneur, and brand ambassador for Marzi by Primus, shared: “My age is a fact. How I choose to live is entirely up to me. At 65, I’m still learning, exploring new opportunities, staying fit and discovering new passions. And I’ve realised that a fulfilling life isn’t just about physical fitness. It’s about friendships, shared experiences, travel and having something exciting to look forward to. That’s what I love about Marzi. It encourages people to keep exploring, connecting and enjoying life on their own terms. Because the best years of your life don’t have to be behind you.”

Notably, Adarsh Narahari, Founder, Marzi by Primus, shared: “For too long, ageing in India has been associated with slowing down, dependency and retirement. We believe it should be about freedom, discovery and new beginnings. At Marzi, we’re creating opportunities for people to make new friends, travel the world, discover new interests and lead more fulfilling lives. Suniel embodies this philosophy throughhis commitmentto fitness, constant reinvention and enthusiasm for life. We’re delighted to have him join us in inspiring India’s Generation Evergreen to live life on their own terms.”

As per the latest buzz, The partnership marks another step in Marzi’s ambition to reshape the narrative around ageing in India, moving the conversation beyond healthcare and retirement towards experiences, friendships, wellbeing and the joy of living.

title: EXCLUSIVE: CBFC censors 57 seconds of Yami Gautam Dhar's dialogue in Nayyi Navelli; inserts disclaimer in visuals of masala eating
body: Here's the latest update from the Bollywood world:

The Central Board of Movie Certification (CBFC) passed Nayyi Navelli with a U/A 16+ certificate. However, they asked for a few minor changes. Adding to this, A visual in the climax was 'suitably modified' while at the same time, the background music was also asked to be 'suitably modified'. body: Here's the latest update from the Bollywood world:

With established platforms in Melbourne and Sydney, the Perth edition aims to expand the reach of Indian cinema, provide opportunities for filmmakers and audiences to connect, and strengthen cultural ties between India and Western Australia.

Meanwhile, The announcement of the festival coincided with the visit of Western Australia's Premier, Hon Roger Cook MLA, to India. The initiative reflects the growing cultural and creative links between the two regions and aims to encourage further cultural exchange through cinema.

Notably, Vidya Balan, known for her work across a range of roles and narratives, has been associated with films that explore distinctive stories and women-led characters. Her participation as Chief Guest at the inaugural festival will mark the beginning of the event, which seeks to bring audiences together through Indian cinema across languages, cultures and regions.

As per the latest buzz, Speaking about the announcement, Mitu Bhowmick Lange AM, Festival Director, shared, “Bringing the Indian Movie Festival to Perth is a very special milestone for us. Having built platforms for Indian cinema in Melbourne and Sydney, we are delighted to now bring this celebration to Western Australia and connect with a new community of audiences and movie lovers. Cinema has a remarkable ability to bring people together, transcend borders and create a deeper understanding of one another. We are thrilled to welcome Vidya Balan as the Chief Guest for our inaugural edition, and we look forward to creating a festival that celebrates the extraordinary diversity of Indian storytelling while building meaningful cultural connections between India and Western Australia.”

In further updates, Through its first edition, the Indian Movie Festival of Perth aims to establish a platform for Indian cinema in Western Australia and bring together movie enthusiasts, filmmakers and members of the creative community. The programme will showcase stories from across Indian languages, genres and perspectives, while providing opportunities for discussions, collaborations and cultural exchange.

On top of that, The festival's launch adds another platform for Indian cinema in Australia, with the organisers looking to build connections between audiences and the movie industry while highlighting the range of stories emerging from India.

title: Abhijeet Dipke free to hold protest at Connaught Place tomorrow, Delhi Police assures HC of vigilance
body: Here's the latest protest news from across India:

The Delhi High Court on Thursday refused to pass an order restraining the Cockroach Janta Party (CJP) and its founder, Abhijeet Dipke, from holding a protest at Connaught Place on October 16. The court recorded the Delhi Police's assurance that it would take “all possible measures” to control the situation. Track Delhi protests live here

Adding to this, Cockroach Janta Party (CJP) founder Abhijeet Dipke has called for a ‘Tiranga March’ at Central Park in Delhi’s Connaught Place on October 16, urging people to gather with the national flag at 5 pm. (PTI) The court was hearing a petition filed by Anil Kumar Gupta, a licensed street vendor at Palika Bazar, who expressed concerns that the proposed demonstration at Central Park in Connaught Place could disrupt business activities and affect traders and other people working in the area, Bar and Bench reported.

Meanwhile, During the hearing, the Delhi Police assured the court that appropriate steps would be taken in view of the apprehensions raised by the petitioner. The matter has been posted for further consideration on November 3.

Notably, Dipke has called for a nationwide ‘ Lehra Do Tiranga’ demonstration on October 16, asking people to assemble at Central Park in Connaught Place at 5 pm with the national flag. He has framed the march as a protest against the arrests of fellow CJP members Saurav Das and Ashutosh Ranka.

As per the latest buzz, In his appeal, Dipke shared that waving the Tricolour was not a crime and urged people in other cities to organise similar gatherings. He has also indicated that he could face arrest over the protest call, HT reported earlier.

In further updates, The proposed demonstration comes days after Das and Ranka were sent to five days of judicial custody and lodged in Tihar Jail. They were arrested along with CJP activist Ajinkya Shinde after allegedly entering Jantar Mantar, a day after the Delhi Police denotified it as a designated protest site.

On top of that, The arrests followed a demonstration in which CJP members allegedly raised slogans demanding the resignation of chief election commissioner Gyanesh Kumar . Police cited alleged trespassing, violations of prohibitory orders and breaches of peace-bond conditions in connection with the action against the activists.

The petition against the October 16 march argued that Central Park was not a designated protest venue and that a gathering there could affect traffic, access to public spaces and commercial activity around Connaught Place, particularly during the festive period.

title: Ramayana gets PG-13 rating in the US; Ranbir Kapoor, Yash’s film clocks 3 hours and 15 minutes runtime
body: Here's the latest update from the Bollywood world:

Nitesh Tiwari’s Ramayana , which is being called as Ramayana: Rise of a Legend, is gearing up for its global rollout, with the international trailer set to be unveiled in Bengaluru on October 15. Starring Ranbir Kapoor , Sai Pallavi and Yash , the much-anticipated epic has drawn attention ahead of its theatrical rollout, with its US age rating and reported runtime becoming the latest talking points. Now, the runtime and rating for the movie has been revealed, due to its certification internationally.

Adding to this, Ramayana gets PG-13 rating ahead of rollout; Ranbir Kapoor’s epic as per reports has a 3-hour-plus runtime. Ramayana gets a PG-13 rating in the US The Motion Picture Association (MPA) in the United States has given Ramayana: Rise of a Legend a PG-13 rating, indicating that some of its content may not be suitable for children below the age of 13. The classification advises parental guidance for younger viewers and is broadly comparable to India's U/A certification, although the two rating systems have different guidelines.

Meanwhile, According to the MPA's official website, the rating is based on the movie's intense action sequences, violence and some graphic images involving blood. The classification offers an early indication of what audiences can expect from the movie's portrayal of the epic's battles and larger-than-life confrontations.

Notably, The movie's duration has also become a subject of discussion ahead of its rollout. IMAX lists the movie's runtime is at 3 hours and 15 minutes, suggesting that the movie could run well beyond the three-hour mark. However, trade sources indicate that the English-language version may be shorter, with a reported runtime of around 2 hours and 45 minutes. The makers have yet to confirm the final duration.

As per the latest buzz, If the longer runtime is verified, Ramayana will become Ranbir Kapoor's second movie to cross the three-hour mark. His first was Sandeep Reddy Vanga 's Animal, which had a runtime of 3 hours and 21 minutes.

In further updates, The event is being hosted by Prime Focus Studios and Yash's Monster Mind Creations. On Wednesday night, Namit Malhotra shared an official statement which read,“When we set out to make Ramayana, our dream was always to take one of India’s greatest stories to the world. Tomorrow, that dream takes another big step forward. Sony Pictures begins its international campaign for Ramayana, introducing this timeless story to audiences across the globe, many of whom will be discovering it for the very first time.”

On top of that, The post further read, “For a movie born in India to be presented to the world on the scale of a global cinematic event is something we as Indians are incredibly proud of.” The producer's note ended with the lines "Our truth. Our history. From India to the world. Jai Shri Ram." The post was signed by Namit, director Nitesh Tiwari and Yash.

Directed by Nitesh Tiwari and produced by Namit Malhotra's Prime Focus Studios in collaboration with eight-time Oscar-winning visual effects company DNEG and Yash's Monster Mind Creations, Ramayana is planned as a two-part cinematic epic. The first instalment is scheduled for a worldwide theatrical rollout on November 5, 2026, while the second part is planned for Diwali 2027.

title: Saif Ali Khan leases office space in Mumbai's Andheri to a fintech firm for ₹22.76 lakh monthly rent
body: Here's the latest update from the Bollywood world:

Saif Ali Khan has leased two commercial units spanning 5,692 sq ft of RERA carpet area on Andheri Kurla Road in Mumbai for a monthly rent of ₹ 22.76 lakh, according to property registration documents accessed by CRE Matrix.

Adding to this, Saif Ali Khan has leased two commercial units spanning 5,692 sq ft of RERA carpet area on Andheri Kurla Road in Mumbai for a monthly rent of ₹22.76 lakh. (HT Files) The leave and licence agreement was registered on September 29, 2026, for a tenure of five years, from May 10, 2026, to May 9, 2031, the documents show. The space has been leased to Durva Fintech Private Limited, represented by director Vikaas Mohan Sachdeva, who is the licensee, while Khan is the licensor, acting through his constituted attorney.

Meanwhile, According to property registration documents, the leased premises comprise commercial units on the higher floor of a building named Kanakia Wall Street, located in Chakala, Andheri East. The agreement specifies a monthly rent of ₹ 22,76,800 for the combined 5,692 sq ft area, translating into approximately ₹ 400 per sq ft per month on the RERA carpet area.

Notably, The agreement includes a security deposit of ₹ 2.36 crore rupees, equivalent to more than 10 months of the starting monthly rent. The tenant has been given a two-month rent-free period from May 10 to July 9, 2026, to undertake fit-out work before the rent commencement date of July 10, 2026. The monthly rent is scheduled to increase by 5% annually over the five-year tenure.
As per the latest buzz, According to the agreement, the total rent payable over the 60-month period amounts to approximately over ₹ 14 crore rupees, excluding applicable goods and services tax (GST).

In further updates, The registration documents also indicate that Khan acquired the two commercial units in November 2025. The Index-II records show that unit was purchased for for over ₹ 30 crore rupees, taking the combined acquisition value to ₹ 30.75 crore rupees. Both purchases were registered on November 18, 2025, from Apicore Pharmaceuticals Private Limited, CRE Matrix shared.

On top of that, In the surroundings where Saif Ali Khan has purchased the office units, Elon Musk’s satellite internet venture, Starlink Satellite Communications Private Limited , of late, leased a 1,294 sq ft office space in Mumbai’s Chandivali area for five years, at a total rent of ₹ 2.33 crore rupees.
Saif Ali Khan and Durva Fintech Private Limited could not be reached for comment.

title: Imran Khan to move Bombay High Court after getting notice to leave the country, says actor's lawyer
body: Here's the latest update from the Bollywood world:

Imran Khan's lawyer has shared that the star will move the Bombay High Court against a notice issued asking him to leave the country. He shared rules do not prohibit OCI (Overseas Citizen of India) cardholders from participating in a protest.

Adding to this, Imran Khan was detained for taking part in anti-CEC protests on October 10. What is the row? Last week, Imran, who as per reports holds a US passport, had participated in a protest at Mumbai’s August Kranti Maidan demanding the resignation of Chief Election Commissioner Gyanesh Kumar. He was also detained by Mumbai Police while he was protesting.

Meanwhile, According to the information provided, action has been initiated against Imran under Sections 29 and 7 of the Immigration Act over allegations that he participated in the protest despite not being an Indian citizen.

Notably, Following his detention, the star shared a picture of himself apparently seated inside a police van, accompanied by the caption, “Apparently I’m going for a drive.”In conversation with the media, Khan shared he had come to the location as a citizen of Mumbai and was not present with any specific demands.
As per the latest buzz, He questioned the restrictions on freedom of movement and the suppression of people's voices.

In further updates, CJP activist Abhijit Dipke has also reacted. Backing Imran, Dipke on X wrote, "Mary Millben, an American, can speak in favour of the BJP. But Imran, an OCI cardholder, can’t say anything against the BJP ."

On top of that, Earlier, Bharatiya Janata Party (BJP) leader Kirit Somaiya had demanded the immediate arrest and deportation of star Imran Khan over his participation in a protest in Mumbai, alleging violations of Overseas Citizen of India (OCI) provisions and visa conditions.

Somaiya shared he had submitted evidence to the police regarding the star's speeches during the demonstration and his earlier remarks. He also called for immediate police action, alleging that Khan had misused his OCI status by participating in what he described as an illegal political agitation.

title: Anupam Kher backs right to dissent amid anti-CEC protests but slams insults against PM Modi: ‘Is it necessary to resort to abuse?'
body: Here's the latest update from the Bollywood world:

Anupam Kher has defended the right to protest and question the government amid the ongoing demonstrations against Chief Election Commissioner Gyanesh Kumar, but shared dissent should not be an excuse for abusive language or violence. Currently touring the US and Canada with his play Jaane Pehchane Anjaane, the star shared a video addressing the protests, explaining why he felt compelled to speak up despite expecting criticism.

Adding to this, Anupam Kher questions abusive remarks against PM Modi. (PTI) The demonstrations have been fuelled by allegations of voter-list irregularities and vote theft, with protesters demanding Gyanesh's resignation. While he shared criticising Prime Minister Narendra Modi and challenging government decisions were essential democratic rights, he also stressed that those supporting the government deserved the freedom to express their views.

Meanwhile, In his Instagram caption, Kher shared he did not want to remain silent simply to avoid criticism. He argued that people supporting the protests should be heard, but so should those who disagree with them.

Notably, “Sometimes, speaking up is essential, even if some people might not like what you say. Staying true in your own eyes is far more important than being popular with others. When your conscience tells you to speak out, staying silent becomes difficult—and that is exactly what I am doing,” he wrote.

As per the latest buzz, Explaining why he was speaking out in support of Modi, Kher added, “I am also among those who are hurt by the abusive language used against the Prime Minister. He is the Prime Minister of our country, older in age, and in my view, leading the country well. Disagreement and criticism have their place, but why should there be a need for abusive language to express one's point?”

In further updates, View this post on Instagram Anupam Kher questions abusive remarks against PM Modi Calling himself an unofficial cultural ambassador of India, Anupam shared the videos emerging from the protests had left him upset. He particularly objected to alleged abuses directed at Modi and his mother, along with the reported mistreatment of police personnel, including women officers.

On top of that, Making it clear that he was not questioning the right to protest, the star shared, “I want to clarify at the outset that we all have the right to protest. Questions should be asked of the government, criticize the Prime Minister, and disagree with his decisions—all of this should happen in a democracy. But is it right to abuse the Prime Minister, direct foul language at his mother, behave rudely with police personnel, insult female police officers, and provoke them? No matter how fierce your opposition is, is it necessary to resort to abuse to make your point?”

He then also reiterated his faith in PM Modi's leadership, saying his opinion was based on the Prime Minister's work over the past 12 years. Addressing allegations against Kumar and the Election Commission, he urged protesters to present evidence and seek answers through legal and constitutional channels.

title: Salman Khan recalls feeling a mysterious presence in his bedroom, says lights flickered, cupboards opened on their own: ‘I never stayed alone’
body: Here's the latest update from the Bollywood world:

Bollywood star Salman Khan appeared on the couch of Karan Johar ’s Koffee With Karan season 9. During the show, Salman opened up that he had felt a mysterious presence in his bedroom at Galaxy Apartments, where he lived with his family.

Adding to this, Salman Khan says he never lived alone in his room in Galaxy apartment. (PTI) Salman Khan says he felt mysterious presence in his room Karan recalled visiting Salman’s home to pitch Kuch Kuch Hota Hai to him. Remembering his first visit to Galaxy Apartments, Karan shared Salman lived with his family, including his father, Salim Khan, mother, Salma Khan, and brothers Arbaaz and Sohail. He was surprised to see that Salman had a small bedroom with just a cupboard and a bed.

Meanwhile, Salman then recalled, “I never stayed alone in that room. I always stayed there with somebody whom I had never seen, only heard and felt behind me. Every time I came out of that room, the lights flickered. The cupboards used to open on their own; the music system would turn on on its own. Whenever I was in the bathroom, I could feel someone’s presence outside, fidgeting with the cupboards.”

Notably, When Karan asked if he felt the room was haunted, Salman shared, “Not haunted but a presence was felt by me. Whenever I played music, I could feel its presence behind me. So, I used to play music for it and walk out of the room. There was a billiards table outside, and whenever we played there, we could hear that someone was inside the room. It never freaked me out, it didn't do anything. My only request was if you are a really beautiful woman, then show yourself to me.”

As per the latest buzz, Karan further recalled that he had narrated only the first half of Kuch Kuch Hota Hai to Salman, who agreed to do the cameo. The filmmaker also remembered that other people were waiting outside to narrate their films to the star. Salman casually told them, “What a second half he has written”, even though he had not heard the second half of the movie.

In further updates, Kuch Kuch Hota Hai featured Shah Rukh Khan, Rani Mukerji and Kajol in the lead roles, with Salman making a cameo appearance as Aman, Kajol’s fiancé. During Koffee With Karan season 9, Salman also opened up that Saif Ali Khan and Chandrachur Singh, among others, had turned down the role.
On top of that, Salman will next be seen in Maatrubhumi. Directed by Apoorva Lakhia, the movie also stars Chitrangada Singh in a lead role. Its rollout date is yet to be revealed.

Salman also has a project backed by Dil Raju in the pipeline, as per reports titled Monster. Directed by Vamshi Paidipally, the movie will as per reports star Salman and Nayanthara in the lead roles. It is scheduled to rollout in theatres on Eid 2027.

title: Jailer 2 details: All about that superstar's massy cameo, meta references and a homage 40 years after Bhagwaan Dada
body: Here's the latest update from the Bollywood world:

Everyone who just saw the silhouette of Hrithik Roshan in the trailer of Nelson Dilipkumar’s Jailer 2 trailer for a brief 2 seconds and guessed it was him must be patting themselves on their back. Sure, there were rumours circulating about his cameo in the Rajinikanth movie for a while now, but there was a time when even Shah Rukh Khan and Nandamuri Balakrishna’s names did the rounds. As I write this, it’s no surprise that Hrithik does, in fact, get a cameo in Jailer 2 thanks to all the clips circulating on X (formerly Twitter). Know all about the references and homages in his few minutes on screen. *Spoilers ahead*

Adding to this, There’s a point in Jailer 2 when Tiger Muthuvel Pandian (Rajinikanth) is almost painted into a corner, and he requires the help of more than his steadfast friends, Narasimha (Shiva Rajkumar), Mathew (Mohanlal) and Kamdev (Jackie Shroff). When Kamdev warns Muthu that he needs to be careful because Bodhi Kalpak (SJ Suryah) is closing in on him, he makes a phone call, and the new cameo is teased.

Meanwhile, When Muthu’s family is in danger, dressed in a workman jumpsuit, bronzed to the T and rocking a new hairstyle and piercings, Roddy (Hrithik) comes to his aid. Teased almost like Charlie with his angels, he comes to reign chaos with four of his henchwomen (one of whom is played by Bani). Roddy even says that Muthu helped him 20 years ago. “You might have forgotten what you’ve done for me. I’ll never forget. Anytime, anything for you, sir,” he says, kissing his hand.
Notably, The duo then even get a chance to be massy together, with Hrithik paying homage to Rajinikanth’s trademark sunglasses flip as he walks next to him.
As per the latest buzz, View this post on Instagram A post shared by Hrithikrules (Hrithik Roshan) (@hrithikrules_official)

In further updates, Hrithik was only 12 when he shared the screen with Rajinikanth in the 1986 movie Bhagwaan Dada. The movie, which also starred his dad, Rakesh Roshan , saw him play a young boy named Govind, who is adopted by Rajinikanth’s titular character. Jailer 2 marked their reunion after 40 long years, with a now-older Hrithik, seemingly referencing everything Rajinikanth had done for him.

On top of that, In January 2025, even before Jailer 2 went on floors, Hrithik expressed interest in working with Rajinikanth again. At the trailer launch of The Roshans, he shared, “I had no idea that I was standing with the greatest legend of all time. For me, he was Rajni uncle. I used to talk to him like, yeah, no... I had my way with him.” He also added, “I will realise the burden and the weight of the moment that I am sharing screen space with him... He was so gentle and so giving. Whenever I messed up a shot, my grandfather used to cut the shot. And Rajni sir used to take the blame, saying, sorry, sorry, sorry. My fault.”

In August 2025, before Coolie clashed at the ticket-window with his War 2, Hrithik congratulated Rajinikanth on completing 50 years in cinema, writing, “Took my first steps as an star at your side. You were one of my first teachers, @rajinikanth sir, and continue to be an inspiration and a standard. Congratulations on completing 50 years of on-screen magic!”

title: Manoj Bajpayee's 'Ghooskhor Pandat' renamed 'Gajab Raat', to release on Oct 23
body: Here's the latest update from the Bollywood world:

Manoj Bajpayee's 'Ghooskhor Pandat' renamed 'Gajab Raat', to rollout on Oct 23 Directed by Ritesh Shah and produced by Pandey's banner Friday Storytellers, the crime thriller follows a police officer caught between personal gain and doing what he believes is right, as his decision sets off a chain of events over the course of one night, Netflix shared in a press rollout on Thursday.

Adding to this, "My association with Netflix has been an exciting journey, and 'Gajab Raat' is another project I'm delighted to be a part of," Bajpayee, who had also collaborated with the streamer for its 2025 movie "Inspector Zende", shared in a note.

Meanwhile, "I have always been drawn to characters who are not easy to define, and this movie gave me the opportunity to inhabit a world filled with suspense, moral dilemmas and questions of accountability. What makes the story particularly compelling is how the characters' motivations gradually reveal themselves as the night unfolds," he added.
Notably, "Gajab Raat" continues Pandey's creative association with Netflix following the success of "Khakee" franchise, "Sikandar Ka Muqaddar" and the of late-rolled out show "Taskaree".

As per the latest buzz, "I have always believed that an engaging story should do more than keep you guessing; it should also leave you thinking. 'Gajab Raat' is a thriller where the choices that people make push them to a point where there are no easy answers. The tension comes as much from the moral dilemmas the characters face as from the events unfolding over the course of one night," the filmmaker-producer shared.

In further updates, "Reuniting with Manoj and introducing Ritesh as a director was another exciting aspect of the project. I'm looking forward to audiences experiencing the movie on Netflix," he added.
On top of that, Shah, who has worked as a writer on projects such as "Kahaani", "Pink", "Airlift" and "Raid", shared he has been a huge fan of thriller movies.

" pull you into a situation and keep you guessing what happens next, and that was the starting point for 'Gajab Raat'. With the story unfolding over a single night, we had the opportunity to build a sense of urgency and keep raising the stakes as events unfold... I'm looking forward to audiences discovering the movie and experiencing the story for themselves," he shared.

title: Where have Bollywood's children's films vanished? Why the industry that gave Makdee and Taare Zameen Par won't bet on kids anymore
body: Here's the latest update from the Bollywood world:

Movie historians often argue that the 1950s and 60s was the golden age of Indian cinema , when filmmakers experimented with genres, subjects, and socio-political issues freely and without sacrificing mainstream commercial aspirations. The period gave rise to several desi movie genres that remain prevalent today. A similar case could be made for the period between the late 90s and early 2010s for ‘children’s films’ in India. During that 15-17-year period, major filmmakers and stars experimented with mainstream films aimed at children. Be it animation, fantasy, or even coming-of-age, kids were spoilt for choice when it came to Hindi films made for them.

Adding to this, The soon-to-release movie, Little Thomas, is a rarity in these times with a child star in the lead. Around the turn of the millennium, Hindi cinema saw a big, positive change in how films meant for children were mounted, made, and marketed. Mainstream stars, actors, and producers increasingly began to venture into the space. And this continued for over a decade. Vishal Bhardwaj began his career with Makdee and Blue Umbrella. Anurag Kashyap followed Black Friday with Return of Hanuman. Both Yash Raj Films and Dharma Productions backed multiple children’s films. And then there were the non-star-led films that still left their mark, from Stanley Ka Dabba to Jajantaram Mamantaram.

Meanwhile, That is in stark contrast to how the situation is today. The big stars no longer work in children's films. The animation industry has found mythology to be the only gateway for kids, and independent slice-of-life films have diminished in number. So much so that when the trailer of Little Thomas - a movie with an 8-year-old in the lead - dropped, the words used to describe it were ‘rare’ and ‘niche’. What changed, then? Hindustan Times spoke to stakeholders - filmmakers, writers, and producers - who have made such films before to decode where Bollywood’s children’s films vanished.

Notably, The biggest change in the last decade of Indian cinema has been the focus on box-office ‘surety’ as a parameter for making films. ‘Risk averse’ is the term writers and directors use to describe financiers and producers today. Kaushal Oza wrote and directed Little Thomas , an soon-to-release movie about a youngster trying to persuade his parents to give him a sibling. The filmmaker says he had to run pillar to post to pitch the movie before he found a backer. “I wrote this movie and started making it because I liked the story. I didn’t think of it as any particular genre, just an accessible movie that could be low-budget. But when I started putting this out. I realised people are seeing it as a children’s movie because they need a reference point. They shared, ‘Children’s movie kaunsi chalti hai (Which children’s movie is successful).’,” he says.

As per the latest buzz, Movie producer Ranjan Singh, who has backed Little Thomas and began his career with Taare Zameen Par , says the market for children’s films exists, as evidenced by the fact that three of the top 10 highest-grossing films of the year globally are children’s films. He argues, “PVR has a sub-section for kids, with about 80-90 theatres across India dedicated to children. 90% of the films played there throughout the year are Hollywood films, because they know how big a market it is.”

In further updates, Industry insiders say that while Hollywood has created a blueprint for kids’ films to succeed, India has lumped children - as audience members - with adults. The films meant for children are now often those that are meant primarily for their parents or older siblings. Filmmaker Sonam Nair, who made her debut with the heartwarming teen comedy Gippi in 2013, recounts an incident from a recent outing to watch singer Mika Singh perform. “There were two kids who kept dancing, and they kept asking for a song. That was the Pushpa title track. He performed that, and these two kids did the full Pushpa step. That is the change. The kids want to watch Pushpa,” she says.

On top of that, Kaushal Oza echoes this, recalling a conversation he had with writer Jaideep Sahni while he was making Little Thomas. “He shared I was up for a challenge. He shared, ‘Idhar bache Singham dekhte hain, Taarak Mehta dekhte hain (Here, kids watch Singham and Taarak Mehta), which may not even be age-appropriate. Your fight is with these titles’.”

Anurag Kashyap may not be the first name that springs to mind when you talk of children’s films, but for years, he was the director of India’s most successful animated movie. His 2007 movie Return of Hanuman was a cable TV hit, even if it did not do well in theatres. Kashyap attributes the changed scenario to a lack of institutional support. “We had a big advantage earlier because we had the Children’s Movie Commission, which was headed by renowned actors and filmmakers. It was almost mandated for the industry to keep making films that catered to children. That is gone now. The irony is that we live in a time when the administration wants all films to be for children. Even adult films are cut so that they can be watched by children. But they should not be children’s films,” says the filmmaker.

title: Akhil calls off sit-in after meeting with 2 Assam ministers over compensation to flood-hit families
body: Here's the latest protest news from across India:

Guwahati, Raijor Dal MLA Akhil Gogoi on Thursday called off his 13-day sit-in after two Assam ministers assured him that CM Himanta Biswa Sarma had agreed to his demands for adequate compensation for the flood-affected people of four districts.

Adding to this, Akhil calls off sit-in after meeting with 2 Assam ministers over compensation to flood-hit families The move came after state cabinet ministers Keshab Mahanta and Pijush Hazarika met Gogoi at the protest site outside the assembly.
Meanwhile, Gogoi had started the sit-in on October 2, demanding adequate compensation for flood-hit people of Sivasagar, Charaideo, Jorhat and Golaghat districts of Upper Assam.

Notably, The MLA had submitted a memorandum to the government demanding that the affected families of these four districts be given a one-time interim assistance of ₹ 15,000, and an additional ₹ 10,000 for flood-hit people of Sivasagar and Charaideo.
As per the latest buzz, He had been demanding a CBI inquiry into the causes of the flood.
In further updates, "We have been deputed by the chief minister to discuss the matter with Gogoi and convey certain measures taken by the government to him," Mahanta shared.

On top of that, He also shared, "Providing ₹ 15,000 as an interim financial assistance to each of the 3,068 families will require over ₹ 4.60 crore rupees, and the government has agreed to pay the amount to the families listed by the Raijor Dal."
The chief minister decided that a high-level inquiry would be instituted and that the committee details would be revealed soon, Mahanta shared.

title: Ghooskhor Pandat renamed Gajab Raat: Trailer of Neeraj Pandey's thriller shows Manoj Bajpayee as cop torn between right and wrong; release date out
body: Here's the latest update from the Bollywood world:

In February, when Netflix revealed its 2026 slate, one of its projects drew attention for all the wrong reasons. An FIR was filed against the makers of Manoj Bajpayee ’s Ghooskhor Pandat over its title. The movie has now been renamed Gajab Raat, with Netflix releasing its trailer and announcing its rollout date.

Adding to this, Manoj Bajpayee's still from Gajab Raat trailer. Gajab Raat trailer The trailer features Manoj Bajpayee as a police officer torn between personal gain and doing what he believes is right. He is seen investigating a case involving a young girl who is thrown out of a car in a serious condition and later fights for her life in hospital. Unfolding over the course of a single night, the story centres on the officer’s dilemma as he weighs doing the right thing against manipulating the case for his own benefit. One decision could change the course of the investigation and everything that follows. The trailer also offers glimpses of the characters played by Divya Dutta, Nushrratt Bharuccha and Akshay Oberoi.

Meanwhile, In February, after Netflix revealed Ghooskhor Pandat (now titled Gajab Raat), the name became the subject of widespread criticism. The row centred on the combination of the words ‘Ghooskhor’, meaning someone who takes bribes, and ‘Pandat’, a colloquial spelling of ‘Pandit’, a term associated with Brahmins and religious scholars. Several people objected to the title, arguing that it linked the Brahmin community with corruption. They alleged that it was derogatory, promoted caste-based stereotyping and hurt the sentiments of the religious community.

Notably, The backlash prompted the makers to withdraw the promotional material and agree to rename the project. The matter eventually reached the courts. Amid the criticism, director Neeraj Pandey issued a statement acknowledging that the title had hurt some viewers. He maintained that the project was a fictional cop drama and that ‘Pandat’ was intended as the colloquial name of a fictional character, rather than a reference to any particular community. He added that the story focused on an individual’s actions and choices and did not comment on or represent any caste, religion or community.

As per the latest buzz, The row took a legal turn when the Uttar Pradesh government ordered an FIR against the movie’s makers over the disputed title. An FIR was registered at Lucknow’s Hazratganj police station amid allegations that the title hurt caste and religious sentiments. The Federation of Western India Cine Employees (FWICE) also objected to the title, arguing that provocative movie titles could hurt sentiments and create social discord. Petitions seeking to prevent the movie’s rollout were subsequently filed in the Delhi High Court.

In further updates, On February 10, 2026, Netflix informed the Delhi High Court that the producer had consciously decided to change the title in light of the concerns raised. The court subsequently disposed of the petition after the petitioner indicated that the grievance had been addressed.

On top of that, The matter also reached the Supreme Court. On February 12, 2026, a bench comprising Justices BV Nagarathna and Ujjal Bhuyan questioned the makers over the title and directed them to confirm its withdrawal and provide details of the replacement name. The court made it clear that it would not permit the movie’s rollout unless the title was changed.

On February 19, 2026, the Supreme Court disposed of the petition after Neeraj Pandey submitted an affidavit confirming that the original title had been withdrawn. He also undertook that the new title, once finalised, would neither resemble nor evoke the earlier name and would accurately reflect the movie’s narrative and intent.
